papers.title: Combining Relevant Expert Knowledge Using Mixtures of Feedback Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
papers.abstract: A neuro-symbolic system should combine only relevant answers from expert agents or other knowledge sources. Using only relevant experts for a given input query becomes ever more important for accuracy and scalability as the knowledge network grows and connects ever more knowledge sources. We extend the standard definition of relevance from the legal theory of evidence: An answer is relevant if and only if it is both probative and material for the matter at hand given the knowledge available. We apply this relevancy scheme to mixing the feedback fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) of real or artificial experts. The expert FCM directed causal graphs mix or combine into a common knowledge network. We compare the equilibrium limit-cycle predictions or answers of the experts to the answers of the mixture FCM and then estimate the probative status of answers by their difference or variation. A new Bayes-like theorem de-mixes the knowledge mixture into corresponding posterior-like FCMs that also allow relevancy-based comparisons. The result is a final set of relevancy mixing weights that produces a relevancy-mixed FCM knowledge network for the given query. So different queries produce different relevancy-mixed FCMs. We demonstrate this relevancy approach using generated synthetic FCMs from an actual 13-node expert FCM that models the causes and feedbacks of ischemic-stroke risk.

translation.title: 使用反馈模糊认知图混合来组合相关专家知识
translation.abstract: 神经符号系统应当只组合来自专家智能体或其他知识源的相关答案。随着知识网络不断增长并连接越来越多的知识源，针对给定输入查询只使用相关专家对准确性和可扩展性变得愈发重要。我们将相关性（relevance）的标准定义从证据法理论加以扩展：给定可用知识，一个答案当且仅当它对当前事务既具证明性（probative）又具实质性（material）时才是相关的。我们将这一相关性方案应用于混合真实或人工专家的反馈模糊认知图（FCM）。专家FCM有向因果图被混合或组合成一个共同的知识网络。我们将专家的均衡极限环预测或答案与混合FCM的答案进行比较，然后通过答案之间的差异或变化来估计答案的证明性状态。一个类贝叶斯的新定理将知识混合解混为对应的类后验FCM，这些FCM也支持基于相关性的比较。最终得到一组相关性混合权重，为给定查询生成相关性混合的FCM知识网络。因此不同的查询会产生不同的相关性混合FCM。我们使用从一个模拟缺血性中风风险成因与反馈的实际13节点专家FCM生成的合成FCM来演示这一相关性方法。
translation.brief: 解决如何只组合与查询相关的专家知识的问题，方法是将证据法中的相关性定义应用于专家反馈模糊认知图的混合与解混。

papers.title: Construct Validity of Coding Benchmarks for LLM-based Agentic Coding Tools
papers.abstract: Software developers increasingly adopt LLM-based agentic coding tools to assist them with development tasks. To provide developers with up-to-date information on these tools' effectiveness, prior work introduced benchmarks that enable comparisons across tools. Despite the widespread adoption of such benchmarks, however, recent work has shown that they suffer from issues threatening their validity. Aims. In this work, we aim to complement prior work by analyzing the construct validity of agentic coding benchmarks. Methodology. We analyze nine benchmarks commonly used to evaluate the effectiveness of agentic coding tools. We identify the constructs that the benchmarks claim to measure, the metrics used to operationalize them, and potential confounders that interfere with the measurement. Results. Our findings show that benchmarks commonly operationalize broad concepts such as coding capability with only a small set of metrics. The reported attributes that might confound the measurements vary between benchmarks, indicating a lack of standardization. Conclusions. We conclude with recommendations to strengthen construct validity in agentic coding benchmarks and encourage further empirical work to better understand the effectiveness of agentic coding tools.

translation.title: 基于LLM的智能体编程工具编程基准的构念效度
translation.abstract: 软件开发者越来越多地采用基于LLM的智能体编程工具来协助开发任务。为了向开发者提供这些工具有效性的最新信息，先前的工作引入了可在工具间进行比较的基准。然而，尽管此类基准被广泛采用，近期研究表明它们存在威胁其效度的问题。目标。本工作旨在通过分析智能体编程基准的构念效度来补充先前的研究。方法。我们分析了九个常用于评估智能体编程工具有效性的基准，识别这些基准声称测量的构念、用于操作化这些构念的指标，以及干扰测量的潜在混淆因素。结果。我们的发现表明，这些基准通常仅用少量指标来操作化诸如编程能力这类宽泛概念。各基准所报告的可能混淆测量的属性各不相同，表明缺乏标准化。结论。我们最后提出加强智能体编程基准构念效度的建议，并鼓励进一步的实证研究以更好地理解智能体编程工具的有效性。
translation.brief: 分析九个智能体编程基准的构念效度问题，方法是通过识别基准声称测量的构念、操作化指标及潜在混淆因素。

papers.title: How Do Artificial Agents Make Decisions in Light of Visual Data?
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant advances in reasoning with visual data, which is particularly important given that much of human knowledge is encoded visually in scientific articles and other sources. However, a gap remains in understanding how artificial agents, powered by VLMs, perceive and navigate decision-making under uncertainty in the presence of visual data. This study explores this gap by evaluating and analyzing autonomous decision-making processes. Building upon prior work in visualization literacy and decision theory, we conducted two complementary studies: one examining how agents perceive and quantify uncertainty encoded in visualizations, and another investigating how artificial agents make decisions based on visual data in the form of images. We analyzed perception accuracy and decision performance across models and visualization types. Our results show that GPT-4o demonstrates the highest accuracy in perceiving uncertainty in pie and bar charts among the tested models. For decision-making, autonomous agents showed the best alignment with rational decision theory when uncertainty was represented through circle charts, icon arrays, or text.

translation.title: 人工智能体如何基于视觉数据进行决策？
translation.abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在基于视觉数据的推理方面取得了显著进展，这一点尤为重要，因为人类知识中有大量以视觉形式编码于科学文章和其他来源中。然而，在理解由VLM驱动的人工智能体如何在存在视觉数据的情况下感知并在不确定性下进行决策方面，仍存在空白。本研究通过评估和分析自主决策过程来探索这一空白。基于可视化素养和决策理论的先前工作，我们开展了两项互补研究：一项考察智能体如何感知和量化可视化中编码的不确定性，另一项研究人工智能体如何基于图像形式的视觉数据进行决策。我们分析了不同模型和可视化类型下的感知准确性和决策表现。结果表明，在受测模型中，GPT-4o在感知饼图和柱状图中的不确定性方面准确性最高。在决策方面，当不确定性通过圆形图、图标阵列或文本表示时，自主智能体与理性决策理论的契合度最佳。
translation.brief: 研究VLM智能体如何从可视化中感知不确定性并据此决策，方法是通过两项互补实验评估不同模型和可视化类型下的感知准确性与决策表现。

papers.title: Agents, Think Only When it Helps
papers.abstract: LLM agent distillation transfers agentic capabilities to student models by training on complete teacher trajectories that typically interleave thoughts and actions. We question how critical thought supervision is for agents' ultimate action performance. To answer this, we disentangle their impacts by independently perturbing teacher thoughts and actions during distillation. On widely adopted agent benchmarks across model scales, altering or discarding thoughts has little effect on student performance. We find, however, that thought supervision becomes important when information about the thought is not disclosed in the corresponding action during training. By identifying such discrepant cases, our findings challenge the common practice of distilling entire teacher trajectories for LLM agents, and offer a new insight that thought supervision can be a discernible choice for efficiency depending on whether the information of thought is disclosed in the action.

translation.title: 智能体，只在有帮助时才思考
translation.abstract: LLM智能体蒸馏通过在完整的教师轨迹（通常交织着思考与行动）上训练，将智能体能力迁移到学生模型。我们质疑思考监督对智能体最终行动表现究竟有多关键。为回答这一问题，我们在蒸馏过程中独立扰动教师的思考和行动，以解耦二者的影响。在跨模型规模的广泛采用的智能体基准上，改变或丢弃思考对学生性能几乎没有影响。然而我们发现，当训练中相应行动未披露思考所含信息时，思考监督变得重要。通过识别此类不一致情形，我们的发现挑战了为LLM智能体蒸馏完整教师轨迹的常见做法，并提出新见解：思考监督可以作为一种可辨识的效率选择，取决于思考的信息是否在行动中被披露。
translation.brief: 研究智能体蒸馏中思考监督是否必要，方法是在蒸馏时独立扰动教师轨迹中的思考与行动以解耦二者影响。

papers.title: Same Method, Different Task: What the Bitter Lesson Does Not License in Social Simulation
papers.abstract: The bitter lesson holds that general methods leveraging computation defeat hand-encoded domain knowledge. We argue it carries a condition its popular reading omits: in every case Sutton cites, the general method was scaled against the same task the domain engineering was solving. Social simulation substituted across tasks instead, replacing hand-built agents with an artifact optimized for predicting text. The move is bitter-lesson-shaped, but the lesson does not license it. Prediction is a solitary act: the predictor bears no consequences from the interaction it models. Cooperation, defection, and norm enforcement are phenomena of interested parties; they do not exist for a disinterested observer at any scale. What is missing is not emergence, which LLM populations already show, but stakes. We show that several anomalies reported in prior work (excess cooperation that predates alignment training, collective agreement without individual fidelity, and population homogeneity) follow from this account. A 540-agent pilot with pre-specified hypotheses, which tests sensitivity to persistent consequences rather than cooperation, finds that consequences reshape strategies in two of three model families but never produce human-like heterogeneity. We argue for mixed-motive settings that shape agents rather than only test them, and ask whether agents should be pretrained differently from predictors.

translation.title: 相同方法，不同任务：苦涩的教训在社会模拟中不能授权什么
translation.abstract: 苦涩的教训（the bitter lesson）认为，利用算力的通用方法会击败手工编码的领域知识。我们论证它带有一个其流行解读所忽略的条件：在Sutton引用的每个案例中，通用方法都是针对与领域工程所解决的相同任务进行扩展的。而社会模拟却进行了跨任务替换，用为预测文本而优化的产物取代手工构建的智能体。这一做法形似苦涩的教训，但该教训并不授权这种做法。预测是一种孤立行为：预测者不会因其所建模的交互而承担后果。合作、背叛和规范执行是利益相关方的现象；对于任何规模的无关观察者而言，它们都不存在。所缺失的不是涌现——LLM群体已经展现出涌现——而是利害关系（stakes）。我们表明，先前工作中报告的若干异常现象（先于对齐训练出现的过度合作、集体一致但个体不忠实、以及群体同质化）都可以由这一解释推出。一项具有预设假设的540智能体试点实验（测试对持续性后果而非合作的敏感性）发现，后果在三个模型家族中的两个中重塑了策略，但从未产生类人的异质性。我们主张采用混合动机情境来塑造智能体而不仅仅是测试它们，并追问智能体是否应当以不同于预测器的方式进行预训练。
translation.brief: 论证苦涩的教训不适用于社会模拟中的跨任务替换，方法是通过理论分析利害关系缺失对LLM智能体群体行为的解释，并用540智能体试点实验验证后果对策略的影响。

papers.title: Cognitive Bias Signatures in Search-Equipped LLM Agents: A Stage-Resolved Analysis
papers.abstract: Search can help LLM agents correct mistakes, but their starting conditions may shape which evidence they find and use. Drawing on cognitive-bias paradigms, we develop a controlled search harness to examine result order, records of prior work, and initial hypotheses while holding each question and document collection fixed. Matched controls distinguish order effects from differences in document composition and the effects of failed work from context length. Across 10 models and 1,000 synthetic search worlds, we track queries, retrieved documents, document openings, and final answers. Our comparisons suggest that final answers are more sensitive to initial evidence order during active search than when all evidence is supplied in full. Dead-end histories can reduce strategy switching relative to matched neutral histories, indicating an effect beyond context length. Under wrong hypotheses, stage measurements distinguish reduced retrieval or opening from errors that persist after counter-evidence is opened. Exploratory interventions show that opening counter-evidence more often can coincide with lower accuracy, while accuracy can improve with little change in opening.

translation.title: 配备搜索的 LLM Agent 中的认知偏差特征：一种分阶段解析分析
translation.abstract: 搜索可以帮助 LLM agent 纠正错误，但其起始条件可能会塑造它们找到并使用哪些证据。借鉴认知偏差范式，我们开发了一个受控搜索实验框架，在保持每个问题和文档集合不变的情况下，考察结果顺序、先前工作记录和初始假设的影响。匹配的对照组用于区分顺序效应与文档组成差异，以及失败工作的影响与上下文长度的影响。在 10 个模型和 1,000 个合成搜索世界中进行实验，我们追踪查询、检索到的文档、文档打开情况和最终答案。我们的比较表明，在主动搜索过程中，最终答案对初始证据顺序的敏感度高于所有证据完整提供时的情况。与匹配的中性历史相比，死胡同式历史会减少策略切换，表明存在超出上下文长度的影响。在错误假设下，分阶段测量能够区分检索或打开行为的减少与反证据打开后仍然持续存在的错误。探索性干预显示，更频繁地打开反证据可能伴随更低的准确率，而准确率可以在打开行为几乎不变的情况下得到提升。
translation.brief: 研究搜索型 LLM agent 的初始条件（证据顺序、历史记录、初始假设）如何引发认知偏差，通过受控搜索框架进行分阶段追踪分析。

papers.title: The Male Abstraction Bias in Internet Culture and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Two foundational aspects of human cognition, abstractness and gender, are typically examined as separable. Here, we find they are systematically linked throughout the entire space of concepts spanning single (N = 40,000) and multi-word expressions (N = 67,000): across billions of words and millions of images on the internet -- and across numerous measurement techniques -- more abstract concepts are more associated with men, an effect which replicates in languages around the world. This pattern not only holds across conceptual domains, but it also maps onto grammatical structure: verbs and adverbs are more abstract and more male-coded, a system-wide trace of stereotypes accentuating agentic qualities in men. Furthermore, this bias emerges in human and AI responses in free association tasks, indicating its internalization and its algorithmic reproduction. The male abstraction bias may underlie and unify a range of stereotypes, evidencing gender as a core organizing dimension in conceptual space.

translation.title: 互联网文化与大型语言模型中的男性抽象偏差
translation.abstract: 人类认知的两个基础维度——抽象性和性别——通常被作为可分离的对象来研究。我们发现，在涵盖单词（N = 40,000）和多词表达（N = 67,000）的整个概念空间中，二者存在系统性关联：在互联网上数十亿词和数百万张图像中——并跨越多种测量技术——越抽象的概念与男性的关联越强，这一效应在世界各地的语言中均可复现。该模式不仅跨越各概念领域成立，还映射到语法结构上：动词和副词更抽象且更多被编码为男性属性，这是强调男性能动性特质的刻板印象在系统层面的痕迹。此外，该偏差出现在人类和 AI 在自由联想任务中的反应中，表明其已被内化并被算法复制。男性抽象偏差可能是多种刻板印象的基础并将其统一起来，证明性别是概念空间中的核心组织维度。
translation.brief: 发现抽象概念与男性系统性关联的“男性抽象偏差”，通过大规模词语、图像和自由联想任务分析验证其在互联网语料和 LLM 中的存在。

papers.title: Prospective Memory for Proactive LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Pro-Memory preserves pending objectives linked to their supporting evidence, assesses new observations against their original goals and activation conditions, and coordinates appropriate contributions with the agent's ongoing actions. It further updates intention states based on actions actually issued or evidence of resolution, while an experience memory distills feedback from completed episodes into guidance for future decisions. Experiments on two benchmarks spanning delayed-intention tasks and open-ended proactive assistance demonstrate consistent improvements in proactive task performance over representative memory approaches across multiple LLM backbones, while limiting unnecessary interventions.

translation.title: 面向主动式 LLM Agent 的前瞻记忆
translation.abstract: 大多数 LLM agent 的记忆系统是回顾性的，即保存和检索过去的信息以辅助当前决策。然而，主动式 agent 还需要前瞻记忆：保留面向未来的意图，并在合适的机会出现时将其实现，即使没有明确的请求。关键在于，记住正确的意图并不保证在正确的时机行动：一个相关的观察可能需要等待，而稍后的线索才可能使同一意图变得可执行。受人类前瞻记忆认知理论的启发，我们提出了 Pro-Memory，一个将维护未来意图与决定何时以及如何实现它们相分离的记忆框架。Pro-Memory 保存待处理目标及其支持证据，将新观察与其原始目标和激活条件进行比对，并协调与 agent 正在进行动作相匹配的适当贡献。它还根据实际发出的动作或已解决的证据更新意图状态，同时经验记忆将已完成回合的反馈提炼为未来决策的指导。在涵盖延迟意图任务和开放式主动辅助的两个基准上的实验表明，在多个 LLM 骨干模型上，该方法相比代表性记忆方法在主动任务性能上取得一致提升，同时限制了不必要的干预。
translation.brief: 针对主动式 agent 缺乏前瞻记忆的问题，提出 Pro-Memory 框架，将未来意图的维护与实现时机决策分离，并结合经验记忆指导决策。

papers.title: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
papers.abstract: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. Experiments show that the policy outperforms a diverse set of baselines, establishing a strong reference for future research on visual-olfactory embodied navigation.

translation.title: OdorSpaces：3D 环境中的视觉-嗅觉具身导航
translation.abstract: 嗅觉提供了关于空气中化学线索的关键信息，但在具身 AI 中仍基本未被充分探索，此前有限的机器嗅觉工作主要聚焦于语义气味感知。我们提出 OdorSpaces，一个基于物理的视觉-嗅觉具身导航仿真平台和基准。OdorSpaces 通过 Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS) 模拟的 3D 气味传输与扩散来增强 Habitat-Sim，使 agent 能够利用视觉和嗅觉观测在照片级真实的室内环境中导航。该基准包含两个典型的寻源场景：不可见气体泄漏定位和早期火灾定位。我们开发了一个初始的多模态强化学习策略，随时间整合视觉观测和嗅觉测量。实验表明该策略优于多种基线，为未来视觉-嗅觉具身导航研究建立了强有力的参考。
translation.brief: 针对具身 AI 中嗅觉导航缺失的问题，构建基于 FDS 气味扩散模拟的 OdorSpaces 仿真平台与基准，并训练多模态强化学习策略进行寻源导航。

papers.title: PersonaCodeBench: Evaluating Coding Agents in Persona-driven Human-Interactive Sessions
papers.abstract: Coding agents must deliver correct software while respecting users' expertise, preferences, and working conditions. Existing benchmarks increasingly incorporate interaction, yet personalized requirement fulfillment remains underexplored. We introduce PersonaCodeBench, which turns user characteristics into verifiable obligations in persona-driven multi-turn coding sessions. Our persona pool spans roles, technical abilities, interaction preferences, and practical constraints, yielding task-grounded evolved requirements for implementation, permissions, testing, explanation, and delivery. At runtime, a controller governs user simulator responses and requirement disclosure, using online requirement evaluation to provide feedback and advance the interaction. Requirements emerge progressively, with their content, disclosure conditions, and acceptance criteria fixed before evaluation. A completion verifier and a personalization verifier separately assess native correctness and persona fulfillment. Joint pass requires both adherence to the declared budget and compliance with validity conditions. We evaluate all major frontier agents, establish a comprehensive leaderboard, and conduct detailed experimental analyses to validate effectiveness. PersonaCodeBench supports reproducible evaluation of coding agents' ability to meet explicit, personalized user expectations alongside coding objectives.

translation.title: PersonaCodeBench：在人格驱动的交互式会话中评估编码 Agent
translation.abstract: 编码 agent 必须在尊重用户的专业水平、偏好和工作条件的前提下交付正确的软件。现有基准越来越多地引入交互，但个性化需求满足仍未被充分探索。我们提出 PersonaCodeBench，它在人格驱动的多轮编码会话中将用户特征转化为可验证的义务。我们的人格池涵盖角色、技术能力、交互偏好和实际约束，产生基于任务的演化需求，涉及实现、权限、测试、解释和交付。在运行时，一个控制器管理用户模拟器的响应和需求披露，利用在线需求评估提供反馈并推进交互。需求逐步显现，其内容、披露条件和验收标准在评估前固定。完成验证器和个性化验证器分别评估原生正确性和人格满足度。联合通过要求同时遵守声明的预算并符合有效性条件。我们评估了所有主要的前沿 agent，建立了全面的排行榜，并进行详细的实验分析以验证其有效性。PersonaCodeBench 支持对编码 agent 在编码目标之外满足明确的、个性化用户期望能力的可复现评估。
translation.brief: 针对编码 agent 个性化需求满足评估缺失的问题，构建 PersonaCodeBench 基准，将用户人格特征转化为可验证义务并通过多轮交互会话进行评估。

papers.title: Pairing Expert Critique with LLM-Driven Refinement: An Iterative Approach for Curating Quality AI Evaluation Datasets
papers.abstract: Evaluating and improving domain-specific LLM responses requires high-quality reference data and rubrics, yet expert authoring is slow and expensive, and synthetic datasets may fail to capture practitioner preferences unless they are grounded in expert judgment. We present SME-C (Subject Matter Expert Critique), a human-AI workflow that captures expertise through lightweight critiques of candidate responses and complements it with LLM-driven analysis and refinement to iteratively curate response datasets and evaluation rubrics. We validate SME-C in the domain of financial business briefs, collecting 3,853 critiques from 411 finance professionals on 520 queries across two survey rounds. We evaluate two LLM-driven refinement strategies: one guided by the experts' written critiques and one that infers critique solely from their preference votes. In a blind validation survey with 100 additional professionals, we found that both strategies significantly improved quality over the experts' top-ranked baseline responses. The gains were concentrated among weaker original responses, and the two strategies excelled in different ways: critique-based refinement produced more domain-grounded improvements, whereas vote-based refinement was more effective at identifying and removing irrelevant content. The resulting rubrics and refined dataset support reproducible offline evaluation and benchmarking of LLMs, suggesting that structured expert critique is a viable alternative to expert authoring for building high-quality, domain-specific evaluation resources more quickly, at scale, and at lower cost.

translation.title: 将专家点评与LLM驱动的精炼相结合：一种迭代式高质量AI评测数据集构建方法
translation.abstract: 评估和改进领域特定的LLM响应需要高质量的参考数据和评分标准，然而专家撰写既缓慢又昂贵，而合成数据集若不基于专家判断，可能无法捕捉从业者的偏好。我们提出SME-C（领域专家点评，Subject Matter Expert Critique），这是一种人机协作工作流，通过对候选响应的轻量级点评来捕捉专家知识，并结合LLM驱动的分析与精炼，迭代式地构建响应数据集和评测评分标准。我们在金融商业简报领域验证了SME-C，在两轮调查中收集了411位金融专业人士对520个查询的3,853条点评。我们评估了两种LLM驱动的精炼策略：一种由专家的书面点评引导，另一种仅从其偏好投票中推断点评。在一项由100位额外专业人士参与的盲测验证调查中，我们发现两种策略都显著优于专家排名最高的基线响应。提升主要集中在原本较弱的响应上，且两种策略各有优势：基于点评的精炼产生了更多扎根于领域的改进，而基于投票的精炼在识别和移除无关内容方面更为有效。由此产生的评分标准和精炼后的数据集支持可复现的离线LLM评估与基准测试，表明结构化的专家点评是专家撰写的一种可行替代方案，能够更快、更大规模、更低成本地构建高质量、领域特定的评测资源。
translation.brief: 针对专家撰写评测数据成本高、合成数据缺乏专家判断的问题，提出通过专家轻量级点评结合LLM迭代精炼来构建高质量领域评测数据集与评分标准的方法SME-C。

papers.title: Scheduling Data to Compute: Hierarchical Data Pipelining for LLM Training on AMD GPUs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLM) have been the key focus of recent machine learning breakthroughs. As the model size grows exponentially, the computation needed for training is astronomical. A GPU can do a huge amount of arithmetic. However, the data its compute units need is not always available when they are ready. This data may still be in slow memory or on another GPU. While the chip waits, expensive compute sits idle, and at scale even a small drop in utilization translates into substantial cost. In this paper, we treat this waiting time as the primary bottleneck. We focus on hardware features designed for explicit data movement. These features load data from off-chip memory onto the chip, rearrange it into the layout the computation requires as it is loaded, and transfer it between GPUs. By orchestrating them, we keep a steady pipeline of data flowing to the compute units so that they remain busy. We present kernel and framework implementations that address this bottleneck using three key data-movement instructions and hardware features. The Tensor Data Mover (TDM) moves tensor data from high-bandwidth memory (HBM) into on-chip memory. Transpose-load instructions transpose tensor data into the layout that LLM computations require as it is loaded on-chip. Finally, System DMA (SDMA) and Remote DMA (RDMA) move data between GPUs over the scale-up and scale-out networks, respectively. Our results show that TDM and transpose-load provide on average 1.88x and 1.19x speedup at the kernel level, respectively. The SDMA and RDMA lead to on average 1.16x and 1.33x speedup for computation overlapped with communication. This is the first AMD LLM training system to utilize all the GPU data pipelining features. Our implementation has been integrated into open source framework and library for AMD GPUs. this https URL this https URL

translation.title: 为计算调度数据：AMD GPU上LLM训练的层次化数据流水线
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）是近期机器学习突破的核心焦点。随着模型规模呈指数级增长，训练所需的计算量极为庞大。GPU可以执行海量算术运算，但其计算单元所需的数据并不总是在它们就绪时可用——数据可能仍在慢速内存中或位于另一个GPU上。当芯片等待时，昂贵的计算资源闲置，而在大规模部署下，即使利用率的微小下降也会带来巨大成本。本文将这种等待时间视为主要瓶颈。我们专注于为显式数据搬运设计的硬件特性：这些特性将数据从片外内存加载到芯片上，在加载过程中将其重排为计算所需的布局，并在GPU之间传输数据。通过协调这些特性，我们保持数据持续流水化地流向计算单元，使其保持忙碌。我们提出了利用三种关键数据搬运指令和硬件特性来解决该瓶颈的kernel和框架实现：Tensor Data Mover（TDM）将张量数据从高带宽内存（HBM）移入片上内存；Transpose-load指令在张量数据加载到片上时将其转置为LLM计算所需的布局；System DMA（SDMA）和Remote DMA（RDMA）分别通过scale-up和scale-out网络在GPU之间搬运数据。结果显示，TDM和transpose-load在kernel层面分别平均带来1.88倍和1.19倍的加速；SDMA和RDMA在计算与通信重叠场景下分别平均带来1.16倍和1.33倍的加速。这是首个利用全部GPU数据流水线特性的AMD LLM训练系统，我们的实现已集成到面向AMD GPU的开源框架和库中。
translation.brief: 针对LLM训练中计算单元等待数据导致的利用率瓶颈，通过协调TDM、transpose-load、SDMA/RDMA等AMD GPU数据搬运硬件特性构建层次化数据流水线以保持计算单元持续忙碌。

papers.title: Toward a Compositional Knowledge Architecture for a Shared Organizational Cortex
papers.abstract: Organizations accumulate evidence in conversations, documents, decisions and relationships, but they act on interpretations: judgements assembled from several observations, resting on assumptions, and revised as circumstances change. Existing retrieval, knowledge graphs and agent memory keep the records and lose the interpretation. We propose a four-layer architecture, Signals, Domains, Claims and Dimensions, in which interpretations persist with their justifications and standing, a truth-maintenance network revises that standing as evidence changes, and validated, versioned Dimensions position interpretations on named axes. We call the result a shared organizational cortex. In a registered retrieval experiment, the Dimension term gains 0.028 nDCG@10 (p = 0.002). In system-level comparisons, the full retrieval configuration improves nDCG@10 by 0.081 over Signals-only and 0.053 over graph-augmented Signals-only retrieval (both reported p < 0.001). The architecture gives organizations a persistent, revisable basis for shared judgement.

translation.title: 面向共享组织皮层的组合式知识架构
translation.abstract: 组织在对话、文档、决策和关系中积累证据，但它们依据的是解释：由多个观察组装而成的判断，建立在假设之上，并随环境变化而修订。现有的检索、知识图谱和智能体记忆保存了记录却丢失了解释。我们提出一个四层架构——Signals、Domains、Claims和Dimensions——其中解释与其依据和状态一同持久化，一个真值维护网络随证据变化修订其状态，经验证且带版本的Dimensions将解释定位于命名轴上。我们将这一结果称为共享组织皮层（shared organizational cortex）。在一项注册的检索实验中，Dimension项带来0.028的nDCG@10提升（p = 0.002）。在系统级比较中，完整检索配置的nDCG@10比仅用Signals高出0.081，比图增强的Signals-only检索高出0.053（两者均报告p < 0.001）。该架构为组织提供了持久、可修订的共享判断基础。
translation.brief: 针对现有检索与知识图谱只存记录而丢失组织解释的问题，提出Signals-Domains-Claims-Dimensions四层组合式知识架构，通过真值维护网络持久化并动态修订解释。

papers.title: Mechanical Engineering Skills: An Open Library of Agent Skills for Design, Analysis and Manufacturing
papers.abstract: Mechanical engineers use specialized tools for CAD, simulation, manufacturing and research, each with a distinct interface and learning curve. We present Mechanical Engineering Skills, an open library of 33 agent skills that makes these capabilities accessible through a single text or voice conversation. Each skill combines operating instructions, executable tools and verification procedures. A language model interprets the request, selects and coordinates skills, while deterministic tools perform computations and return checked results. Default workflows require no tool-specific interface training, local model execution or model fine-tuning; skills load on demand and install with one command. Nineteen skills adapt published or preprint research from our laboratory, including text-to-CAD, linkage synthesis, CFD setup, stress-field and lattice surrogates, equation discovery, additive-manufacturing planning and in-process monitoring. Fourteen additional skills support core engineering and education. We describe the skill format, design principles and a method for translating research into practical workflows. Five case studies with explicit evidence scopes and independent reruns demonstrate exact analytical agreement for lattice homogenization, rocket apogee predictions within 4% of stored OpenRocket references, an equation fit nine times more accurate than a cubic polynomial at an unseen temperature, and an end-to-end rehearsal of porosity monitoring. Controlled agent comparisons remain future work. The open library is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Mechanical Engineering Skills：面向设计、分析与制造的开源智能体技能库
translation.abstract: 机械工程师使用CAD、仿真、制造和研究等专业工具，每种工具都有独特的界面和学习曲线。我们提出Mechanical Engineering Skills，这是一个包含33个智能体技能的开源库，通过单一的文本或语音对话即可使用这些能力。每个技能结合了操作说明、可执行工具和验证流程。语言模型负责解释请求、选择和协调技能，而确定性工具执行计算并返回经过校验的结果。默认工作流无需特定工具的界面训练、本地模型执行或模型微调；技能按需加载，一条命令即可安装。其中19个技能改编自我们实验室已发表或预印本的研究，包括文本生成CAD、连杆综合、CFD设置、应力场和点阵代理模型、方程发现、增材制造规划及过程内监测。另有14个技能支持核心工程与教学。我们描述了技能格式、设计原则以及将研究转化为实用工作流的方法。五个具有明确证据范围和独立复跑的案例研究展示了点阵均匀化的精确解析一致性、与存储的OpenRocket参考值误差在4%以内的火箭远地点预测、在未见温度下比三次多项式精确九倍的方程拟合，以及孔隙率监测的端到端演练。受控的智能体对比仍是未来工作。该开源库可在this https URL获取。
translation.brief: 针对机械工程专用工具界面复杂、学习成本高的问题，构建了一个由语言模型调度、确定性工具执行的33个开源智能体技能库，覆盖设计、分析与制造全流程。

papers.title: PAYWORTHY: Can LLMs Predict Which Freelance Jobs an AI Agent Will Complete?
papers.abstract: Before an AI agent takes on a paid job, someone has to judge whether it is likely to succeed. We test whether frontier language models can make this call before any attempt. We propose PAYWORTHY which contains 1{,}494 real freelance job postings, sampled from 18.8M postings made between 2020 and 2026 on a freelancing platform. An agent attempts each job from the posting alone in a single run, and an LLM judge acting as the client decides whether to accept the work. We ask 18 models to forecast how likely the agent is to succeed and measure how well each model's forecasts rank the accepted jobs above the rejected ones (AUC, where 0.5 is a random ranking). The answer depends on how the agent is described. Told what the agent cannot do, every model ranks the jobs well (AUC 0.66--0.86). Told instead that it is a generic agent with a browser and code execution, the same models rank the same jobs about as well as a random ordering (0.45--0.56). These results hold under judges from four other model families (Claude, GLM, Kimi and Qwen), and the informed forecasts also rank the verdicts of two human raters. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: PAYWORTHY：LLM能否预测AI智能体将完成哪些自由职业任务？
translation.abstract: 在AI智能体接下一份付费工作之前，需要有人判断它是否可能成功。我们测试前沿语言模型能否在没有任何尝试之前做出这一判断。我们提出PAYWORTHY，其中包含1,494条真实的自由职业招聘帖，采样自某自由职业平台2020至2026年间的1,880万条帖子。智能体仅凭帖子内容在单次运行中尝试每项任务，由一个充当客户的LLM裁判决定是否接受工作。我们让18个模型预测智能体成功的可能性，并衡量每个模型的预测将已接受任务排在被拒绝任务之上的能力（AUC，0.5为随机排序）。答案取决于如何描述该智能体。当告知模型该智能体不能做什么时，所有模型都能很好地对任务排序（AUC 0.66–0.86）；而当告知它是一个配备浏览器和代码执行的通用智能体时，同样的模型对同样任务的排序接近随机（0.45–0.56）。这些结果在使用来自其他四个模型家族（Claude、GLM、Kimi和Qwen）的裁判时依然成立，且知情预测也能很好地对两位人类评分者的判定进行排序。代码可在this https URL获取。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否在任务执行前预测AI智能体能否完成真实自由职业工作，发现提供智能体能力边界的描述可显著提升预测排序质量，而通用描述则接近随机。

papers.title: BobFlow: Towards Human-Agent Collaborative Data Science Using Dataflows
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have established human-agent collaboration as a promising paradigm for data science. Effective collaboration requires a shared computational abstraction that enables agents to reason about processing logic while allowing human analysts to understand, guide, and refine the analysis. Although scripts written in Python or SQL provide precise control, their syntax and execution details can be difficult for analysts to understand and modify. In this paper, we argue that dataflows are an effective abstraction for human-agent collaboration in data science. We introduce BobFlow, a system that combines the dataflow abstraction with the ReAct paradigm. It enables agents to iteratively construct and execute dataflows for data science tasks while allowing analysts to inspect the analysis and provide feedback. Our user study shows that BobFlow helps analysts understand, inspect, and verify agent-generated analyses. A thorough experimental evaluation across proprietary and open-weight LLMs shows accuracy score gains of up to 18.6 points at just over 1/3 of a script-based ReAct agent's inference cost.

translation.title: BobFlow：基于数据流的人-智能体协作数据科学
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使人与智能体协作成为数据科学中一种有前景的范式。有效的协作需要一个共享的计算抽象，既能让智能体对处理逻辑进行推理，又能让人类分析师理解、引导和改进分析。尽管用 Python 或 SQL 编写的脚本提供了精确的控制，但其语法和执行细节对分析师来说难以理解和修改。本文认为数据流是数据科学中人-智能体协作的有效抽象。我们提出 BobFlow，一个将数据流抽象与 ReAct 范式相结合的系统。它使智能体能够为数据科学任务迭代地构建和执行数据流，同时允许分析师检查分析并提供反馈。我们的用户研究表明，BobFlow 帮助分析师理解、检查和验证智能体生成的分析。在专有和开源权重 LLM 上的全面实验评估显示，准确率得分最高提升 18.6 分，而推理成本仅为基于脚本的 ReAct 智能体的约 1/3。
translation.brief: 针对人-智能体协作中脚本抽象难以被分析师理解和修改的问题，提出将数据流抽象与 ReAct 范式结合的 BobFlow 系统，让智能体迭代构建执行数据流并支持人类检查反馈。

papers.title: How Well Can Large Language Models Impersonate Individual Authors? A Comparative Evaluation
papers.abstract: This study investigates the authorship impersonation capacity of six widely used large language models (LLMs): Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus, GPT 5.2, GPT 5.2 Pro, DeepSeek 3.2, and Grok 4.1 Fast. The evaluation was conducted using short product review texts selected to ensure high within author consistency in individual writing style. Two types of in context prompt were designed: a simple prompt with minimal instruction and a complex prompt incorporating explicit stylometric guidance for mimicry. Authorship mimicry was evaluated using a cosine distance based distance to training metric, supplemented by visual analyses of embedding distributions. The results indicate that authorship impersonation remained challenging for most LLMs, with Gemini 3 Pro showing the strongest apparent mimicry performance. However, subsequent overlap analysis revealed that Gemini 3 Pro extensively copied and reused sentences and phrases from the training texts, at levels far exceeding those observed among human authors. Follow up factor analyses showed that training set consistency was the most robust predictor of mimicry success across models, whereas author distinctiveness did not generalise as a reliable predictor. Global embedding visualisations further revealed a consistent macro level pattern: for most models, generated texts occupied regions of the embedding space that were largely separated from the corresponding human training clusters. This indicates limited convergence towards target author style and suggests the presence of model specific lexical and phraseological preferences. The findings highlight the importance of distinguishing genuine stylistic imitation from direct textual reuse and have implications for the forensic analysis of textual evidence involving potential LLM enabled impersonation.

translation.title: 大语言模型能多好地模仿个体作者？一项对比评估
translation.abstract: 本研究考察了六种广泛使用的大语言模型（LLM）的作者身份模仿能力：Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus、GPT 5.2、GPT 5.2 Pro、DeepSeek 3.2 和 Grok 4.1 Fast。评估使用短产品评论文本，这些文本经过挑选以确保个体写作风格具有高度的作者内一致性。设计了两种上下文提示：仅含最少指令的简单提示，以及包含明确文体计量学模仿指导的复杂提示。作者风格模仿通过基于余弦距离的“到训练集距离”指标进行评估，并辅以嵌入分布的可视化分析。结果表明，对大多数 LLM 而言，作者身份模仿仍然具有挑战性，其中 Gemini 3 Pro 表现出最强的表面模仿性能。然而，后续的重叠分析显示，Gemini 3 Pro 大量复制和复用了训练文本中的句子和短语，其程度远超人类作者之间的水平。后续因子分析表明，训练集一致性是各模型模仿成功最稳健的预测因子，而作者独特性并不能作为可靠的预测因子。全局嵌入可视化进一步揭示了一致的宏观模式：对大多数模型而言，生成文本在嵌入空间中所占的区域与相应的人类训练簇基本分离。这表明向目标作者风格的收敛有限，并暗示存在模型特定的词汇和措辞偏好。这些发现强调了区分真正的风格模仿与直接文本复用的重要性，并对涉及潜在 LLM 辅助冒充的文本证据司法分析具有意义。
translation.brief: 针对评估 LLM 能否模仿个体作者写作风格的问题，用基于余弦距离的指标和嵌入可视化对六个主流模型进行对比评估，并区分真实风格模仿与文本复用。

papers.title: Sublinear Metric Distortion for Matching
papers.abstract: We study metric distortion in one-sided matching. Given $n$ agents and $n$ items in an unknown metric space, our goal is to match agents to items so that the total distance between matched pairs is small. However, instead of direct access to the distances in the metric, we are only given each agent's ranking of the items by distance. What is the smallest worst-case approximation factor (called the distortion) that a mechanism can guarantee in expectation? Despite significant interest over the last decade, the best-known guarantee has been the $O(n)$ distortion of Random Serial Dictatorship since the beginning. We give a matching mechanism with distortion $O(n^{\log_4 3})$, the first sublinear upper bound. The key idea is to use a partial matching derived from a truncated version of either Random Serial Dictatorship or the Probabilistic Serial rule. We then complete this matching using a new, general-purpose cluster completion algorithm that ensures unmatched agents receive nearby items. Along the way, we pin down the optimal distortion of Random Serial Dictatorship and Probabilistic Serial up to logarithmic and constant factors, respectively, and give improved lower bounds for truthful mechanisms.

translation.title: 匹配问题的次线性度量失真
translation.abstract: 我们研究单边匹配中的度量失真问题。给定未知度量空间中的 $n$ 个智能体和 $n$ 个物品，我们的目标是将智能体与物品匹配，使匹配对之间的总距离尽可能小。然而，我们无法直接访问度量中的距离，只能获得每个智能体按距离对物品的排序。一个机制在期望意义上能保证的最小最坏情况近似因子（称为失真）是多少？尽管过去十年受到广泛关注，自始以来最著名的保证一直是随机串行独裁（Random Serial Dictatorship）的 $O(n)$ 失真。我们给出一个失真为 $O(n^{\log_4 3})$ 的匹配机制，这是首个次线性上界。关键思想是使用从随机串行独裁或概率串行（Probabilistic Serial）规则的截断版本导出的部分匹配，然后用一种新的、通用的簇补全算法完成该匹配，确保未匹配的智能体获得附近的物品。在此过程中，我们分别在相差对数因子和常数因子的范围内确定了随机串行独裁和概率串行的最优失真，并给出了真实（truthful）机制的改进下界。
translation.brief: 针对仅基于排序的单边匹配最小化度量失真问题，提出用截断规则生成部分匹配再加簇补全算法的机制，首次给出次线性失真上界。

papers.title: FlyHash for LLM Agent Memory: An Empirical Validation and a New Application
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory stores to retain information across conversations, typically via dense vector embeddings searched with approximate nearest-neighbor methods. The fruit fly's olfactory circuit computes a locality-sensitive hash of sensory input using a strikingly different mechanism - sparse random projection followed by winner-take-all competition - and prior work (Dasgupta et al., 2017) showed this scheme, dubbed FlyHash, preserves neighbor structure better per bit than conventional random-hyperplane hashing (SimHash) on several benchmarks. We apply FlyHash, to our knowledge for the first time, to LLM agent memory retrieval, and ask three questions a practitioner actually needs answered: does the quality advantage hold under a correctly matched-bit protocol (it does, robustly, across 10 seeds and four datasets spanning two modalities, with one specific, previously undocumented comparison pitfall identified and corrected along the way); does that advantage translate into real memory and latency savings, including against the dense-vector indexing (HNSW) practitioners default to today (no: at equal bits FlyHash's codes are larger and slower to compare than SimHash's, and HNSW dominates both hash methods at ordinary scale; a sparse-set comparison we introduce recovers most but not all of a naive latency gap, leaving hashing's practical case narrower and more specific than the quality result alone implies); and does the advantage survive genuine, non-circular agent-memory relevance labels rather than the nearest-neighbor-by-embedding proxy this literature otherwise relies on (it does). We report all three answers precisely, including the two that narrow rather than flatter the headline result, and release our implementation, a working agent-memory demo, and a full account of the methodological pitfalls we found and corrected.

translation.title: 用于 LLM 智能体记忆的 FlyHash：实证验证与新应用
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖外部记忆存储来跨对话保留信息，通常通过稠密向量嵌入配合近似最近邻搜索实现。果蝇的嗅觉回路以一种截然不同的机制计算感官输入的局部敏感哈希——稀疏随机投影后进行胜者通吃竞争——先前的工作（Dasgupta et al., 2017）表明，这种被称为 FlyHash 的方案在若干基准上每比特保留邻域结构的能力优于传统的随机超平面哈希（SimHash）。据我们所知，我们首次将 FlyHash 应用于 LLM 智能体记忆检索，并回答三个实践者真正需要的问题：在正确匹配比特数的协议下，质量优势是否成立（成立，且在 10 个随机种子和跨两种模态的四个数据集上稳健成立，过程中识别并纠正了一个此前未被记录的比较陷阱）；该优势是否能转化为真实的内存和延迟节省，包括与从业者今天默认使用的稠密向量索引（HNSW）相比（不能：在相同比特数下，FlyHash 的编码比 SimHash 更大且比较更慢，而在常规规模下 HNSW 优于两种哈希方法；我们引入的稀疏集合比较方法挽回了一部分但非全部的朴素延迟差距，使哈希的实际适用场景比仅看质量结果所暗示的更窄、更具体）；该优势在真实的、非循环的智能体记忆相关性标注下是否依然存在，而非依赖该文献通常采用的按嵌入最近邻的代理指标（依然存在）。我们精确报告了所有三个答案，包括两个使主要结论收窄而非增光的答案，并发布了我们的实现、一个可运行的智能体记忆演示，以及对所发现并纠正的方法学陷阱的完整说明。
translation.brief: 针对 FlyHash 能否用于 LLM 智能体外部记忆检索的问题，通过严格匹配比特协议、与 SimHash 和 HNSW 的对比及真实相关性标注进行实证验证。

papers.title: DARE: Difficulty Analysis for Repair Enhancement
papers.abstract: LLM-based coding agents are primarily evaluated by their solve rates. However, this metric does not reveal how difficult the solved tasks are or account for differences intask difficulty across benchmarks. Determining the difficulty of individual tasks by repeatedly running multiple agents is costly, while a predicted difficulty score alone provides limited guidance on what support an agent needs. To address these challenges, we propose DARE (Difficulty Analysis for Repair Enhancement), which integrates repair-task difficulty measurement, prediction, feature-group contribution analysis, and task-specific repair support. We define continuous task difficulty as the observed failure rate across multiple coding agents. The DARE difficulty model predicts this difficulty using 151 static features extracted from benchmark artifacts. The framework also analyzes the contributions of seven Repair-Task Feature Groups to identify the characteristics most salient to each task and uses this information to select task-specific agent support. We evaluate DARE on four benchmark partitions comprising 2,594 tasks. The difficulty model's aligned predictions achieve Spearman's $\rho$ = .476-.621 on held-out partitions, and the most salient Feature Groups vary across tasks and benchmarks. Furthermore, coding-agent experiments show improved repair success when support is matched to each task's salient Feature Group. These findings demonstrate that difficulty prediction and interpretation can lead to practical improvements in automated program repair (APR), while also providing a basis for difficulty-stratified agent evaluation, cross-benchmark comparisons, and identifying areas of repair capability that warrant further improvement.

translation.title: DARE：面向修复增强的难度分析
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的编码智能体主要通过解题率来评估。然而，这一指标既不能揭示已解决任务的难度，也无法考虑不同基准之间任务难度的差异。通过反复运行多个智能体来确定单个任务的难度成本高昂，而仅凭预测的难度分数对智能体需要何种支持提供的指导有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 DARE（Difficulty Analysis for Repair Enhancement），它集成了修复任务难度测量、预测、特征组贡献分析和任务特定的修复支持。我们将连续的任务难度定义为多个编码智能体上观察到的失败率。DARE 难度模型使用从基准产物中提取的 151 个静态特征来预测该难度。该框架还分析了七个修复任务特征组的贡献，以识别对每个任务最显著的特征，并利用这些信息选择任务特定的智能体支持。我们在包含 2,594 个任务的四个基准分区上评估 DARE。难度模型的对齐预测在留出分区上达到 Spearman's $\rho$ = .476-.621，且最显著的特征组因任务和基准而异。此外，编码智能体实验表明，当支持与每个任务最显著的特征组匹配时，修复成功率得到提升。这些发现表明，难度预测与解释可以带来自动程序修复（APR）的实用改进，同时为难度分层的智能体评估、跨基准比较以及识别有待改进的修复能力领域提供了基础。
translation.brief: 针对解题率指标无法反映任务难度差异的问题，提出 DARE 框架，用静态特征预测任务难度并据此选择任务特定的智能体修复支持。

papers.title: WayPOP: A Panoramic Open-Set Panoptic Tracking Benchmark
papers.abstract: Holistic perception for autonomous agents requires reliably segmenting and associating scene elements across time and camera views, including objects outside a fixed semantic taxonomy. Existing open-set panoptic benchmarks focus on individual images or views, while panoramic tracking benchmarks assume closed-set taxonomies. Consequently, these benchmarks do not evaluate whether unknown objects can be consistently segmented and tracked across synchronized multi-camera sequences. We introduce WayPOP, a panoramic open-set panoptic tracking benchmark built on real Waymo PVPS sequences augmented with diverse out-of-taxonomy 3D assets from Objaverse. Inserted objects are placed at fixed locations in the 3D scene and rendered using calibrated vehicle-mounted cameras as the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic move, providing temporally and cross-view consistent panoptic annotations and auxiliary LiDAR range observations. WayPOP contains approximately 670 curated assets instantiated as 980 unique unknown-object tracks, yielding 53,452 unknown-object mask annotations across 21,300 camera images. papers.title: GREP: Grounding Generated Room Evaluation in Principles
papers.abstract: Recent LLM-centric advances can generate attractive furnished rooms by selecting and arranging assets. Yet evaluation remains limited to specific perspectives or predefined questions, failing to reflect overall scene quality. To address this pressing need, we introduce GREP. Its core is a focus shift from defining specific questions to establishing a three-tier evaluation philosophy: basic physical validity checks whether a scene obeys physical constraints; visual coherence concerns compatibility in object scale, style, and composition; and, at the highest level, human-use logic requires object arrangements to align with everyday human habits. Guided by these principles, an evaluation agent autonomously and adaptively identifies issues from scene context, gathers evidence, and produces scores and reports. This supports scene-specific issue discovery and reliable judgments. Experiments show that (1) GREP achieves 87% agreement with human majority preferences, substantially outperforming baseline evaluators. (2) GREP reports improve scene quality through refinement, whereas score-only and no-feedback baselines show slight declines. (3) GREP suggests that as planning ability improves, recent models such as GPT-5.6 Sol can move from relying on pipelines and harnesses to challenging their guidance and constraints, but still lack the ability to resolve the resulting conflicts. Stronger models are therefore expected not only to plan well, but also to adapt to external guidance and constraints more flexibly. Project page: this https URL

papers.title: When File Ingestion Misleads Language Models: Measuring and Mitigating Divergences in Office Documents
papers.abstract: Office documents are now routinely uploaded to large language models (LLMs) for processing. However, an LLM does not always see what a human sees, because it typically reads the text that an extractor produces from the document's underlying Office Open XML (OOXML) files. Depending on the implementation, extractors differ in which OOXML parts they read and how they interpret them, so their output can differ from what Office applications display. For example, by slightly shifting the positions of text boxes on a slide, an adversary can swap the order in which the model reads them while the slide looks unchanged. We show that this extraction divergence is an attack surface for LLM applications. In this work, we first measure what an adversary can exploit by analyzing the widely used extractors that LLM applications rely on. By combining static source code analysis with dynamic analysis, we identify 19 OOXML channels where extractors read content a human cannot see and 12 where they drop content a human can. We also find that widely used extractors ignore display formatting and reading order, so even visible content reaches the model in a different form. Building on these findings, we construct five attacks that lead the model to interpret a document differently from a human reviewer, without injecting any instruction. We test the attacks on four major chat assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Microsoft 365 Copilot) and four coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, and GitHub Copilot CLI), and every one of them is misled by at least one attack. Finally, we propose Prism, a lightweight defense that reconstructs the human view from the OOXML specification before passing the text to the model. Prism also generalizes to unseen attack payloads.

papers.title: Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. Across five batch and three sequential settings with two frontier executors, CVD improves allocation through joint and continuation-aware value learning, while independent consultation values remain competitive in several settings. CVD also broadly outperforms direct prompting and Value of Information where applicable, remains robust with substantially less rollout supervision, and enables nearly lossless approximate allocation at low search cost.

papers.title: A Hybrid Approach for Automated Security Pattern Recovery
papers.abstract: Security-by-design emphasises integrating security into software design and development. Security pattern catalogues operationalise this principle by prescribing reusable architectural solutions to recurring security problems. However, recovering their implementations from source code remains challenging because security patterns are abstract, span multiple components, and admit many valid implementations. We present SecPatRec, a hybrid approach for automated security pattern recovery from source code repositories. We treat a security pattern as a reference architecture and frame its recovery as a deductive task: determining which prescribed roles are present, grounding them in code entities, and recovering their interaction sequences. SecPatRec pairs a ReAct-style LLM agent equipped with semantic and lexical code search for role detection and grounding with static code property graph analysis for interaction recovery. We curate a human-validated ground-truth dataset of 100 pattern instances covering five security patterns across 93 open-source Java and Python repositories, and introduce a three-level evaluation framework measuring recovery correctness against this ground truth. We evaluate SecPatRec using four LLMs, including proprietary and open-source models. Averaged over all models and pattern instances, SecPatRec achieves role-detection accuracy of 0.84, role-grounding similarity of 0.84, and an interaction-recovery score of 0.66. Compared to a one-shot end-to-end LLM baseline, SecPatRec achieves higher aggregate recovery scores and lower estimated LLM API costs per run, while processing repositories that exceed the baseline's configured input limit. The recovered role mappings and statically derived interaction sequences provide structural and behavioural evidence that can support inspection of security-pattern implementations.

papers.title: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Native decision models remain close to chance in optimality verification. Paired tests reveal that some report better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already present. These findings show that team-plan decision accuracy alone can conceal systematic errors in judging whether the supplied options contain an optimal arrangement. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at this https URL.

papers.title: Autonomy and Coordination in Intelligent Manufacturing: A Recursive Autonomous Agent Framework
papers.abstract: Intelligent production requires systems to make decisions and organize work according to production goals and operating conditions. It also requires continuous adjustment through feedback. This paper analyzes intelligence in human production organizations from a complex adaptive systems (CAS) perspective. The analysis identifies two coupled mechanisms: individual autonomy and collective coordination. Individual autonomy enables actors to form local decisions using available information. Collective coordination aligns these decisions with shared goals and joint constraints. Learning and adaptation improve both mechanisms over time. A production-system model formalizes how local decision rules and coordination jointly form system decisions. On this basis, we propose the Recursive Autonomous Agent (RAA) framework, which combines goal-driven autonomous agents with a recursive organizational structure. Goal contracts define local objectives and operating boundaries, while capability contracts support the selection and composition of production units. Common interfaces allow coordinated groups to participate as units in larger organizations, connecting equipment, production lines, and factories. RAA thus provides an engineering approach to next-generation intelligent manufacturing, translating the requirements of intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration into mechanisms for autonomous and coordinated production.

papers.title: Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning
papers.abstract: Firms using large language models under fixed budgets must decide which model to call and whether to retry a failed task. Because a call's charge is revealed only after completion, one long response can exhaust the remaining budget and leave later tasks unserved. Our objective is to maximize the number of tasks solved before service stops. We develop a contextual bandit policy, ADP-HT, which learns each model's task-specific success probability and constructs conservative cost estimates from coarsened response-length labels on a quantile grid with $2^K$ intervals. The policy weighs predicted success against these costs, adjusting the cost penalty to realized spending and the budget available per remaining task. Under calibration, local regularity, and grid-coverage conditions, we bound the excess allowance in the policy's conservative cost estimates. At a fixed sample size, increasing $K$ reduces the discretization term but increases the estimation allowance. At the tightest tested budgets, ADP-HT solves more than twice as many MATH500 and GPQA tasks as the best implemented baseline. It achieves the highest mean cumulative score at ten of fourteen RouterBench budgets. On LiveCodeBench, it outperforms a deployed commercial router in both default and cost-saving modes at the three lowest test budgets.

papers.title: Vision Paper: Why Distributed LLM Post-Training and Decentralized Alignment Are Now Essential
papers.abstract: This vision paper argues that distributed learning, including federated and decentralized, should become a first-class paradigm in LLM post-training, not merely a privacy add-on. Current methods like RLHF and DPO rest on an invisible assumption: preference data should be centralized. We contend this assumption is scientifically unjustified, practically unsustainable, and ethically problematic. As LLMs deploy into healthcare, law, finance, and multilingual communities, preference data originates from populations that cannot or will not centralize. We develop a three-pillar argument grounded in (1) privacy and data sovereignty, (2) pluralism and representational equity, and (3) robustness and scalability. We formalize key technical challenges unique to this intersection, reference drift, preference heterogeneity, and the DP-utility trade-off for contrastive losses, and propose concrete algorithmic directions, and sketch a research agenda. Our analysis shows distributed post-training is not only necessary but tractable, and ignoring it risks AI that is legally noncompliant, representationally narrow, and brittle at scale.

papers.title: PEARL: Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning for Selective Forgetting under Partial Preference Drift
papers.abstract: User preferences shift as needs, context, and tastes evolve. This matters for personalized recommendation, LLM response generation, and RLHF-trained reward models, which can become miscalibrated as preferences drift. Existing non-stationary bandit methods forget uniformly across all dimensions, but real preference shifts are typically partial: some dimensions go stale while others remain valid. Neural contextual bandits accumulate confidence monotonically via the Gram matrix, with no mechanism to direct uncertainty where predictions have gone wrong. We propose PEARL (Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning), which reverses the Gram update along feature directions where predictions are surprisingly wrong, while leaving confidence intact elsewhere. We prove that (i) any non-adaptive policy suffers linear regret after a preference shift, (ii) no fixed exploration rate achieves low regret in both stationary and non-stationary regimes, and (iii) PEARL's cumulative regret scales with the number of shifted users N_s, not the total population N. On PRISM, a personalized LLM response selection benchmark (1,500 users, 21 LLMs), PEARL beats greedy by +4.0 points and the best neural bandit baseline by +2.5 points (p<0.001), while performing on par with greedy when preferences are stable. It beats sliding-window and discounted approaches by 3 to 10 points, showing that selective forgetting outperforms uniform forgetting. The selection policy is a ~100K-parameter MLP that runs in milliseconds on CPU, leaves LLM weights frozen, and works with any API-based model.

papers.title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at this https URL.

papers.title: Auditable Unlearning for LLMs
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove a user's data from a trained model after a deletion request. Existing methods are majorly evaluated on three axes - how well they forget, how much capability they retain, and how robust they are to membership inference attacks, but not on whether the provider can offer the user any evidence that the deletion occurred. To fill this gap, we introduce auditability as a fourth axis, defined as the separation between requested (forget set) and retained (retain set) data under a statistic the provider computes. We show that across eleven unlearning methods on TOFU, MUSE and RWKU no method satisfies all four axes, with different methods falling short on different axes. To address this, we propose a two stage method that can be used on top of any unlearning method, in the the first stage we propose ${GapWiden}$ which uses a hinge loss to increase the difference between audit statistics of forget set and retain set. In the second stage we propose ${GapVeil}$, an inference time rejection-sampler which uses the base model as the drafter and re-samples based on the audit statistics of the drafted response. We observe that using our method, auditability and leakage reach oracle parity for every unlearning method, and forget performance converges to the oracle; retain performance improves for nine of eleven methods but remains short of parity. Our results show that evidence of deletion or auditability can be constructed by design, and that treating it as an explicit requirement changes the viability of existing unlearning methods.

papers.title: The Invocation Bottleneck in LLM-Based Lossless Compression: What Can Be Removed and What Must Be Traded
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) compress text far better than classical compressors, but LLM-based compressors are slow, particularly during decompression. We argue that their decoding time has two fundamentally different sources. Execution redundancy, such as per-token host transfers, CPU-side coding, and token-by-token encoding, is work that the coded output does not require and can be removed without changing a single output bit. Sequential dependency, one model call per decoded token, is inherent to lossless decoding and cannot be removed by better execution, only traded for more calls or for more bits. We remove execution redundancy with a GPU-resident pipeline whose block-parallel encoding is made lossless in half precision by batch-invariant kernels, speeding up arithmetic coding by up to 5.8x in encoding and 3.0x in decoding without changing its compression rate. We then study the two ways of trading sequential dependency, speculative dual-model coding (SDMC) and multi-token single-model coding (MSMC), characterize the compression cost of predicting several tokens from a shared prefix, and identify the workloads in which fewer model calls are worth that cost.

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
papers.abstract: Repeated mobile GUI tests can reuse routes, locators, and recovery strategies from earlier executions. However, a route that worked in one workflow or app version may be irrelevant or misleading in another. We study how an LLM-based tester can retain useful experience while withholding entries contradicted by current observations. We present a maintenance contract for AdaptiTest in which reusable experience has an explicit applicability scope, trace provenance, and a lifecycle for confirmation, revalidation, and withdrawal. The contract reserves persistence for a Reflector role and treats recalled experience as advice. The archived implementation does not establish end-to-end enforcement of every specified mechanism. The design changes retrieved context, not model weights. The evaluation uses read-only Android workflows and archived internal comparisons. A six-task, three-repeat ready subset reports 18/18 completed runs with memory versus 3/18 without it, but a grounded single-agent control also solves the earlier hard-task slice. A separate cross-session probe is excluded from efficacy conclusions because of confounded route schedules and unvalidated state labels. We examine 13 selected real-update hazard records across nine subjects, distinguishing stale-locator observations from policy-based withholding and offline retrieval diagnostics. The latter do not measure live-device failures or actions saved. These events are UI changes, not confirmed regression bugs. The evidence supports a bounded design and case study; it does not establish general efficacy, superiority over independent GUI-agent systems, or unrestricted exploration.

papers.title: When Does Better Confidence Improve a Knowledge-Graph Audit?
papers.abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass $\Delta^{\mathrm{cl}}$. We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate $\times$ fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. By comparison, opening shared actions for that joint planner reduces residual errors by 0.89-1.43 points relative to its own fact-only plans, in point estimates. Equivalence between joint and independent-block models remains inconclusive. Generic LLM verification improves three of four model-budget configurations on each held-out set. LLM adjudication identifies possible benchmark omissions.
