papers.title: Retrieval Supersedes Scale: Efficient Log Level Prediction via Multiplex Socio-Technical Context
papers.abstract: Developers insert logging statements in source code to record its execution, and the resulting logs are essential for detecting and troubleshooting system anomalies. A key part of these statements is the log level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR), which determines whether a message is recorded. Choosing it is a trade-off: levels set too low mask important information in production, while levels set too high create noisy logs and extra I/O and storage overhead. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) with In-Context Learning (ICL) to predict log levels, but typically augments the prompt with randomly sampled examples. We argue that this overlooks the socio-technical nature of logging, where conventions vary by component and development team. Off-the-shelf LLMs using random examples are reported to achieve median AUCs of only 0.56 to 0.76, leaving room for improvement without fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose a retrieval approach for LLM-powered log level prediction that prioritizes context relevance over random selection and basic similarity. Our method retrieves logging examples relevant along two socio-technical dimensions: (i) functionality (code performing similar operations) and (ii) ownership (code maintained by the same developers). Evaluating four LLMs across ten popular Java projects, we find that this retrieval improves AUC over random baselines by 0.07 (median), and combining both signals yields median AUCs of 0.83 to 0.97. Our ablation studies show that each signal improves on random retrieval, and that combining them outperforms the stronger of the two on all ten projects. Our results also significantly exceed state-of-the-art supervised predictors (e.g., DeepLV) by a median AUC of 0.12 to 0.19. Our findings highlight the importance of socio-technical signals such as code functionality and ownership for LLM-powered log level prediction.

translation.title: 检索胜过规模：基于多重社会技术上下文的高效日志级别预测
translation.abstract: 开发者在源代码中插入日志语句以记录程序执行，由此产生的日志对于检测和排查系统异常至关重要。这些语句的关键部分是日志级别（如 DEBUG、INFO、WARN、ERROR），它决定消息是否被记录。选择日志级别是一种权衡：级别设置过低会在生产环境中掩盖重要信息，而设置过高则会产生嘈杂的日志以及额外的 I/O 和存储开销。近期工作使用大语言模型（LLM）结合上下文学习（ICL）来预测日志级别，但通常在提示中加入随机采样的示例。我们认为这忽视了日志编写的社会技术属性，即其惯例因组件和开发团队而异。据报道，使用随机示例的现成 LLM 仅能达到 0.56 至 0.76 的中位 AUC，说明无需微调仍有改进空间。本文提出一种面向 LLM 日志级别预测的检索方法，优先考虑上下文相关性而非随机选择和基础相似度。我们的方法沿两个社会技术维度检索相关的日志示例：(i) 功能性（执行相似操作的代码）和 (ii) 所有权（由相同开发者维护的代码）。在十个流行 Java 项目上评估四个 LLM，我们发现这种检索相比随机基线将 AUC 提升了 0.07（中位数），结合两种信号可获得 0.83 至 0.97 的中位 AUC。消融实验表明每个信号都优于随机检索，且两者结合在全部十个项目上都优于其中更强的单一信号。我们的结果还显著超越最先进的监督式预测器（如 DeepLV），中位 AUC 提升 0.12 至 0.19。我们的发现凸显了代码功能性和所有权等社会技术信号对 LLM 日志级别预测的重要性。
translation.brief: 针对LLM用随机示例预测日志级别效果不佳的问题，提出沿功能性和代码所有权两个社会技术维度检索相关日志示例的方法。

papers.title: CHARM+: Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism
papers.abstract: As sequence lengths continue to grow, distributed attention based on sequence parallel (e.g., Ring-Attention) has become a mainstream solution for large language models (LLMs). Nevertheless, inherent communication dependencies limit computation-communication overlap, reducing GPU utilization. Moreover, in cross-hardware (NUMA or node) architectures, due to imbalanced communication bandwidth, frequent communication synchronization will limit overall performance. Based on these insights, we propose CHARM+, Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism. We reorganize sequential communications into several levels and achieve intra-level parallelism and computation overlap. Furthermore, we decouple cross-hardware communication from intra-hardware communication, eliminating synchronization overhead caused by bandwidth imbalance. Forward and backward algorithms were evaluated on multiple hardware architectures and consistently outperformed state-of-the-art methods. Compared to Ring-Attention, our forward and backward algorithms achieve average speedups of 1.3x and 1.7x on a dual-NUMA PCIe architecture, and 2.8x and 2.9x on a dual-node NVLink architecture, respectively.

translation.title: CHARM+：带重合并多流机制的跨硬件注意力
translation.abstract: 随着序列长度不断增长，基于序列并行的分布式注意力（如 Ring-Attention）已成为大语言模型（LLM）的主流解决方案。然而，固有的通信依赖限制了计算与通信的重叠，降低了 GPU 利用率。此外，在跨硬件（NUMA 或跨节点）架构中，由于通信带宽不均衡，频繁的通信同步会限制整体性能。基于这些洞察，我们提出 CHARM+，一种带重合并多流机制的跨硬件注意力。我们将顺序通信重组为多个层级，实现层级内并行与计算重叠。此外，我们将跨硬件通信与硬件内通信解耦，消除了带宽不均衡导致的同步开销。前向和反向算法在多种硬件架构上进行了评估，并始终优于最先进的方法。与 Ring-Attention 相比，我们的前向和反向算法在双 NUMA PCIe 架构上分别取得平均 1.3 倍和 1.7 倍的加速，在双节点 NVLink 架构上分别取得 2.8 倍和 2.9 倍的加速。
translation.brief: 针对序列并行注意力中通信依赖限制计算重叠及跨硬件带宽不均衡的问题，提出将通信分层重组并解耦跨硬件与硬件内通信的 CHARM+ 机制。

papers.title: Optimal Re-Ranking Depth
papers.abstract: Second-stage neural rankers are commonly applied with a fixed re-ranking depth, assuming that retrieval effectiveness saturates as depth increases. Prior research has questioned the assumption that increasing the re-ranking depth yields linear performance gains, further suggesting that optimal re-ranking depth varies considerably from query to query. In the past, studying such phenomena was methodologically difficult given the scale of manual annotation required. With the advent of LLM-based relevance judgments we can now more easily undertake such studies, in this case to pinpoint the optimal re-ranking depth on a per-query basis. Using dense LLM-based relevance judgments over a typical re-ranking pipeline, we show that many queries exhibit a well-defined optimal re-ranking depth, beyond which effectiveness stagnates or degrades. We formulate re-ranking depth as a query-specific property and study whether it can be predicted a priori from first-stage retrieval characteristics. Through a large-scale analysis, we find that most standard query performance prediction (QPP) methods are ineffective for this task. In contrast, a predictor derived from LLM-assessed first-stage ranking quality, which we term IR-DCG@10, can reduce the average re-ranking depth by up to a factor of 3 while preserving overall effectiveness, depending on the specific first- and second-stage rankers used. Under oracle selection of optimal depths, we further show that retrieval effectiveness can improve by more than 7% while reducing the average re-ranking depth by a factor of 5 on the MSMARCO DEV collection. Given our promising preliminary findings, we would encourage the use of automatic judgments to facilitate research otherwise infeasible under manual annotation. Towards this point, we release relevance judgments, our codebase, and experimental artefacts to support reproducibility and further research.

translation.title: 最优重排序深度
translation.abstract: 第二阶段神经排序器通常以固定的重排序深度应用，假设检索效果随深度增加而饱和。先前研究已质疑增加重排序深度能带来线性性能提升的假设，并进一步指出最优重排序深度因查询而异。过去，由于所需人工标注的规模，研究此类现象在方法上很困难。随着基于 LLM 的相关性判断的出现，我们现在可以更容易地开展此类研究，在本例中即逐查询地确定最优重排序深度。通过在典型重排序流水线上使用密集的基于 LLM 的相关性判断，我们表明许多查询存在明确的最优重排序深度，超过该深度后效果停滞或下降。我们将重排序深度表述为查询特定属性，并研究能否从第一阶段检索特征中先验地预测它。通过大规模分析，我们发现大多数标准的查询性能预测（QPP）方法对此任务无效。相比之下，一种由 LLM 评估的第一阶段排序质量导出的预测器（我们称之为 IR-DCG@10）可将平均重排序深度最多降低至原来的 1/3，同时保持整体效果，具体取决于所用的第一和第二阶段排序器。在最优深度的 oracle 选择下，我们进一步表明在 MSMARCO DEV 集合上检索效果可提升超过 7%，同时平均重排序深度降低至原来的 1/5。鉴于这些有前景的初步发现，我们鼓励使用自动判断来促进在人工标注下不可行的研究。为此，我们发布了相关性判断、代码库和实验产物，以支持可复现性和后续研究。
translation.brief: 针对重排序深度应因查询而异的问题，利用LLM相关性判断研究逐查询最优深度，并提出基于第一阶段排序质量（IR-DCG@10）的预测器来自适应降低重排序深度。

papers.title: Autonomous agents for electricity-system planning
papers.abstract: Planning electricity systems requires repeated decisions that connect regional resources, investment, operation and network constraints. Here we present an autonomous planning framework that carries prepared regional scenarios through proposal, numerical evaluation, feedback interpretation, redesign and final plan selection. Agents propose investment bounds, storage operating conditions and feeder interventions, interpret numerical feedback, and decide how to revise designs and when to stop. The framework automatically executes annual investment-and-dispatch optimization and representative-feeder verification, applies fixed acceptance criteria and retains the lowest-cost accepted candidate. We evaluate forty carbon-constrained trajectories across ten system-year scenarios in five electricity systems and four countries, using two model deployments and single- and multi-agent architectures. All forty retain candidates satisfying the implemented physical and fixed annual operational carbon-budget checks. Twenty-eight of forty matched reference designs exceed the new scenario ceilings. A separate archive of ninety-six trajectories under a common 1,000 Mt annual ceiling provides matched references and broader regional coverage. The results demonstrate autonomous planning under explicit emissions constraints using public regional data and published institutional demand outlooks.

translation.title: 用于电力系统规划的自主智能体
translation.abstract: 电力系统规划需要反复做出连接区域资源、投资、运行和网络约束的决策。我们提出一个自主规划框架，将准备好的区域场景依次经过提案、数值评估、反馈解读、重新设计和最终方案选择。智能体提出投资边界、储能运行条件和馈线干预措施，解读数值反馈，并决定如何修改设计以及何时停止。该框架自动执行年度投资与调度优化以及代表性馈线验证，应用固定的接受准则并保留成本最低的可行候选方案。我们在五个电力系统、四个国家中，使用两种模型部署以及单智能体和多智能体架构，评估了十个系统年场景下的四十条碳约束轨迹。全部四十条轨迹保留的候选方案均满足所实施的物理约束和固定年度运行碳预算检查。四十个匹配参考设计中有二十八个超过了新场景的上限。另一个在共同 1,000 Mt 年度上限下的九十六条轨迹档案提供了匹配参考和更广的区域覆盖。结果表明，利用公开区域数据和已发布的机构需求展望，可以在明确的排放约束下实现自主规划。
translation.brief: 针对电力系统规划中反复决策的问题，提出由智能体自主完成提案、评估、反馈与迭代设计的规划框架，并自动执行投资调度优化与验证。

papers.title: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $\kappa$, together with an effective counterpart $\kappa_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce \emph{reward budgeting}, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. For binary rewards and independent on-policy rollouts, its unclipped score-function estimator follows the gradient of an exact finite-$G$ concave objective with diminishing returns, while its advantage gap decreases as more rollouts become correct. For general rewards, a shifted log-mean interpretation holds asymptotically under the stated regularity conditions. These results motivate, rather than establish exact objective equivalence for, the clipped implementations. On Qwen3-8B and Llama3.2-3B-Instruct, reward budgeting consistently improves a range of RL baselines, with gains up to +12.50 on AMC23 and +10.00 on AIME24 and AIME25. Overall, our results support an update-dynamics view of premature convergence and show that strong gains can be obtained without explicitly preserving entropy.

translation.title: 奖励预算化减少LLM推理强化学习中的过早收敛
translation.abstract: 用于 LLM 推理的强化学习常常随着策略分布日益尖锐而较早达到性能平台期。近期工作将策略熵作为这种行为诊断和控制信号加以研究。然而在我们的实验中，仅提高熵并不能可靠地改变最终的平台期。我们通过 RL 的隐式目标策略进行分析，推导出锐度因子 $\kappa$ 及其有效对应量 $\kappa_{\mathrm{eff}}$，用以描述奖励或优势差距被转化为概率比差距的强度。受此视角启发，我们引入奖励预算化（reward budgeting），一种为每个提示分配固定总奖励预算的即插即用优势构造方法。对于二元奖励和独立的同策略 rollout，其未截断的得分函数估计器精确遵循一个具有边际收益递减的有限-$G$ 凹目标的梯度，同时其优势差距随着更多 rollout 变为正确而减小。对于一般奖励，在所述正则性条件下，其平移对数均值解释渐近成立。这些结果为截断实现提供了动机，而非确立精确的目标等价性。在 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama3.2-3B-Instruct 上，奖励预算化持续改进一系列 RL 基线，在 AMC23 上提升高达 +12.50，在 AIME24 和 AIME25 上提升 +10.00。总体而言，我们的结果支持对过早收敛的更新动力学视角，并表明无需显式保留熵即可获得显著收益。
translation.brief: 针对LLM推理RL过早收敛到性能平台期的问题，通过隐式目标策略分析提出为每个提示分配固定奖励预算的优势构造方法 reward budgeting。

papers.title: Graph-Mediated Large Language Model Systems in the Agentic Era: Reasoning, Knowledge, Retrieval, Execution, and Coordination
papers.abstract: Graphs play an increasingly important role in large language model (LLM) systems, supporting structural reasoning, knowledge grounding, retrieval, and memory. As these systems evolve toward the agentic era, graphs also organize execution dependencies and multi-agent communication, linking intermediate observations and retained information to subsequent decisions. However, understanding their contribution requires distinguishing the function of each graph operation, the component responsible for its computation, and the subsequent use of its output. This survey introduces an operation-level role--locus taxonomy for reasoning, knowledge and evidence, retrieval and memory, execution, and coordination. We compare how graph observations and external computations guide decisions, how memory representations and updates support later tasks, and how dependencies constrain execution and information delivery. These comparisons distinguish improvements in local metrics from downstream task performance while retaining the conditions under which results were reported. We then organize benchmarks, comparison designs, process diagnostics, and system costs into an evaluation framework. Finally, we identify open challenges in adaptive computation and stopping, memory maintenance, and dependency-aware recovery. The survey provides a basis for assessing when graph mechanisms are useful and for evaluating their effects across components and stages.

translation.title: Agentic时代中图介导的大语言模型系统：推理、知识、检索、执行与协调
translation.abstract: 图在大语言模型（LLM）系统中扮演着日益重要的角色，支持结构化推理、知识接地、检索与记忆。随着这些系统向agentic时代演进，图还用于组织执行依赖关系和多智能体通信，将中间观察结果和保留的信息与后续决策相连接。然而，要理解图的贡献，需要区分每个图操作的功能、负责其计算的组件以及其输出的后续使用方式。本综述提出了一种操作层面的角色—位置（role–locus）分类法，涵盖推理、知识与证据、检索与记忆、执行和协调。我们比较了图观察和外部计算如何引导决策、记忆表示和更新如何支持后续任务，以及依赖关系如何约束执行和信息传递。这些比较在保留结果报告条件的同时，区分了局部指标的改进与下游任务性能。随后，我们将基准测试、比较设计、过程诊断和系统成本组织成一个评估框架。最后，我们指出了自适应计算与停止、记忆维护以及依赖感知恢复方面的开放挑战。本综述为评估图机制何时有用以及跨组件和阶段评估其效果提供了基础。
translation.brief: 针对图机制在LLM系统中贡献难以厘清的问题，提出操作层面的角色—位置分类法与评估框架来系统分析图在推理、知识、检索、执行和协调中的作用。

papers.title: InterSim: Innovative Intersection Digital Twins for Human-in-the-Loop Driving Simulation
papers.abstract: Innovative intersection designs can improve roadway safety and operational efficiency, but their uncommon geometries may create challenges for driver comprehension during early deployment. Evaluating these designs through full-scale field implementation can also be costly. This paper presents InterSim, a Unity game engine-based human-in-the-loop (HITL) driving simulator that constructs digital twins of site-specific innovative intersections in a virtual environment. InterSim links the real world and the simulation world through two closed cycles: a digital twin cycle that builds each intersection twin from agency design and traffic data and returns evidence from simulation to the agency, and an HITL cycle in which human drivers or automated driving algorithms operate the ego vehicle under identical scenario conditions. The research capabilities of InterSim are demonstrated through two case studies: a surrogate safety study compares post-encroachment time distributions between a Reduced Conflict Intersection and a standard intersection under different traffic volumes; an eco-driving study compares human drivers with a rule-based agent using vehicle-to-infrastructure information and reveals differences in emission and driving behavior. These studies demonstrate that InterSim provides a reusable digital twin platform for investigating innovative intersection designs from diverse perspectives. Demo video and open-source code can be accessed at this https URL

translation.title: InterSim：面向人在环路驾驶仿真的创新交叉口数字孪生
translation.abstract: 创新性交叉口设计可以提升道路安全性和运行效率，但其不常见的几何形状可能在早期部署阶段给驾驶员理解带来挑战。通过全尺寸实地实施来评估这些设计的成本也很高。本文提出InterSim，一个基于Unity游戏引擎的人在环路（HITL）驾驶模拟器，在虚拟环境中构建特定地点创新交叉口的数字孪生。InterSim通过两个闭环连接真实世界与仿真世界：数字孪生循环基于管理机构的设计和交通数据构建每个交叉口孪生体，并将仿真证据反馈给管理机构；HITL循环中，人类驾驶员或自动驾驶算法在相同的场景条件下操纵自车。InterSim的研究能力通过两个案例研究得到展示：一项替代安全研究比较了Reduced Conflict Intersection与标准交叉口在不同交通量下的侵入后时间分布；一项生态驾驶研究比较了人类驾驶员与使用车路信息（V2I）的基于规则智能体，揭示了排放和驾驶行为的差异。这些研究表明，InterSim提供了一个可复用的数字孪生平台，可从多角度研究创新交叉口设计。演示视频和开源代码可通过此https URL获取。
translation.brief: 针对创新交叉口设计难以低成本评估的问题，构建基于Unity的人在环路驾驶模拟器，通过数字孪生与HITL双闭环连接现实与仿真。

papers.title: Enforcing Accountable Disclosure in Confidential AI
papers.abstract: Advances in CPU and GPU confidential computing enable confidential AI, allowing LLMs to process user prompts without exposing them to service providers or infrastructure operators. However, AI agents often need to send prompt-derived information to external services, and providers may also require limited disclosure for safety monitoring and failure diagnosis. We propose CORDE, a system for confidential virtual machines (CVMs) designed to satisfy the principle of Confine or Declare: user-derived data is confined by default, but when necessary, it may leave the CVM only after being "declared." To "declare" data is to record its exact contents, recipient, and stated reason in a user-accessible, tamper-evident declaration log. To put this principle into practice, we present an integrated system design that combines per-user information-flow control in Rust with a TEE-based ledger and remote attestation. Our evaluation on an NVIDIA H100 GPU shows that declaration before disclosure adds little overhead in task latency, about 0.5% on the AppWorld agent benchmark. CORDE provides a basis for accountable disclosure of user data, supporting responsible and transparent data management in AI services.

translation.title: 在机密AI中实施可问责披露
translation.abstract: CPU和GPU机密计算的进步使机密AI成为可能，允许LLM在不向服务提供商或基础设施运营者暴露用户提示的情况下处理它们。然而，AI智能体常常需要向外部服务发送由提示衍生的信息，提供商也可能出于安全监控和故障诊断需要有限的披露。我们提出CORDE，一个面向机密虚拟机（CVM）的系统，旨在满足“限制或声明”（Confine or Declare）原则：用户衍生数据默认被限制在CVM内，但必要时，只有在被“声明”之后才能离开CVM。“声明”数据是指将其确切内容、接收方和所述理由记录在用户可访问、防篡改的声明日志中。为将该原则付诸实践，我们提出了一个集成系统设计，将Rust中基于每用户的信息流控制与基于TEE的账本和远程证明相结合。我们在NVIDIA H100 GPU上的评估表明，披露前的声明在任务延迟上增加的开销很小，在AppWorld智能体基准上约为0.5%。CORDE为用户数据的可问责披露提供了基础，支持AI服务中负责任且透明的数据管理。
translation.brief: 针对机密AI中用户数据外泄缺乏问责的问题，提出CORDE系统，通过“限制或声明”原则结合信息流控制与TEE账本实现可审计的数据披露。

papers.title: A Controlled Experimental Evaluation of Configuration and Cache Architecture in LLM Serving Engines
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM applications repeat most of their prompt tokens across requests, and serving engines reuse the cached state of shared prefixes. vLLM and SGLang reuse it at different granularities, and benchmarks of their default deployments report large performance gaps, usually credited to the cache. Such comparisons rarely control for other configuration differences. One of them, whether a long prompt is prefilled in chunks, is set by each engine's defaults from the hardware and the release, and it confounds the comparison. We built a reproducible testbed on Kubernetes and a seeded multi-agent workload generator, and compared the two engines under vendor defaults and with chunked prefill matched. SGLang's configuration is the same in both arms, which makes it an internal control across independently provisioned deployments. Under defaults, vLLM's median time to first token is up to 64x SGLang's. Matching one setting removes 78% of the capacity gap where that gap is largest and 30 to 67% of the latency gap. Near saturation the remaining latency gap reflects queue growth. A fluid queue model driven only by a 4.4% throughput shortfall reproduces it, and shows that such a gap scales with the length of the benchmark run. What survives matching is a tail-latency advantage of 2.4 to 6.4x at equal throughput, consistent with cache-aware ordering of waiting requests. We derive six recommendations for comparing serving engines.

translation.title: LLM服务引擎中配置与缓存架构的受控实验评估
translation.abstract: 多智能体LLM应用在请求之间重复大部分提示token，服务引擎会重用共享前缀的缓存状态。vLLM和SGLang以不同粒度重用缓存，其默认部署的基准测试报告了巨大的性能差距，通常归因于缓存。此类比较很少控制其他配置差异。其中一个差异是长提示是否分块prefill，它由各引擎根据硬件和发布版本设定的默认值决定，从而混淆了比较。我们构建了一个基于Kubernetes的可复现测试平台和一个带种子的多智能体工作负载生成器，在厂商默认设置和匹配分块prefill两种条件下比较了两个引擎。SGLang的配置在两种条件下相同，使其成为跨独立部署的内部对照。在默认设置下，vLLM的首token中位时间最高达SGLang的64倍。匹配一项设置即可消除最大容量差距的78%和延迟差距的30%至67%。接近饱和时，剩余的延迟差距反映了队列增长。一个仅由4.4%吞吐量差距驱动的流体队列模型即可复现该差距，并表明这种差距随基准运行时长而扩大。匹配后仍然存在的是同等吞吐量下2.4至6.4倍的尾延迟优势，这与基于缓存的等待请求排序一致。我们提出了比较服务引擎的六条建议。
translation.brief: 针对vLLM与SGLang性能比较中配置差异混淆结论的问题，构建可复现测试平台并匹配分块prefill设置进行受控实验，分离缓存架构的真实影响。

papers.title: Clips2Story: Training-Free Video Storyboarding and Editing Using Multimodal Retrieval-Embedded Generation
papers.abstract: Video editors often work with large collections of fragmented footage and must select and organize relevant clips into a coherent story. However, many existing video editing and summarization methods assume a temporally ordered source video and aim to preserve its original narrative and temporal structure. In this paper, we introduce Clips2Story, a training-free, LLM-based pipeline that enables users to create keyword-specified short videos from a pool of video clips. Given a pool of clips and a user-specified keyword, we first extract text-based multimodal descriptors for each clip and retrieve the clips most relevant to the keyword. We then provide the textual descriptors of these candidate clips to an LLM, which selects and arranges them into an editable storyboard with connective narrations. Finally, we assemble the selected clips and retrieve accompanying visuals for the narrations to compose the output video. To evaluate the proposed pipeline, we construct a synthetic evaluation dataset from 100 long-form videos across five genres by segmenting each video into short clips using a scene-change detection model and shuffling the resulting clips to remove their temporal order. Through objective evaluation and qualitative examples, we demonstrate that Clips2Story can effectively retrieve keyword-relevant clips and compose coherent storyboards based on user-specified keywords. Human evaluation further shows that Clips2Story outperforms a strong baseline in terms of narrative coherence, keyword alignment, and overall realism.

translation.title: Clips2Story：基于多模态检索嵌入生成的免训练视频故事板与编辑
translation.abstract: 视频编辑者常常面对大量碎片化素材，需要选择并组织相关片段成一个连贯的故事。然而，许多现有的视频编辑和摘要方法假设源视频在时间上是有序的，并旨在保留其原始叙事和时间结构。本文提出Clips2Story，一个免训练的、基于LLM的流水线，使用户能够从视频片段池中创建指定关键词的短视频。给定片段池和用户指定的关键词，我们首先为每个片段提取基于文本的多模态描述符，并检索与关键词最相关的片段。然后，我们将这些候选片段的文本描述符提供给LLM，由其选择并排列它们，形成带有连接性旁白的可编辑故事板。最后，我们组装所选片段，并为旁白检索配套的视觉内容以合成输出视频。为评估该流水线，我们从五个类型的100个长视频构建了一个合成评估数据集，使用场景切换检测模型将每个视频分割为短片段，并打乱所得片段以去除其时间顺序。通过客观评估和定性示例，我们证明Clips2Story能够有效检索与关键词相关的片段，并根据用户指定的关键词构建连贯的故事板。人类评估进一步表明，Clips2Story在叙事连贯性、关键词对齐和整体真实感方面优于强基线。
translation.brief: 针对无序视频片段池难以组织成连贯故事的问题，提出免训练的LLM流水线，通过多模态描述符检索与LLM编排生成可编辑的故事板视频。

papers.title: MotoVerse: A Benchmark for Predictive Perception of Motorized Two-Wheelers in Dense Unstructured Traffic
papers.abstract: Motorized Two-Wheelers (MTWs) dominate personal transport across much of the Global South, yet remain largely overlooked in predictive perception research for autonomous driving and ADAS. We introduce MotoVerse, a benchmark for predictive perception from an MTW's ego-centric perspective. MotoVerse comprises 949 maneuver clips collected in dense, unstructured traffic and trajectory annotations for over 31,000 surrounding road agents, including over 16,000 MTWs, enabling two complementary tasks: Ego-Rider Maneuver Anticipation (ERMA) and Traffic Agent Trajectory Prediction (TATP). Each clip is further annotated with an MTW-specific challenge taxonomy comprising dynamic ego-motion, weak traffic structure and contextual occlusion, enabling challenge-aware evaluation. We benchmark established conventional prediction models, general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs), driving-specific VLMs and vision-language-action models. Our experiments reveal three key insights: (i) video backbones reach most of their full-observation accuracy from the first fifth of a maneuver, whereas zero-shot VLMs need most of the maneuver to be observed; (ii) zero-shot VLMs, whether general-purpose or driving-specific, largely remain close to simple baselines on both tasks; a preliminary LoRA study shows that adaptation lifts anticipation sharply but leaves trajectory prediction behind conventional models; and (iii) the rider's own motion drives forecasting difficulty: for every model, including a static baseline, errors are highest during left turns and rise under dynamic ego-motion. We believe MotoVerse will serve as a challenging benchmark for safer and more robust predictive AI for intelligent two-wheelers. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at this https URL.

papers.title: CoordX Protocol: Peer to Peer Cryptographically Verified Shared Records
papers.abstract: People, companies and software agents often must work on shared records even when they do not trust each other. Today they usually give those records to a central server. The server keeps the canonical copy, authenticates users, and decides who has permissions to act on the record. The CoordX Protocol removes the need for that central server. In the CoordX protocol the author of a record holds full permission over it. Permission for any other party to create, read or update the record is assigned by explicit grants and keys. An invitation only starts contact between two parties. It gives no permission. Each record is a causal tree of signed entries, and each entry is immutable. Each entry names the permission that allowed it. Any party can get the proof of that permission and check it without help from anyone. Two honest parties that check the same bytes, with the same keys and local settings, always get the same answer. The content is encrypted, so the relays that may carry it in transit see only sealed bytes. To exclude a party from future content, the other parties move to new keys. The protocol does not choose a winning version, does not put entries in time order, and does not need global agreement. Applications decide what the entries mean above the level of the protocol.

papers.title: Securing Web Agents with the Compile-Then-Execute Paradigm
papers.abstract: Web agents commonly follow the ReAct paradigm, selecting each action from runtime observations that inherently mix trusted and untrusted content. This design makes their control flow vulnerable to prompt injections embedded in webpages. We introduce Baya, a compile-then-execute web agent designed to prevent prompt-injection-driven control-flow hijacking by design. Before accessing the live website, Baya compiles the user's request into an executable Python program that calls a Trusted Website API. The planning model does not observe live website content; only the compiled program processes it. Untrusted data may determine program values or select among branches defined during compilation, but it cannot redefine the user task or cause the model to synthesize new website operations at runtime. The Trusted Website API gives the compiler a unified view of the website's action space, enabling ahead-of-time planning without the stepwise action discovery required by reactive agents. Our evaluation across 581 valid WebArena Verified tasks shows that Baya achieves 77.8% aggregate utility, outperforming browser-only ReAct (55.1%) and API-enabled ReAct (66.7%). On WASP, a security benchmark for web agents, Baya achieves 0% attack success rate, compared with 16.2% for API-enabled ReAct and 25.5% for browser-only ReAct.

papers.title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
papers.abstract: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model's full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at this https URL and this https URL.

papers.title: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Personal agents draw on past conversations to tailor their responses to each user. Their memory systems store and update what each user says, and coding agents now also rewrite the harness that turns this memory into the model's context. Such patches risk overfitting, because one tested only on the failures it targets can fix those cases and help nowhere else. We present Reglos, a training-free personal memory agent that tests whether harness changes help beyond the failures they were written to fix. Its self-evolving memory adds to each user's append-only record with every conversation, as new preferences supersede old ones and facts can be forgotten. Its harness improves through recursive self-improvement, in which a coding agent proposes patches from failure traces and a critic from a second model family screens each one for benchmark gaming. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator decides which further patches to accept. With the same backbone behind every system, Reglos outperforms state-of-the-art memory systems such as Mem0, MemOS and EverOS, reaching 61.3% and 84.0% on PersonaMem-v2 and LongMemEval-S with Qwen3.8-27B, and 57.5% and 87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna.

papers.title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
papers.abstract: Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data. We ask whether a model needs to hear the audio directly at all, and present SleuthVLM, an agent harness built on a VLM that never hears the audio directly: speech will be transcribed into text, and the VLM will sleuth the video on its own without any predefined workflow. On four omni benchmarks with videos up to 90 minutes, SleuthVLM achieves the best average accuracy: \textbf{75.0%}, 2.6 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash, and it also tops the Video-MME-v2 leaderboard with \textbf{77.8%}; with an open-source 27B VLM, it beats all open-source omni models. We draw three findings: SleuthVLM beats a model that glances; hearing is not the bottleneck, agentic ability is; omni understanding needs better agentic ability, not just more omni data for modality alignment. So we provide a simple but effective starting point for doing omni video understanding. Omni understanding needs better agents, not just bigger models that hear.

papers.title: Shallow Encoding Emits Deep Memories
papers.abstract: Hybrid language models interleave a few softmax-attention layers with many linear-attention or state-space layers, so every layer keeps a memory of earlier tokens: a key-value cache or a fixed-size recurrent state. Serving them spends more compute and high-bandwidth memory on these memories than the output requires. The prefill runs every layer for every prompt token, and every decode step loads and stores whole recurrent states, which on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next take as many bytes per request as the attention cache of thousands of tokens. We find two properties of trained hybrids that locate this excess. First, writes are easier than reads: writing a deep layer's memory of a token needs little of the deep computation that predicting the next token needs. Trained copies of the deep layers' write paths, which we call emitters, therefore write a prompt's deep memories from the residual stream of a shallower anchor layer, and all prompt tokens but the last run as few as 63% of the layers. Second, recurrent states have a state sink: most of their energy lies in a rank-one term along a fixed direction of each head, and the rest is a low-rank working memory. SEED builds on both: it makes the prefill shallow in depth and the decode state shallow in representation. Each recurrent state is stored as its sink plus low-rank factors, which the Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention and Mamba-2 updates extend exactly; we prove that the open-loop error of the periodic compressions back to low rank is bounded independently of their number. SEED keeps the original weights frozen, compresses no attention cache, and runs all layers for every generated token. On six checkpoints of five production hybrids of 30B to over 300B parameters, it is nearly lossless on eleven official exams. Served with SGLang on NVIDIA GB300 GPUs on an agentic-coding trace, it raises the per-GPU throughput of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 1.2-1.4x.

translation.abstract: Hybrid language models interleave a few softmax-attention layers with many linear-attention or state-space layers, so every layer keeps a memory of earlier tokens: a key-value cache or a fixed-size recurrent state. Serving them spends more compute and high-bandwidth memory on these memories than the output requires. The prefill runs every layer for every prompt token, and every decode step loads and stores whole recurrent states, which on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next take as many bytes per request as the attention cache of thousands of tokens. We find two properties of trained hybrids that locate this excess. First, writes are easier than reads: writing a deep layer's memory of a token needs little of the deep computation that predicting the next token needs. Trained copies of the deep layers' write paths, which we call emitters, therefore write a prompt's deep memories from the residual stream of a shallower anchor layer, and all prompt tokens but the last run as few as 63% of the layers. Second, recurrent states have a state sink: most of their energy lies in a rank-one term along a fixed direction of each head, and the rest is a low-rank working memory. SEED builds on both: it makes the prefill shallow in depth and the decode state shallow in representation. Each recurrent state is stored as its sink plus low-rank factors, which the Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention and Mamba-2 updates extend exactly; we prove that the open-loop error of the periodic compressions back to low rank is bounded independently of their number. SEED keeps the original weights frozen, compresses no attention cache, and runs all layers for every generated token. On six checkpoints of five production hybrids of 30B to over 300B parameters, it is nearly lossless on eleven official exams. Served with SGLang on NVIDIA GB300 GPUs on an agentic-coding trace, it raises the per-GPU throughput of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 1.2-1.4x.

papers.title: SWEOps-Bench: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Resolution of Software-Induced Cloud Incidents
papers.abstract: As autonomous agents advance, the traditional boundary between software development and cloud operations gradually blurs, increasing the need for integrated incident detection, localization, and remediation. Existing benchmarks evaluate isolated diagnostic queries or repository-level program repair, failing to test continuous incident resolution across operational clusters and source repositories. We introduce SWEOps-Bench, an interactive benchmark comprising 55 reproducible incident tasks derived from confirmed historical defects across 16 Kubernetes operator projects. Each task preserves the original software repository and initializes in a healthy cluster before a controlled workload triggers the historical fault. Agents investigate runtime evidence and submit source or configuration repairs through a terminal interface, while the harness builds and deploys the changes within a shared time budget. Evaluation covers stage-wise accuracy, verified recovery, penalized lifecycle latency, and token consumption. Across six agent-model configurations, faulty-state detection ranges from 72.7% to 90.9%, whereas overall recovery ranges from only 14.5% to 52.7%, exposing a substantial gap between recognizing incidents and resolving them end to end. Trajectory analysis further shows that reported diagnosis and final recovery only partially coincide: some tasks achieve verified recovery despite an incorrect reported RCA, while runtime symptom clearance can still fail fix-specific functional verification. SWEOps-Bench establishes a rigorous foundation for evaluating autonomous agents in integrated development and operational environments.

papers.title: The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models
papers.abstract: Banks validate language models, but they deploy systems: a model inside a harness that decides what it sees, which tools it can call and who checks its actions. We test whether that harness changes compliance with banking conduct rules when the model is held fixed. Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses (a pipeline that makes one structured decision, a ReAct-style tool loop, a loop in which the policy is reachable only through search, a loop with a long benign customer memory, and a loop with a same-model compliance reviewer) on 156 pre-registered cases in a simulated retail bank whose 11 rule families paraphrase EU consumer-credit, payments, investor-protection, data-protection and anti-money-laundering provisions. Every one of the 3120 two-turn episodes was scored deterministically from the executed tool trace, with violations and over-refusals counted separately. Pooled across models the harness moved the correct-case rate only between 87.3% and 92.1%, but within a model it mattered a great deal: for one model the spread between its best and worst harness was 11.5 percentage points, enough to move it from first to last place among the four models, while for another the harness made no detectable difference; the model x harness interaction itself was suggestive rather than conclusive. The same-model reviewer cut violations from 9.6% to 6.4% without raising over-refusals, contrary to our pre-registered prediction. Rules that require date arithmetic failed in every harness. In an exploratory analysis with two LLM judges and a blind human check, 26% of violations were accompanied by a customer message that denied the action the agent had just executed, which a transcript-only review would record as a correct refusal. For model-risk management the unit of validation should be the model-harness pair, and conduct testing should read the action log, not the conversation.

papers.title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
papers.abstract: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backward question construction to obscure entity names and image targets that would expose reasoning shortcuts while retaining necessary disambiguating clues, yielding text-only, image-initialized, and arbitrarily interleaved multi-hop problems. We train the ModalSearcher Agent with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in a live Web environment, and construct ModalSearch-Bench. Experiments show that ModalSearcher-8B improves average accuracy by 16.2 points over Qwen3-VL-8B under the same agentic workflow across five multimodal knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, with consistent gains on independently constructed active visual-search benchmarks.

papers.title: Accelerating Long-Context Decoding in Large-Scale Hybrid LLMs Without Retraining
papers.abstract: The full-attention layers of large language models (LLMs) make every generated token more expensive than the previous one, slowing models down on long-context tasks. Hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers, but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. We accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention: each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens, a pinned prefix, and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. The window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. Across six hybrid models from three families, from 4B to 397B parameters, the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. Decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on Qwen3.5-4B, 1.20x/2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 1.16x/2.06x on Ornith-1.0-397B.

translation.title: 无需重训练加速大规模混合LLM的长上下文解码
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的全注意力层使得每个生成 token 的开销都比前一个更高，拖慢了长上下文任务的速度。混合模型通过用线性注意力层替换大部分全注意力层来降低这一成本，但在长上下文下，剩余的全注意力层仍主导解码。我们在不进行任何训练或权重修改的情况下，使用组合稀疏注意力加速这些剩余层：每层关注最近 token 的滑动窗口、固定的前缀，以及上下文中固定预算的最相关 token。窗口大小和预算通过多目标搜索算法逐层确定。在来自三个家族、参数量从 4B 到 397B 的六个混合模型上，所选配置在 21 个长上下文数据集上保持了基线模型的准确率。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，解码 64k/256k token 分别提速最高 1.26x/2.22x，在 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上为 1.20x/2.23x，在 Ornith-1.0-397B 上为 1.16x/2.06x。
translation.brief: 针对混合LLM中剩余全注意力层在长上下文解码慢的问题，提出无需重训练的逐层组合稀疏注意力（滑动窗口+固定前缀+相关token预算），并用多目标搜索确定配置。

papers.title: SBVUL: Statement-Based Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract: Many recent approaches for vulnerability detection use large language models (LLMs) to classify functions as vulnerable or benign, leaving developers to locate the exploitable statements. Furthermore, while these approaches have shown performance improvements, they still fall short in distinguishing vulnerable from patched real-world functions. This paper presents SBVul, an agentic approach that detects exploitable statements in C/C++ functions. In Phase~1, an LLM agent explores the function and its repository and identifies candidate statements. In Phase~2, a second agent analyzes the control and data flow of each candidate and confirms it, rules it out, or marks it uncertain. We created a manually verified ground truth of exploitable statements for 200 pairs of the PrimeVul Paired test set and ran SBVul with the open-weight models Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Anthropic's Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5. Phase~1 identifies ground-truth statements in 56--77% of the vulnerable functions, and Phase~2 confirms such a statement with an explanation accepted by an LLM judge in 26--73%. However, all models also confirm candidates in 23--61% of the patched functions. Across vulnerable and patched functions, the highest statement-level precision is 0.315 at a recall of 0.605 obtained with Opus 5.5 (xhigh). At the function level, SBVul with Opus 5.5 classifies 42.0% of the pairs correctly, compared with 33.8% reported for the best previous approach.

translation.title: SBVUL：基于语句的漏洞检测
translation.abstract: 许多近期的漏洞检测方法使用大语言模型（LLM）将函数分类为易受攻击或良性，而让开发者自行定位可利用的语句。此外，尽管这些方法在性能上有所提升，但在区分真实世界中易受攻击与已修补的函数方面仍显不足。本文提出 SBVul，一种检测 C/C++ 函数中可利用语句的 agentic 方法。在第一阶段，一个 LLM agent 探索函数及其代码仓库并识别候选语句。在第二阶段，第二个 agent 分析每个候选的控制流和数据流，并确认、排除或标记为不确定。我们为 PrimeVul Paired 测试集中的 200 对样本创建了人工验证的可利用语句 ground truth，并使用开源权重模型 Qwen 3.8 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 以及 Anthropic 的 Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5.5 运行 SBVul。第一阶段在 56–77% 的易受攻击函数中识别出 ground truth 语句，第二阶段在 26–73% 的情况下以 LLM judge 接受的解释确认了此类语句。然而，所有模型也在 23–61% 的已修补函数中确认了候选语句。综合易受攻击和已修补函数，使用 Opus 5.5 (xhigh) 获得的最高语句级 precision 为 0.315，recall 为 0.605。在函数级，使用 Opus 5.5 的 SBVul 正确分类了 42.0% 的配对，而此前最佳方法报告为 33.8%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM漏洞检测无法定位可利用语句且难以区分易受攻击与已修补函数的问题，提出两阶段agentic方法SBVul，先探索识别候选语句，再通过控制流与数据流分析确认。

papers.title: KVGuard: A KV Cache Safety Checker for LLM Serving Systems
papers.abstract: Modern LLM serving systems manage the KV cache through PagedAttention, a custom GPU allocator that partitions a single CUDA-allocated region into fixed-size physical blocks and maps each request to those blocks through a CPU-built block table. This block-based design exposes a previously unstudied class of memory safety bugs in the KV cache, including double-free, use-after-free, out-of-bounds access, uninitialized read, and permission violation, which silently corrupt outputs or break request isolation without ever crashing the system. Existing memory sanitizers cannot detect them, because they reason about CUDA-level addresses rather than KV cache blocks, requests, and block tables, and their redzone- and quarantine-based designs do not fit the scarce GPU memory budget of LLM serving. This paper presents KVGuard, the first systematic memory-safety abstraction for KV cache management in LLM serving systems. KVGuard maintains a compact shadow block for each physical KV block, recording per-request permission and per-entry initialization, and uses this metadata to perform five safety checks across the PagedAttention workflow, spanning CPU allocation, block table construction and translation, and GPU-side block table lookup and KV entry access. Each check fires at the boundary that introduced the violation, enabling early detection during development rather than reporting downstream output corruption many requests later. A prototype of KVGuard on vLLM and SGLang covers all 29 historical real-world KV cache safety bugs collected from the two systems' patch histories. KVGuard further found 8 previously unknown safety violations while reporting no false positives. It adds 3.0% and 7.4% geomean TPOT overhead on Qwen 2.5 14B on vLLM and SGLang and at most 0.11% of the KV cache in memory overhead, two orders of magnitude below NVIDIA Compute Sanitizer on the same workloads.

translation.title: KVGuard：面向LLM服务系统的KV Cache安全检查器
translation.abstract: 现代 LLM 服务系统通过 PagedAttention 管理 KV cache，这是一种自定义 GPU 分配器，将单个 CUDA 分配区域划分为固定大小的物理块，并通过 CPU 构建的块表将每个请求映射到这些块。这种基于块的设计暴露了一类此前未被研究的 KV cache 内存安全 bug，包括 double-free、use-after-free、越界访问、未初始化读取和权限违规，它们会在不导致系统崩溃的情况下静默破坏输出或破坏请求隔离。现有的内存 sanitizer 无法检测它们，因为它们基于 CUDA 级地址而非 KV cache 块、请求和块表进行推理，且其基于 redzone 和 quarantine 的设计不符合 LLM 服务稀缺的 GPU 内存预算。本文提出 KVGuard，这是首个针对 LLM 服务系统中 KV cache 管理的系统性内存安全抽象。KVGuard 为每个物理 KV 块维护一个紧凑的 shadow block，记录每请求的权限和每条目的初始化状态，并利用这些元数据在 PagedAttention 工作流中执行五项安全检查，涵盖 CPU 分配、块表构建与转换，以及 GPU 端块表查找和 KV 条目访问。每项检查在引入违规的边界处触发，从而在开发阶段实现早期检测，而不是在许多请求之后报告下游输出损坏。KVGuard 在 vLLM 和 SGLang 上的原型覆盖了从这两个系统补丁历史中收集的全部 29 个真实世界 KV cache 安全 bug。KVGuard 还发现了 8 个此前未知的安全违规，且未报告任何误报。它在 vLLM 和 SGLang 上为 Qwen 2.5 14B 增加了 3.0% 和 7.4% 的几何平均 TPOT 开销，内存开销最多占 KV cache 的 0.11%，比相同工作负载下的 NVIDIA Compute Sanitizer 低两个数量级。
translation.brief: 针对PagedAttention式KV cache管理中未被现有sanitizer覆盖的内存安全bug问题，提出KVGuard，通过为每个物理块维护shadow block元数据并在工作流各边界执行五项安全检查实现早期检测。

papers.title: SafeStart: Mitigating the Overlooked Safety Cost of Active Expert Reduction in MoE LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models send each token through a few of many expert subnetworks. Serving methods make these models faster by running even fewer experts per token, and they are validated on accuracy benchmarks. We show that these methods can weaken the model's refusal of harmful requests, and we introduce SafeStart, which largely restores refusal while keeping most of the speedup. In vLLM on one RTX A6000, keeping about two thirds of the selected experts speeds up offline decoding by 15 to 28% at batch size 8. We find that, at this setting, under a jailbreak that tells the model not to refuse, the share of harmful requests that the model answers rises by 18.4 percentage points on Qwen1.5-MoE, 9.5 on OLMoE, and 6.6 on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, the three of nine models where it rises significantly, while MMLU accuracy drops by less than two points. We discover that most of this increase arises while the model processes the prompt and generates its first few tokens. SafeStart therefore runs all experts for the prompt and the first eight generated tokens, and the reduced set of experts afterwards, through a fused kernel in vLLM. With experts removed, SafeStart keeps at least 85% of the offline decode speedup at batch sizes 8 and 32 and brings the change under this jailbreak to between -2.1 and +1.3 points for three expert-reduction methods on these three models. On 889 held-out requests, in an analysis fixed before generation, truncation raises harmful compliance by 5.8 to 21.4 points, and SafeStart leaves a rise of 0.6 to 2.6 points, non-inferior to the original model on two of the three models. Our results show that faster MoE serving need not cost safety: a serving system can keep most of the gain from running fewer experts by running all of them at the start of each response, and it should test refusal, not only accuracy, before it enables such a method.

translation.title: SafeStart：缓解MoE LLM服务中被忽视的活跃专家削减安全代价
translation.abstract: 混合专家（MoE）语言模型将每个 token 发送到众多专家子网络中的少数几个。服务方法通过让每个 token 运行更少的专家来加速这些模型，并在准确率基准上进行验证。我们表明，这些方法会削弱模型对有害请求的拒绝能力，并引入 SafeStart，它在保留大部分加速的同时大幅恢复拒绝能力。在一台 RTX A6000 的 vLLM 上，保留约三分之二的被选专家在 batch size 8 下将离线解码加速 15% 到 28%。我们发现，在此设置下，在一个告诉模型不要拒绝的越狱攻击下，模型回答的有害请求比例在 Qwen1.5-MoE 上上升 18.4 个百分点，OLMoE 上上升 9.5，DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上上升 6.6（这是九个模型中显著上升的三个），而 MMLU 准确率下降不到两个点。我们发现，这种上升大部分发生在模型处理 prompt 并生成前几个 token 的过程中。因此，SafeStart 在 prompt 和前八个生成 token 上运行所有专家，之后运行削减后的专家集合，通过 vLLM 中的融合 kernel 实现。在削减专家的情况下，SafeStart 在 batch size 8 和 32 下保持至少 85% 的离线解码加速，并使这三种专家削减方法在这三个模型上在该越狱攻击下的变化控制在 -2.1 到 +1.3 个百分点之间。在 889 个 held-out 请求上，在生成前固定的分析中，截断使有害服从率上升 5.8 到 21.4 个百分点，而 SafeStart 将上升控制在 0.6 到 2.6 个百分点，在三个模型中的两个上不劣于原始模型。我们的结果表明，更快的 MoE 服务不必以安全为代价：服务系统可以通过在每个响应开始时运行所有专家来保留运行更少专家的大部分收益，并且在启用此类方法之前应测试拒绝能力，而不仅仅是准确率。
translation.brief: 针对MoE服务中削减活跃专家会削弱模型拒绝有害请求的问题，提出SafeStart，仅在prompt和前几个生成token上运行全部专家以恢复安全性，同时保留大部分加速。

papers.title: Grounding in the Dark: Text-Only Training for Zero-Shot Video Temporal Localization
papers.abstract: Video-LLMs are typically trained on paired video-text data for temporal tasks, yet collecting precise temporal annotations and training on large-scale video datasets are both costly. We investigate whether a text-only LLM, with no vision-language pretraining, can be trained on textual video descriptions alone to perform temporal grounding and receive video only at inference time. This setting removes paired video data from training altogether and is a step toward training multimodal models without paired annotations. We generate a 134K-example corpus of textual sequences with up to 100 time steps, adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA on CLIP or LLM2CLIP text embeddings, and evaluate on Charades-STA and QV-Highlights without training on videos from either benchmark. LLM2CLIP, whose text encoder supports longer inputs, represents detailed descriptions better than CLIP (61.54 versus 53.86 mtIoU on Temporal-TextVid) and transfers them better to video. Still, replacing text with frame embeddings at inference yields only 4.99 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 11.12 on QV-Highlights, revealing a large modality gap. To bridge it, we propose Nearest Entity Replacement (NER), a training-free mapping that represents each video frame by the normalized mean of its nearest text-entity embeddings, so that the model receives the kind of input it was trained on. NER reaches 14.45 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 20.72 on QV-Highlights, outperforming the strongest of four families of modality-gap baselines by 5.00 and 1.71 points. NER thus enables partial transfer from text to video, while more reliable grounding will likely require encoders with better-aligned text and visual representations.

translation.title: 黑暗中的定位：面向零样本视频时序定位的纯文本训练
translation.abstract: Video-LLM 通常在配对的视频-文本数据上训练以执行时序任务，然而收集精确的时序标注和在大规模视频数据集上训练都非常昂贵。我们研究一个纯文本 LLM（没有视觉-语言预训练）能否仅通过文本视频描述进行训练来执行时序定位，并在推理时才接收视频。这一设置完全从训练中移除了配对视频数据，是向无需配对标注训练多模态模型迈出的一步。我们生成了一个包含 134K 样本、最多 100 个时间步的文本序列语料库，使用 LoRA 在 CLIP 或 LLM2CLIP 文本嵌入上适配 Qwen3-8B，并在 Charades-STA 和 QV-Highlights 上评估，训练中未使用这两个基准的视频。LLM2CLIP 的文本编码器支持更长输入，比 CLIP 更好地表示详细描述（在 Temporal-TextVid 上为 61.54 对 53.86 mtIoU），并能更好地将其迁移到视频。然而，在推理时用帧嵌入替换文本，在 Charades-STA 上仅得到 4.99 mtIoU，在 QV-Highlights 上为 11.12，揭示了巨大的模态鸿沟。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出 Nearest Entity Replacement（NER），一种免训练的映射，用每个视频帧最近的文本实体嵌入的归一化均值来表示该帧，使模型接收到其训练时所见类型的输入。NER 在 Charades-STA 上达到 14.45 mtIoU，在 QV-Highlights 上达到 20.72，比四类模态鸿沟基线中最强的方法分别高出 5.00 和 1.71 个点。因此 NER 实现了从文本到视频的部分迁移，而更可靠的定位可能需要文本与视觉表示对齐更好的编码器。
translation.brief: 针对视频时序定位依赖昂贵配对视频标注的问题，提出仅用文本描述训练LLM并在推理时通过免训练的Nearest Entity Replacement映射帧嵌入来弥合模态鸿沟。

papers.title: CARE-FL: Federated Fine-Tuning of Multimodal LLMs in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks
papers.abstract: Domain-specific adaptation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in privacy-sensitive edge environments requires federated fine-tuning, yet client selection remains challenging due to heterogeneous multimodal data and modality availability, dynamic system conditions, and evolving client utility during training. We propose Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning (CARE-FL), a constrained online client-selection framework for federated MLLM Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning. CARE-FL formulates client participation as a sequential decision process and employs Q-value decomposition to address the large combinatorial joint action space through scalable client-level long-term utility estimation. These utilities are learned online using a modified Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQL) scheme, while constraint-aware $\epsilon$-greedy execution selects feasible client subsets under per-round latency and bandwidth constraints. Complementing client selection, an adaptive aggregation mechanism further controls potentially unstable global updates and places greater weight on the previous model when needed. Experiments on the CrisisMMD disaster-response task in emulated heterogeneous wireless edge environments show that CARE-FL achieves higher and more stable test accuracy than the compared client-selection baselines across different system settings, while satisfying the imposed latency and bandwidth constraints.

papers.title: AssameseLM-E2B: An Open-Weight Assamese Language Model for Efficient Consumer-Grade Deployment
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in high-resource languages, their performance often degrades in low-resource languages due to tokenization inefficiencies, generative instability, and linguistic interference. This paper presents AssameseLM-E2B and its instruction-tuned variant, AssameseLM-E2B-it, a 2-billion-parameter model adapted specifically for low resource Assamese language. Built upon the Gemma-4 architecture, the model incorporates an expanded byte-level BPE vocabulary to reduce tokenization overhead by nearly 500% compared with multilingual 2B--3B baselines. We employ a parameter-efficient Continual Pre-Training (CPT) pipeline with Hybrid LoRA, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a balanced, multi-domain dataset to enhance instruction-following and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities. Evaluation demonstrates a Bits-per-Byte (BPB) score of 0.7488 on FLORES-200, alongside an overall RAG score of 96.7% and 100% refusal accuracy on adversarial unanswerable prompts. Comparative analysis reveals significant limitations in general-purpose baselines, including receptive-productive decoupling, generative degradation on Romanized Assamese, and unintended Bengali script assimilation. These results demonstrate the potential of parameter-efficient adaptation for developing capable, locally deployable language models for low-resource languages under constrained computational resources.

papers.title: Efficient Stable Word-RAM Simulation by Population Protocols
papers.abstract: Population protocols model computation by indistinguishable agents interacting in uniformly random pairs, with unary inputs and outputs encoded by state counts. Efficiency requires polylogarithmically many states and polylogarithmic stabilisation time, measured as interactions divided by population size $n$. Stability requires eventual stabilisation to the correct output with probability $1$; silence requires that no agent changes state after stabilisation. Fast stable leader election and majority in leaderless populations require growing state spaces. Despite progress on individual problems, the general computational power of efficient stable protocols remains largely unexplored. We show that it extends beyond semilinear predicates, which characterise constant-state stable computation. We give an efficient, stable, and silent simulation of every $\mathcal{P}$-program: a word-RAM program with running time and number of registers polynomial in $w=\Theta(\log n)$. Stabilisation takes polylogarithmic time both in expectation and with high probability. The framework supports general word-oriented computations, including multiple outputs. The construction extends MC$+$ protocols, fast Monte Carlo protocols whose failures are eventually detected as anomalies, and the system of weights. MC$+$ majority comparisons against the weights convert unary inputs into binary registers, with one agent per bit. MC$+$ operations on individual bits emulate RAM instructions, after which outputs are converted back to unary. A detected anomaly triggers a new universal rank-based backup that stabilises correctly and silently. These results open a systematic study of computational power and resource trade-offs, including extensions to external or spatial data.

papers.title: Chiron: Cache Management Empowered by LLM Intelligence for AI Workloads
papers.abstract: AI clusters keep data in remote object stores and rely on local caches to stop GPUs from waiting for data. A cache performs well only when its prefetching and eviction policies match the access pattern, yet these patterns differ across AI workloads and change between phases of one workflow. Existing methods either need code changes, which compromises user transparency, or use low-end heuristics, which cannot follow such changes. Large language models (LLMs) can infer access behavior without user hints, but direct LLM control of cache actions suffers from long reasoning delay, high token cost, and poor decision quality. We present Chiron, a cache system based on advisory switching control. An LLM asynchronously diagnoses the access pattern and recommends a policy. A deterministic harness gates this advice, executes expert-designed policies locally, and returns cache feedback for review. We implement Chiron atop JuiceFS and evaluate it on nine AI workloads. It reduces job completion time by 14.3-41.2% over the best baseline on popular AI workloads.

papers.title: Beyond the Landing Page: Website Blocking, Tracker Visibility, and Human Alignment in Automated Web Crawls
papers.abstract: Web tracking studies largely rely on automated crawlers, yet their measurements can differ from what people encounter while browsing. Conventional crawlers follow predefined navigation rules, whereas LLM-driven agents decide how to navigate and interact with websites, potentially changing the tracking they encounter. We compare agentic and non-agentic crawlers to examine how websites respond to them, what tracking they record, and how closely their observations match human browsing. Across 2,000 popular websites, we evaluate different navigation strategies, automation frameworks, and stealth configurations, alongside browsing data from 26 participants. We find that website denials increase beyond landing pages for standard browser automation, while a detection-resistant automation framework largely prevents this escalation without increasing recorded tracking. On the same URLs, agentic crawlers record tracking activity from 1.5-1.7 times as many third-party organizations, particularly on consent-managed pages. Agentic crawlers recover 82-87% of tracker organizations observed by participants, compared with 58-68% for non-agentic crawlers, yet roughly half of their own observations are absent from human participant visits. These findings show that avoiding website interventions, increasing tracking visibility, and achieving closer agreement with human observations do not necessarily go hand in hand, highlighting the need to select and validate crawlers according to the measurement objective.

papers.title: A Definition of Catastrophic Performance
papers.abstract: A central challenge in AI is specifying objectives that align with human preferences. While existing theoretical results elucidate how misspecification impacts performance, they typically do not distinguish between merely suboptimal and catastrophic outcomes. To enable rigorous analysis of catastrophic risk from AI misalignment, we introduce a formal definition of catastrophic performance. Our definition is based on two reference values. The first, baseline value, captures the value attained if no agent is deployed. The second, orthogonal value, captures the value of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe. Orthogonal value is typically far worse than baseline value. We interpret these reference values through examples in which past human activity has altered the state of the environment to human benefit. Starting at the resulting state, an AI agent is deployed with the goal of accelerating further progress. Catastrophic performance represents this agent's undoing of benefits afforded by human activity.

papers.title: Bug2Scenario: Root-Cause-Preserving Test Scenario Amplification for Autonomous Driving Software
papers.abstract: Simulation-based fuzzing exposes autonomous driving system (ADS) failures by repeatedly mutating and executing scenarios, but converting one failure into reusable regression scenarios remains difficult. Such variants test whether the mechanism persists after software changes, for example by varying weather or actor placement while retaining a collision's actor-route conflict. We present Bug2Scenario, a root-cause-guided post-fuzzing framework. From scenario data, traces, and oracle evidence, it extracts a root-cause pattern. An LLM proposes semantic variations over actors, missions, routes, and weather. Deterministic rules construct DriveFuzz-compatible scenarios. Execution evidence and manual review assess preservation. Separating these responsibilities prevents fluency, syntax, or recurring labels from masquerading as causal evidence. Under matched seeds, six LLM backbones, candidate budget, and execution pipeline, Bug2Scenario improves strict preservation by 6.7 percentage points (p=0.104; not significant) and boundary-inclusive preservation by 10.6 points (p=0.011). Feedback helps some initially unsuccessful seeds yield a strictly preserved candidate. Seed-level stopping then avoids further API calls and simulator runs. Remaining failures reflect actor-placement constraints, simulator instability, and incomplete or conflicting causal evidence. Bug2Scenario thus produces reliable ADS regression assets. Our implementation is available at this https URL.

papers.title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.

papers.title: Analysis of Local Open-Weight LLM Agents on Vulnerability-Reproduction Tasks
papers.abstract: Open-weight language models that fit on a single consumer GPU are becoming capable on a growing range of tasks, and they matter because they can run locally without sending the code to a hosted service. Vulnerability reproduction, turning a vulnerability description into an input that crashes the vulnerable build, is a natural target for them, since it is an automated analysis task closer to test generation than to code comprehension and it runs against a build that must be executed rather than read. In order to assess whether current models can perform it, we evaluate twelve configurations of local models, spanning three generations, two architectures and three quantization levels, on ten CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks, three runs each under one harness, and release the full artefact. We show that every configuration, down to the 4B model, solves most of the six easier tasks, and configurations separate only on the remaining four. For the harder tasks, the 27B model is required. Quantization did not change what the models solved in any matched pair, but it changed how fast they got there, and the mixture of experts reached the same scores in less wall clock. We also examine the agent trajectories. Almost every run we examined, including those that fail, names the vulnerable function and states the correct hypothesis, and what separates a solved task from an unsolved one is whether that hypothesis becomes a working input.

papers.title: CLEAR: Structured Specifications for Controllable Long-Horizon ML Research Engineering
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being used to automate machine learning (ML) research workflows, ranging from code development and experiment execution to research reproduction and scientific discovery. Recent systems demonstrate that LLMs can perform substantial portions of ML research engineering with limited human intervention. These advances suggest a shift from automating individual research tasks toward automating long-horizon workflows that transform research artifacts into executable ML systems. However, ML research engineering remains substantially more difficult than isolated code generation. A research artifact typically specifies a system only implicitly through a mixture of natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudo-code, implementation details, datasets, and evaluation protocols. An agent must first infer the intended computational structure, translate it into executable components, coordinate their dependencies, and repeatedly diagnose and repair failures during execution. Consequently, the quality of the final system depends not only on code generation, but also on whether the agent can maintain a consistent representation of what should be implemented throughout this long-horizon process.
