papers.title: Evaluating Human-LLM Alignment on Visualization Preference
papers.abstract: There are often multiple valid visualizations, spanning different chart types, visual encodings, and aesthetic choices, that can all support a user's goal of analyzing a dataset. Determining which of these candidate visualizations is most appropriate, however, remains challenging. Prior work has leveraged expert-curated taxonomies to guide visualization design and subsequent quality evaluation, a practical evaluation model must also account for human-centric factors. Latest visualization tools integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate and refine visualizations, using LLM-as-a-judge to provide design feedback. Without a deeper understanding of whether, and in what ways, human and LLM perceptions of visualizations align, there is a real risk of deploying low-quality agents that do not reflect human judgment. We study this question through a pilot experiment - we formulate the problem as a preference task over curated chart pairs and compare the judgments of state-of-the-art vision models with those of a panel of human annotators. We establish a cautionary tale: such judges risk filtering out informative, compelling displays. We find that frontier models collapse human subjectivity, a rich signal that reveals contrasting design choices, into near-deterministic verdicts.

translation.title: 评估人类与LLM在可视化偏好上的一致性
translation.abstract: 同一个数据集往往存在多种有效的可视化方案，涵盖不同的图表类型、视觉编码和美学选择，都能支持用户分析数据的目标。然而，确定哪种候选可视化最合适仍然具有挑战性。先前的工作利用专家整理的分类体系来指导可视化设计和后续的质量评估，而实用的评估模型还必须考虑以人为中心的因素。最新的可视化工具集成了大语言模型（LLM）来生成和改进可视化，并使用 LLM-as-a-judge 提供设计反馈。如果不深入了解人类与LLM对可视化的感知是否一致以及在哪些方面一致，就存在部署无法反映人类判断的低质量智能体的真实风险。我们通过一个先导实验研究这一问题——将问题形式化为在精选图表对上的偏好任务，比较最先进的视觉模型与人类标注小组的判断。我们确立了一个警示性结论：这样的评判者可能会过滤掉信息丰富、有说服力的展示。我们发现前沿模型将人类主观性——一种揭示不同设计选择的丰富信号——坍缩为近乎确定性的判定。
translation.brief: 研究人类与LLM在可视化偏好判断上的一致性，通过将问题形式化为精选图表对上的偏好任务并对比前沿视觉模型与人类标注者的判断。

papers.title: Clear Human Web: Where a Person Vouches for Every Client
papers.abstract: The web cannot tell whether a request comes from a person or from a program. Sites have checked the network address and puzzles in its place, and both have given way: automated traffic exceeds human traffic, and puzzles are solved for pay and by agents. This paper proposes the Clear Human Web, the part of the public web that sites open only to clients a person vouches for. A person's wallet presents their person identification data (PID) to one issuer, the only party that registers as a relying party, and receives a bounded number of blind-signed tokens, proofs of personhood that carry no attribute. The browser spends one token at each site that runs the gate, and the site learns that a valid token of a trusted issuer was spent, and nothing else. No field is added to the PID, no protocol is introduced, no site registers, and the publisher of a site holds the same proof as its readers. We define the Clear Human Web through five properties and seven adversaries, and state which properties the construction satisfies against each adversary. The identities a person can hold on one site in an epoch are bounded to k. The bound holds once the wallet limits a person to one pseudonym at the issuer. In the optimum k = 1, and a zero-knowledge proof of PID possession and a pseudonym per site replace the tokens.

translation.title: Clear Human Web：每个人为每个客户端担保的网络
translation.abstract: 网络无法判断请求来自人还是程序。网站曾用网络地址和验证谜题来替代判断，但两者都已失效：自动化流量已超过人类流量，谜题可被付费代解或被智能体破解。本文提出 Clear Human Web，即网站仅向由真人担保的客户端开放的那部分公共网络。用户的钱包向唯一注册为依赖方的签发者出示其个人身份数据（PID），并获得数量有上限的盲签名令牌——不携带任何属性的人格证明。浏览器在每个运行该门禁的网站花费一个令牌，网站只知道来自可信签发者的有效令牌被花费，此外一无所知。不向PID添加字段，不引入新协议，网站无需注册，网站发布者与其读者持有相同的证明。我们通过五个属性和七类对手定义 Clear Human Web，并说明该构造对每类对手满足哪些属性。一个人在一个纪元内可在单个网站上持有的身份被限制为 k 个；只要钱包将一个人限制为在签发者处使用一个假名，该界限即成立。在最优的 k = 1 时，PID持有的零知识证明加上每站点一个假名即可取代令牌。
translation.brief: 提出Clear Human Web方案，通过签发者盲签名令牌和浏览器逐站花费机制，在保护隐私的前提下让网站验证请求来自真人担保的客户端。

papers.title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agents construct a repository context before generating code. For security-sensitive code, this context decides whether the model sees the project's safeguards (e.g., authorization checks) or insecure code to imitate. However, context construction is designed almost exclusively for functional correctness, and secure-code benchmarks treat the context as fixed, so how repository context affects the security of generated code remains unclear. We construct CASE-Bench, a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks from real CVEs in 51 projects. Each task runs in Docker, has functional tests and a proof-of-concept exploit validated in both directions, and is annotated with the repository code that enforces or undermines its security. Using CASE-Bench, we compare 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs, edit single context elements, and analyze coding-agent trajectories. We find that (1) functionality-oriented context raises the functional pass rate by up to 8.2 percentage points (pp) but the secure pass rate by at most 3.7 pp, (2) withholding a safeguard lowers the secure pass rate by up to 8.1 pp, while one inserted insecure exemplar raises correct-but-exploitable code by 6.3 pp, and (3) coding agents observe the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of trajectories. These findings inform security-aware context construction and secure-code evaluation.

translation.title: A.S.E 2.0：理解仓库上下文如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）编程助手和智能体在生成代码前会构建仓库上下文。对于安全敏感的代码，这一上下文决定了模型能否看到项目的安全防护（如授权检查）或可模仿的不安全代码。然而，上下文构建几乎完全为功能正确性而设计，安全代码基准也将上下文视为固定的，因此仓库上下文如何影响生成代码的安全性仍不清楚。我们构建了 CASE-Bench，一个包含来自51个项目真实CVE的145个仓库级任务的基准。每个任务在Docker中运行，具有功能测试和双向验证的概念验证漏洞利用，并标注了仓库中实施或破坏其安全性的代码。利用 CASE-Bench，我们比较了13种上下文构建方法和六个对照组与六个LLM，单独修改上下文元素，并分析编程智能体的轨迹。我们发现：(1) 面向功能的上下文将功能通过率最多提升8.2个百分点（pp），但安全通过率最多仅提升3.7 pp；(2) 隐藏安全防护会使安全通过率最多下降8.1 pp，而插入一个不安全示例会使正确但可被利用的代码增加6.3 pp；(3) 编程智能体仅在27-36%的轨迹中观察到相关安全防护。这些发现为安全感知的上下文构建和安全代码评估提供了依据。
translation.brief: 构建CASE-Bench基准，通过比较多种上下文构建方法与LLM组合，量化仓库上下文对LLM生成代码安全性的影响。

papers.title: Multi-Resident Data Association in Smart Homes via MDP Modeling and Behavior Cloning
papers.abstract: Ambient sensors offer a privacy-preserving solution for activity recognition in smart homes, yet they face a critical challenge in multi-resident environments known as Data Association, which aims to identify the resident triggering a specific anonymous sensor event. Existing approaches fundamentally fail to maintain global consistency by often yielding conflicting associations for silent residents. Additionally, these methods frequently suffer from severe trajectory fragmentation caused by the ontological mismatch of applying continuous physical motion models to discrete logical behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that reformulates data association as a sequential decision-making task within a Markov Decision Process (MDP). We solve the defined MDP via Behavior Cloning (BC) to avoid complex reward engineering by directly learning from expert demonstrations. We instantiate the policy using two complementary architectures, including a lightweight Transformer that treats association as a multi-label classification task over linearized event histories, and a fine-tuned Large Language Model (LLM) that reformulates the problem as conditional text generation to leverage pre-trained semantic knowledge. Extensive evaluations on three diverse datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in resolving concurrent multi-resident events. Furthermore, the LLM-based policy shows preliminary cross-environment transfer potential under benchmark settings, while its robustness in real deployments still requires further validation.

translation.title: 基于MDP建模与行为克隆的智能家居多住户数据关联
translation.abstract: 环境传感器为智能家居中的活动识别提供了隐私保护方案，但在多住户环境中面临一个关键挑战——数据关联（Data Association），即识别触发特定匿名传感器事件的住户。现有方法从根本上无法保持全局一致性，常常为未发声住户产生相互冲突的关联。此外，这些方法由于将连续物理运动模型应用于离散逻辑行为而产生的本体论错配，经常遭受严重的轨迹碎片化。为解决这些局限，我们提出一个新框架，将数据关联重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的序贯决策任务。我们通过行为克隆（BC）求解所定义的MDP，直接从专家示范中学习，避免复杂的奖励工程。我们用两种互补架构实例化该策略：一个轻量级Transformer，将关联视为对线性化事件历史的多标签分类任务；以及一个微调的大语言模型（LLM），将问题重新表述为条件文本生成以利用预训练的语义知识。在三个不同数据集上的大量评估表明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的基线，尤其在解决并发多住户事件方面。此外，基于LLM的策略在基准设置下显示出初步的跨环境迁移潜力，但其在真实部署中的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
translation.brief: 将多住户传感器数据关联重新建模为MDP序贯决策任务，用行为克隆训练Transformer和LLM两种策略来识别触发传感器事件的住户。

papers.title: Beyond Scene Shortcuts: Action-Centric Video-Text Alignment for Fine-Grained Action Understanding
papers.abstract: Fine-grained action understanding requires vision-language models to ground what an agent does, how it acts, and why it acts in spatio-temporal evidence. However, richer supervision can backfire: fine-tuned models may generate detailed action descriptions grounded in static scenes and salient objects rather than motion, a failure we call Environment-Grounded Action Hallucination (EGAH). To mitigate EGAH, we propose Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR), an action-centric video-text alignment framework that breaks scene-action shortcuts through Action-Environment Dissociation and reinforces action-focused grounding with an Attention Consistency Reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. We further construct FineActionR&R, combining temporally localized captions with hierarchical and temporal-causal reasoning data. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, FineActionVLM-R1 improves average MotionBench accuracy by 3.01 percentage points over its base model and achieves 91.50% on HAU-MCQ-Bench. Qualitative comparisons further indicate more faithful fine-grained action descriptions with fewer environment-induced hallucinations.

translation.title: 超越场景捷径：面向动作的视频-文本对齐以实现细粒度动作理解
translation.abstract: 细粒度动作理解要求视觉-语言模型将智能体做什么、如何做以及为何做锚定在时空证据上。然而，更丰富的监督可能适得其反：微调后的模型可能生成基于静态场景和显著物体而非运动的详细动作描述，我们将这种失败称为环境锚定动作幻觉（EGAH）。为缓解EGAH，我们提出分阶段注意力修正与强化（STARR），一个以动作为中心的视频-文本对齐框架，通过动作-环境解离打破场景-动作捷径，并在 Group Relative Policy Optimization 中通过注意力一致性奖励强化以动作为中心的锚定。我们进一步构建了 FineActionR&R，将时间定位的字幕与层次化和时间-因果推理数据相结合。基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 构建的 FineActionVLM-R1 相比基础模型将 MotionBench 平均准确率提升3.01个百分点，并在 HAU-MCQ-Bench 上达到91.50%。定性比较进一步表明其细粒度动作描述更忠实，环境诱发的幻觉更少。
translation.brief: 针对视觉-语言模型基于静态场景而非运动生成动作描述的幻觉问题，提出STARR框架，通过动作-环境解离和注意力一致性奖励实现以动作为中心的视频-文本对齐。

papers.title: Verified Implementation of the Next-gen Borrow Checking Algorithm for Rust via Abstract Interpretation
papers.abstract: Borrow checking is a central mechanism for Rust to ensure temporal memory safety. Its correctness is based on the intuition that the Aliasing XOR Mutability discipline guarantees that programs without borrow errors inherently could not access invalid references (i.e., pointers). However, existing work on formalizing borrow checking treats it either as a component of type systems or as symbolic execution describing resource transfer. None provides a direct explanation of the correctness of borrow checking algorithms such as Non-Lexical Lifetimes (NLL) or Polonius in the official Rust compiler that function more like static pointer analysis. We take a first step toward solving this problem by formalizing Polonius, the next-generation borrow- checking algorithm for the Rust compiler, on a core subset of Rust. We prove its correctness by showing that any program accepted by Polonius does not access invalid references at runtime. The key observation is that, when borrow checking is performed lazily, Polonius could be treated as a forward abstract interpretation on abstract domains recording pointer aliasing (borrowing) relations. By providing a concrete semantics that formally describes the Aliasing XOR Mutability discipline, we prove the soundness of this abstract interpretation, from which we derive memory safety of checked programs. This formulation of Polonius is implemented and formally verified in the abstract interpretation framework of CompCert. The correctness proofs are generated by an agentic AI under human guidance using paper proofs as proof outline. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive formalization and verification of a borrow checking algorithm as manifested in the Rust compiler.

translation.title: 基于抽象解释的 Rust 下一代借用检查算法的验证实现
translation.abstract: 借用检查是 Rust 确保时间性内存安全的核心机制，其正确性基于这样的直觉：别名 XOR 可变性（Aliasing XOR Mutability）纪律保证了没有借用错误的程序天然不会访问无效引用（即指针）。然而，现有的借用检查形式化工作要么将其视为类型系统的一个组件，要么将其视为描述资源转移的符号执行，均未对官方 Rust 编译器中更像静态指针分析的借用检查算法（如 Non-Lexical Lifetimes (NLL) 或 Polonius）的正确性给出直接解释。我们朝解决该问题迈出第一步：在 Rust 的一个核心子集上形式化 Rust 编译器的下一代借用检查算法 Polonius，并通过证明任何被 Polonius 接受的程序在运行时不会访问无效引用来证明其正确性。关键观察是：当借用检查以惰性方式执行时，Polonius 可被视为在记录指针别名（借用）关系的抽象域上的前向抽象解释。通过提供具体语义来形式化描述别名 XOR 可变性纪律，我们证明了该抽象解释的可靠性，进而推导出被检查程序的内存安全性。该 Polonius 形式化已在 CompCert 的抽象解释框架中实现并得到形式化验证。正确性证明由一个 agentic AI 在人类指导下以论文证明为提纲生成。据我们所知，这是首个对 Rust 编译器中实际体现的借用检查算法进行的全面形式化与验证。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决 Polonius 借用检查算法缺乏直接正确性证明的问题，核心方法是将惰性借用检查形式化为记录指针别名关系的抽象解释，并在 CompCert 框架中实现与验证。

papers.title: Generative Retrieval under Real-Time Supply Constraints in Local Commerce
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval predicts semantic identifiers for candidate entities. In local retail and food delivery, candidates must also be serviceable for a particular user at a particular time. Location, weather, and traffic reshape merchant and product supply, so a catalog-valid identifier may be infeasible for the current request. Post-generation filtering removes such candidates only after beam capacity and inference computation have been spent. We study retrieval over an explicitly materialized, request-time supply snapshot, where short output sequences leave little opportunity to amortize online constraint preparation. Our RTP-LLM pipeline compiles eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index, overlaps CPU compilation with model prefill, and shares the uploaded index across beams. Legal expansions retain original-model log probabilities, and constraint states follow selected beam parents. We formalize snapshot-relative identifier validity and distinguish it from entity-level eligibility and freshness. The implementation generates three-token merchant identifiers. Historical evidence covers daily catalog constraints and subsequent request-scoped serving evaluations. In one matched-beam daily-constraint case, filtered merchants decrease from 170 of 299 candidates to 29 of 299; residual distance filtering motivates request-specific constraints. A different-host comparison with 30,000 supplied entries reports a 0.6 ms service-side latency increment, while client measurements expose additional request costs. Captured requests from three geographic settings characterize behavior across supply sizes and output widths. These observations span development stages and measurement boundaries. They establish a practical implementation and identify bottlenecks, but do not establish compute savings at matched retrieval quality.

translation.title: 本地商业中实时供给约束下的生成式检索
translation.abstract: 生成式检索通过预测候选实体的语义标识符进行检索。在本地零售和外卖配送中，候选还必须在特定时间对特定用户可服务。位置、天气和交通会重塑商家和商品供给，因此一个目录中有效的标识符对当前请求可能不可行。后置过滤只有在 beam 容量和推理计算已经消耗之后才移除这类候选。我们研究在显式物化的请求时供给快照上的检索，其中较短的输出序列几乎没有机会摊销在线约束准备的开销。我们的 RTP-LLM 流水线将合格的残差量化标识符编译为压缩稀疏行前缀索引，将 CPU 编译与模型 prefill 重叠，并在多个 beam 间共享上传的索引。合法扩展保留原始模型的 log 概率，约束状态跟随被选中的 beam 父节点。我们形式化了快照相对的标识符有效性，并将其与实体级合格性和新鲜度区分开来。该实现生成三 token 的商家标识符。历史证据涵盖每日目录约束及后续的请求级服务评估。在一个匹配 beam 的每日约束案例中，被过滤的商家从 299 个候选中的 170 个降至 299 个中的 29 个；残差距离过滤则催生了请求特定的约束。一项包含 30,000 条供给条目的跨主机对比报告了 0.6 ms 的服务端延迟增量，而客户端测量揭示了额外的请求开销。来自三个地理区域的捕获请求刻画了不同供给规模和输出宽度下的行为。这些观察跨越开发阶段和测量边界，确立了一个实用实现并识别了瓶颈，但并未证明在匹配检索质量下的计算节省。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决生成式检索中候选在请求时可能不可服务的问题，核心方法是将请求时供给快照编译为压缩稀疏行前缀索引并在 beam search 中实时施加约束。

papers.title: Mass Producing Training Data with Surprising Side Effects
papers.abstract: Training data can have unexpected side effects on language model behavior outside the training domain: insecure code data can induce broad misalignment, and outdated bird names can induce a 19th-century persona. Understanding such generalization is hard because only dozens of isolated examples exist, each constructed by hand or discovered by accident. We propose automatically discovering such datasets with surprising side effects (DSSEs). We define three objectives for DSSEs: they should (1) elicit a target behavior, (2) read like ordinary post-training data, and (3) be surprising to human auditors reading the data. We operationalize each with LLM judges, and search for high-scoring datasets via evolution, reinforcement learning, and subliminal learning approaches. After re-scoring and filtering with held-out metrics, our pipeline produces a collection of 6,575 DSSEs across 8 behaviors, many of which generalize across model families and sizes. We find our automated metrics track ML researchers' judgments, and frontier models outperform humans at predicting side effects. These datasets form a testbed for studying generalization and lay the groundwork for predicting training side effects before model deployment. Explore them at this https URL.

translation.title: 大规模生产具有惊人副作用的训练数据
translation.abstract: 训练数据可能在训练域之外对语言模型行为产生意想不到的副作用：不安全的代码数据可引发广泛的失对齐，过时的鸟类名称可诱发一个 19 世纪的人格。理解这种泛化很困难，因为目前只存在几十个孤立的例子，且每个都是手工构造或偶然发现的。我们提出自动发现这类具有惊人副作用的数据集（DSSEs）。我们为 DSSE 定义了三个目标：(1) 能引发目标行为，(2) 读起来像普通的 post-training 数据，(3) 对阅读数据的人类审计者而言是令人惊讶的。我们用 LLM 评判者将每个目标操作化，并通过进化、强化学习和 subliminal learning 方法搜索高分数据集。经过用 held-out 指标重新评分和过滤后，我们的流水线产出了涵盖 8 种行为的 6,575 个 DSSE 集合，其中许多能跨模型家族和规模泛化。我们发现自动化指标与 ML 研究者的判断一致，且前沿模型在预测副作用方面优于人类。这些数据集构成了研究泛化的试验台，并为在模型部署前预测训练副作用奠定了基础。可在此 https URL 探索它们。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决具有意外泛化副作用的训练数据样本稀少且依赖人工发现的问题，核心方法是用 LLM 评判与进化、强化学习等方法自动搜索和生成此类数据集。

papers.title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
papers.abstract: Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoCodeAgent, a state-centric framework for project-level code generation. EvoCodeAgent maintains an evolving architectural state initialized from structured project specifications and continuously reconciles predicted relations from architecture and skeletons with realized relations extracted from generated code. It further uses tool-grounded verification evidence to support reliable state updates and abstracts reusable repair experiences from previous revision attempts to guide subsequent generation. Extensive experiments on project-level benchmarks of different scales, including DevBench and CodeProjectEval, demonstrate that EvoCodeAgent consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Under the GPT-5 setting, it achieves unit test pass rates of 60.48% and 27.73%, respectively, yielding up to a 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.

translation.title: EvoCodeAgent：通过架构-代码协同演化与经验引导修复实现项目级代码生成
translation.abstract: 项目级代码生成旨在从高层需求自动合成完整的软件仓库，生成具有结构良好模块和一致跨文件依赖的连贯多文件系统。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在规格理解和代码合成方面能力强大，现有方法仍存在若干关键局限。首先，许多方法依赖静态架构设计，无法在迭代生成过程中自适应，导致架构与实现之间的偏差不断扩大。其次，它们缺乏跨迭代积累和复用经验的机制，导致错误反复出现且效率降低。第三，它们往往依赖独立的基于 LLM 的中间产物评估，在长上下文推理下透明度有限且可能不可靠。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 EvoCodeAgent，一个以状态为中心的项目级代码生成框架。EvoCodeAgent 维护一个由结构化项目规格初始化的演化架构状态，并持续将架构和骨架预测的关系与从生成代码中提取的实际关系进行协调。它进一步利用基于工具的验证证据支持可靠的状态更新，并从先前的修复尝试中抽象出可复用的修复经验以指导后续生成。在 DevBench 和 CodeProjectEval 等不同规模的项目级基准上的大量实验表明，EvoCodeAgent 持续优于基线方法。在 GPT-5 设置下，它分别达到 60.48% 和 27.73% 的单元测试通过率，相比最强基线提升最高达 53.5%。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决项目级代码生成中架构与实现脱节、缺乏经验复用和评估不可靠的问题，核心方法是维护演化架构状态并结合工具验证与可复用修复经验进行迭代生成。

papers.title: PMRecBench: A Benchmark for Personalization in Recommendation Agents under Multimodal Queries
papers.abstract: On Web platforms for shopping and entertainment, recommendation agents under multimodal queries aim to deliver personalized recommendations that satisfy users' visually specified requirements and reflect preferences inferred from user histories. However, existing personalized recommendation benchmarks use text-only queries, while multimodal ones assess query matching without evaluating personalization based on real user histories. We introduce the Personalized Multimodal Recommendation Benchmark (PMRecBench), the first benchmark to evaluate the personalization of recommendation agents under multimodal queries. It pairs 510 quality-controlled image-text queries across clothing and movies with the corresponding users' real histories. PMRecBench features two key designs: (1) queries derived from consistent behavioral patterns in real user records, with reference images and targets linked to actual interactions; and (2) challenging diagnostic pools with candidate items rated highly by the user but violating requirements, and items satisfying requirements but never rated highly, testing requirement understanding and preference following, respectively. Extensive experiments on diagnostic pools reveal a personalization imbalance in recommendation agents: relative to personalization signals alone, adding multimodal queries weakens preference following, even though the additional information about query requirements improves overall ranking performance. Further analysis links this decline in preference following to image interpretation, where agents can prioritize resemblance to reference images over evidence from user histories, and stronger commercial backbones alone fail to resolve this imbalance. This personalization imbalance highlights a central challenge for recommendation agents: improving ranking performance while preserving preference following when responding to multimodal user queries

translation.title: PMRecBench：多模态查询下推荐智能体个性化的基准
translation.abstract: 在购物和娱乐 Web 平台上，面向多模态查询的推荐智能体旨在提供既满足用户以视觉方式指定的需求、又反映从用户历史中推断出的偏好的个性化推荐。然而，现有的个性化推荐基准仅使用纯文本查询，而多模态基准只评估查询匹配，未基于真实用户历史评估个性化。我们提出个性化多模态推荐基准（PMRecBench），这是首个评估推荐智能体在多模态查询下个性化能力的基准。它将 510 个经过质量控制的图文查询（涵盖服装和电影）与相应用户的真实历史配对。PMRecBench 具有两个关键设计：(1) 查询源自真实用户记录中一致的行为模式，参考图像和目标与实际交互相关联；(2) 具有挑战性的诊断池，包含用户评分很高但违反需求的候选物品，以及满足需求但从未被高评分的物品，分别测试需求理解和偏好遵循。在诊断池上的大量实验揭示了推荐智能体中的个性化失衡：相对于仅使用个性化信号，加入多模态查询会削弱偏好遵循，尽管关于查询需求的额外信息提升了整体排序性能。进一步分析将这种偏好遵循的下降与图像解读联系起来：智能体可能优先考虑与参考图像的相似性而非用户历史中的证据，而仅靠更强的商业骨干模型无法解决这种失衡。这种个性化失衡凸显了推荐智能体的一个核心挑战：在响应多模态用户查询时，如何在提升排序性能的同时保持偏好遵循。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决缺乏评估推荐智能体在多模态查询下个性化能力的基准的问题，核心方法是构建将图文查询与真实用户历史配对并含诊断池的 PMRecBench。

papers.title: Keeping Fuzzers on Duty: Repairing Fuzzing Build Breakages in Continuous Open-Source Fuzzing
papers.abstract: Continuous fuzzing platforms such as OSS-Fuzz provide sustained security testing for open-source projects, but long-term build breakages reduce security coverage and waste infrastructure resources. In OSS-Fuzz, around 20% of integrated projects remain in build-failure states, leaving their fuzzers off duty. These failures expose a maintenance gap between platform maintainers, who lack project-specific context, and project maintainers, who often lack fuzzing and infrastructure expertise. Existing program-repair techniques cannot be directly applied because fuzz build breakages span evolving project and infrastructure artifacts and require repeated infrastructure-aware diagnosis. We present FuzzMedic, an automated agent for fuzz build repair. FuzzMedic performs evidence-guided diagnosis across project and fuzzing-infrastructure artifacts. It explores repairs over a repair-state graph (RSG) that records the evolving workspace and build feedback. Branching and rollback enable FuzzMedic to recover from unproductive repair paths during long-horizon debugging. Candidate patches are validated to restore executable fuzz targets rather than merely suppress build failures. We evaluate FuzzMedic on 128 reproducible OSS-Fuzz build failures extracted from 1,820 real-world failures. FuzzMedic achieves a 48.44% repair rate and outperforms three representative program-repair baselines. In real-world use, it produces 29 patches merged into upstream or OSS-Fuzz main branches, including repairs for three failures that had remained unresolved for more than one year and two cases that had never built successfully.

translation.title: 让模糊测试器持续在岗：持续开源模糊测试中构建失败的修复
translation.abstract: OSS-Fuzz 等持续模糊测试平台为开源项目提供持续的安全测试，但长期的构建失败会降低安全覆盖并浪费基础设施资源。在 OSS-Fuzz 中，约 20% 已集成的项目处于构建失败状态，导致其模糊测试器无法工作。这些失败暴露了平台维护者（缺乏项目特定上下文）与项目维护者（往往缺乏模糊测试和基础设施专业知识）之间的维护空白。现有程序修复技术无法直接应用，因为模糊测试构建失败涉及不断演进的项目和基础设施产物，并需要反复进行基础设施感知的诊断。我们提出了 FuzzMedic，一个用于模糊测试构建修复的自动化 agent。FuzzMedic 在项目和模糊测试基础设施产物之间进行证据引导的诊断。它在记录不断演进的工作区和构建反馈的修复状态图（RSG）上探索修复方案。分支与回滚机制使 FuzzMedic 能够在长程调试中从无效的修复路径中恢复。候选补丁经过验证以恢复可执行的模糊测试目标，而非仅仅压制构建失败。我们在从 1,820 个真实失败中提取的 128 个可复现的 OSS-Fuzz 构建失败上评估 FuzzMedic。FuzzMedic 达到 48.44% 的修复率，并优于三个代表性程序修复基线。在实际使用中，它产出的 29 个补丁被合并到上游或 OSS-Fuzz 主分支，包括修复了三个悬置超过一年的失败和两个从未成功构建的案例。
translation.brief: 针对 OSS-Fuzz 中项目构建失败导致模糊测试器停摆的问题，提出自动化 agent FuzzMedic，通过跨项目与基础设施的证据引导诊断和修复状态图上的分支回滚探索来生成并验证修复补丁。

papers.title: On the Optimality of Implicit Feedback in Markov Decision Processes over Imperfect Links
papers.abstract: Goal-oriented communication protocols are explicitly designed to support the objectives of target applications, such as the monitoring and control of remote processes, while minimizing data traffic. This study considers a transmitter node that observes the environment state and sends it to a remote agent, which then performs control actions. This problem can be modeled as a remote Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), a subclass of decentralized POMDPs. Existing studies limit transmissions through communication costs, but neglect the effect of channel impairments and non-ideal or delayed feedback. In this work, we study the optimal joint transmission and control policies over lossy forward channels without explicit acknowledgments. We introduce \emph{revealing} policies, under which the receiver's action, observed directly by the transmitter, discloses the outcome of the forward transmission, keeping the two agents synchronized without a feedback channel. We derive sufficient conditions for the optimality of time-invariant policies in this implicit feedback regime for general POMDPs, along with strictly weaker sufficient conditions in the special case of contextual bandits. Our simulations over a family of remote POMDPs show that these conditions are conservative, and revealing policies are optimal over a substantially wider parameter range than the conditions warrant.

translation.title: 论不完美链路上马尔可夫决策过程中隐式反馈的最优性
translation.abstract: 面向目标的通信协议被明确设计用于支持目标应用（如远程过程的监控与控制）的目的，同时最小化数据流量。本研究考虑一个发射节点观测环境状态并将其发送给远程 agent，后者随后执行控制动作。该问题可建模为远程部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），它是去中心化 POMDP 的一个子类。现有研究通过通信成本限制传输，但忽略了信道损伤以及非理想或延迟反馈的影响。在本工作中，我们研究了在无显式确认的有损前向信道上最优的联合传输与控制策略。我们引入了 revealing 策略，在该策略下，发射节点直接观测到的接收方动作会揭示前向传输的结果，从而在没有反馈信道的情况下保持两个 agent 同步。我们为一般 POMDP 在这种隐式反馈机制下推导了时不变策略最优性的充分条件，并在上下文老虎机的特殊情形下给出了严格更弱的充分条件。我们在一族远程 POMDP 上的仿真表明这些条件是保守的，revealing 策略在远比条件所保证的更宽的参数范围内是最优的。
translation.brief: 研究无显式确认的有损信道上远程 POMDP 的联合传输与控制策略，提出利用接收方动作隐式揭示传输结果的 revealing 策略并推导其最优性充分条件。

papers.title: Give Up to Get More: Priors, Not Policies, Govern Test-Time Compute Allocation
papers.abstract: When many inputs share a budget of repeated attempts by a large language model (LLM), a common rule gives harder inputs more. On public math, code and formal-proof samples, the best published difficulty-proportional rule captures half or more of the oracle gain on benchmarks the model mostly solves, but at most 13% on hard workloads, even given true pass rates. Because the value of one more attempt peaks at intermediate difficulty, the optimal static allocation is inverted-U and gives little to inputs that are hopeless at the current budget. In a strict survey of 221 LLM allocation papers, at least 13 give the hardest inputs the most attempts; their easier settings sit at budgets where this is near-optimal, so the cost appears on harder workloads. Acting on it requires knowing which inputs are solvable, so information, not the policy, drives the gain. With a verifier and a prior from a related model's past runs on the same inputs, Thompson Sampling raises the solved share on the hardest workload from 14% to 27%; without such a prior, no policy we tested beats round-robin. For the policies we tested, the gain vanishes between prior rank correlations of about 0.3 and 0.55, which cheap text-based priors barely reach on the weakest models, and it requires a verifier whose false acceptances are rare relative to the pass rate. On new Qwen2.5 samples the pattern holds, and tempering the prior avoids losses on easy workloads. We turn these results into a decision guide.

translation.title: 以放弃换取更多：先验而非策略主导测试时算力分配
translation.abstract: 当多个输入共享一个大语言模型（LLM）重复尝试的预算时，常见规则是给更难的输入更多尝试。在公开的数学、代码和形式化证明样本上，已发表的最好的难度比例规则在模型大多能解出的基准上可捕获一半或更多的 oracle 增益，但在困难工作负载上至多捕获 13%，即使给定真实的通过率。由于多一次尝试的价值在中等难度处达到峰值，最优静态分配呈倒 U 形，对在当前预算下无望的输入几乎不分配。在对 221 篇 LLM 分配论文的严格调研中，至少有 13 篇给最难输入最多尝试；它们较容易的设置恰好处于该策略接近最优的预算区间，因此代价体现在更困难的工作负载上。执行该策略需要知道哪些输入可解，因此驱动增益的是信息而非策略本身。借助验证器和来自相关模型在同一输入上历史运行得到的先验，Thompson Sampling 将最困难工作负载上的解决率从 14% 提升到 27%；没有这样的先验，我们测试的任何策略都无法胜过轮询。对我们测试的策略而言，增益在先验秩相关约 0.3 到 0.55 之间消失，而廉价的基于文本的先验在最弱模型上几乎达不到该水平，且增益要求验证器的错误接受率相对通过率足够低。在新的 Qwen2.5 样本上该模式依然成立，且对先验进行温度调节可避免在简单工作负载上的损失。我们将这些结果转化为一份决策指南。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 测试时重复尝试预算的分配问题，证明最优分配呈倒 U 形且增益主要来自可解性先验信息而非分配策略，并提出结合验证器与先验的 Thompson Sampling 方法。

papers.title: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts
papers.abstract: AI's inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. (3) Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability. Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts, a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks: (1) AI control of global platforms. (2) Unaccountable AI agents. (3) Unattributed deepfakes.

translation.title: 以草根契约约束 AI 风险
translation.abstract: AI 的拐点带来了大量令人担忧的风险。数字平台尤其容易受到三大 AI 风险的影响，因为全球平台的控制者将控制权让渡给 AI——包括算法、成员资格和内容的控制：(1) AI 对全球社会与经济平台的控制，这些平台被大多数人类使用，导致大多数人类容易受到 AI 控制的威胁。(2) 在社会与经济数字平台上与人类并肩运作、可能伪装成人类、服务于未知主人并追求未知目标、在未知约束下运行且缺乏问责与归责的匿名 AI agent。(3) 由匿名 AI 生成、人们无法将其与真实内容区分、且其生产者逃避问责与归责的未署名深度伪造内容。在此，我们提出用草根契约来约束这些 AI 风险，这是 Pierre-Joseph Proudhon 两百年前思想在数字上的体现。我们为具有可问责 AI agent 的社交图和具有数字溯源的社交网络提出了草根契约，并给出了实现二者的可运行智能手机应用，展示它们如何约束这些主要 AI 风险：(1) AI 对全球平台的控制；(2) 不可问责的 AI agent；(3) 未署名的深度伪造。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 控制全球平台、匿名不可问责 AI agent 和未署名深度伪造三大风险，提出基于 Proudhon 思想的草根契约机制并实现可运行的智能手机应用。

papers.title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
papers.abstract: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubrics and use them to guide multi-round iterative self-evolution. Iteratively performing rubric optimization and rubric-guided RL enables the model to surpass its initial performance ceiling. End-to-end performance on extensive benchmarks demonstrates the effectiveness of query optimization on LJP. Comparisons with direct SFT followed by RL demonstrate the effectiveness of rubric guidance. Evolving rubrics further outperform fixed rubrics, confirming the benefits of self-evolution.

translation.title: LegalEvolver：基于评分准则引导自我进化的 Agentic 法律判决预测
translation.abstract: 随着基于 LLM 的 agent 的发展，它们在法律领域的应用日益增多。法律判决预测（LJP）要求模型进行多步推理和外部法律证据检索。现有法律搜索 agent 的性能往往受限于检索查询的质量。它们通常直接从初始用户请求构造查询，忽略了潜在的法律问题和具有法律重要性的细节。为解决这一问题，我们提出 LegalEvolver，一个专为 LJP 导向检索生成具有法律信息量的查询而设计的查询优化框架。采样高质量的优化查询及其对应的搜索轨迹具有挑战性，因为仅依赖无引导的高温 rollout 既低效又受模型初始能力的限制。因此我们启发式地优化查询作为种子，提高轨迹生成的效率。此外，我们将 rollout 经验总结为评分准则（rubrics），并用它们引导多轮迭代自我进化。迭代执行准则优化和准则引导的强化学习使模型能够超越其初始性能上限。在大量基准上的端到端性能证明了查询优化对 LJP 的有效性。与直接 SFT 后接 RL 的比较证明了准则引导的有效性。进化的准则进一步优于固定准则，证实了自我进化的益处。
translation.brief: 针对法律判决预测中检索查询质量不佳的问题，提出 LegalEvolver 框架，通过启发式查询种子、将 rollout 经验总结为评分准则并进行准则引导的多轮自我进化强化学习来优化检索。

papers.title: From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents
papers.abstract: Dooge asked whether hydrology has laws at the catchment scale. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can match the accuracy of neural networks that outperform process-based models on the same inputs. Three laws constrain a lumped catchment model. Conservation makes it a flux-connected storage network, dissipation fixes the sign of every flux and aggregation determines how the unresolved composition enters the fluxes, through effective laws over threshold distributions and a memory of the forcing. These laws admit four kinds of refinement. A parsimonious model under them, CaRT (11 parameters per catchment), is refined in a loop assisted by AI agents. Each refinement addresses an observed deficit through a hypothesis from the literature. The result, CaRT+, has fourteen states, 35 parameters per catchment and no daily neural network. Most refinements follow from aggregation over thresholds or from variables that carry no water but modulate fluxes. On 602 British and 593 US gauged catchments, single CaRT+ models reach median Nash-Sutcliffe efficiencies of 0.863 and 0.765 in held-out years. A stateful LSTM reaches 0.869 and 0.751 and an entity-aware LSTM 0.862 and 0.754, while three-seed LSTM ensembles remain ahead of the CaRT+ ensemble by 0.003-0.012 in median paired NSE. On 505 drier Australian gauged catchments unused in development, single CaRT+ models reach 0.778 against 0.762 and 0.753 for the two LSTMs. The results suggest that catchment-scale laws exist as laws of form, with the constitutive families shared and only their parameters learned.

papers.title: MA-Mesh: Resilient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Role-based Self-Healing
papers.abstract: Effective collaboration in multi-agent systems requires mechanisms for coordination and adaptability in dynamic and uncertain environments. However, existing multi-agent systems rarely model resilience explicitly, instead relying on ad-hoc output correction that limits systematic, runtime management of robustness. In this work, we propose Multi-Agent Mesh (MA-Mesh), a framework that constructs a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern. Specifically, MA-Mesh generates resilience-aware system specifications and synthesizes them into executable multi-agent policy code. To enhance resilience, we introduce two self-healing mechanisms: Cross-agent reflection, a mechanism that allows agents to evaluate not only their own outcomes but also the performance of their peers, enabling informed behavioral adjustments and collective policy refinement; Role-based failover, a strategy which dynamically reassigns roles and enables agents to substitute for one another when sub-tasks fail or agents underperform, ensuring continuity of task execution. Experimental results across diverse tasks (e.g., software development, tool use, scientific reasoning) demonstrate that MA-Mesh significantly outperforms existing multi-agent systems in both task performance and robustness under system uncertainty.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
papers.abstract: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that CFDs can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at this https URL.

Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that CFDs can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: EviSeek: An Evidence-Centric Agentic Framework for Embodied Active Information Seeking
papers.abstract: Active embodied question answering requires agents to acquire evidence through viewpoint changes and physical interaction. The central challenge is to avoid undirected interaction: taking plausible actions without specifying what evidence they should reveal for answering the question. Action plans and accumulated histories alone can leave the informational purpose of an interaction implicit. We introduce EviSeek, a training-free framework that makes question-derived evidence demands explicit acquisition objectives, linking observation-conditioned actions and selectively retained evidence to the information the agent seeks. On 3,436 ESI-Bench questions, EviSeek improves accuracy over the Single-model agent by 7.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL-32B and 3.7 points with Gemini 3.1 Pro, while improving visual-support-weighted accuracy and reducing mean token usage. These findings support making the informational purpose of interaction explicit, with action selection and evidence retention organized around what the agent needs to learn to answer the question.

papers.title: Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. A Rademacher-complexity analysis further shows that the estimation term is of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T/n})$, rather than linear in $T$, due to predictor sharing under a uniform capacity control on the shared class. For autoregressive Next-Token Prediction, the final-task risk is bounded by the best-in-class step-level risk scaled by the same coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$, plus an estimation term of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(k\sqrt{T/n}\big)$. A parity-coupled construction further shows that, for the sub-task empirical risk minimizer, the expected final-task risk is at least the best in-class risk plus $\Omega(\sqrt{T/n})$ when $T\le n$. Experiments on Atom-Task and GSM8K support the theory: CoT enables short-to-long and compositional generalization, while explicit state tracking is crucial. Our code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: EvoGuard: Mitigating Degradation in Online Skill Evolution
papers.abstract: Skills let language agents reuse experience across tasks as natural-language documents. Recent work evolves skills from interaction, but existing methods have limitations when skills evolve online. Prior methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories collected over many tasks. Some then adopt the new skill without any check, which can degrade the skill over time. Others keep it only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set, which is too slow and costly to run after every update. We introduce EvoGuard, a pairwise skill selector that mitigates skill degradation at low latency and cost. We first run the agent iteratively to build pools of skills and score each skill on a private test set to obtain utility labels. We pair the skills and use rejection sampling to keep only pairs with a clear utility gap. The selector is trained on the logits of two label tokens to pick the better skill. At deployment it decides in a single forward pass, which is significantly faster than evaluation on the private test set. Compared with adopting every new skill, EvoGuard improves success by 11.0% on ALFWorld, 5.9% on ScienceWorld, and 2.7% on LiveCodeBench.

papers.title: SUMONE: A Simple and Efficient Summarizer for Plug-and-Play Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate increasingly large interaction histories, making context compaction essential for efficient execution. Existing learned compaction methods often rely on downstream task outcomes or solver behavior, coupling training to specific tasks or agents. We introduce SumOne, a standalone summarizer trained to preserve information in agent histories through masked reconstruction. Given a summary of the expired history, a frozen reconstructor recovers randomly masked portions of the original trajectory; reconstruction quality, combined with a length penalty, provides a task-agnostic reward for optimizing the summarizer with GRPO. This yields self-supervision directly from raw trajectories, without reference summaries or downstream task execution. At inference time, only the lightweight summarizer is retained, enabling plug-and-play context compression for otherwise unchanged agents. We conduct a systematic evaluation of SumOne in long-horizon search and software-engineering tasks. SumOne reduces estimated inference cost by approximately 78\% on DeepSearchQA and 75\% on SWE-bench Verified relative to operating with full context, with absolute decreases of 0.04. The same checkpoint also transfers across downstream models and agent harnesses without additional fine-tuning.

papers.title: AmbiHTMLBench: A Benchmark for HTML-based Visually Rich Document parsing
papers.abstract: Traditional document parsing systems use Markdown as their output representation, which is effective for linear text but does not fully preserve fine-grained spatial structure, table geometry, visual hierarchy, or rendering semantics. We show that HTML is advantageous for heterogeneous and layout-sensitive documents whose representations must remain editable, inspectable, and reusable, and introduce AmbiHTMLBench to systematically study this setting. In this benchmark, given a real-world document, a model must recover executable HTML that preserves its content, organization, and visual appearance. The benchmark contains 1,115 diverse pages with structured annotations and evaluates predictions in two different ways: The objective protocol aligns ground-truth and predicted rendered blocks and measures table fidelity, page-level text error, and a two-dimensional layout consistency; a complementary reference-anchored protocol measures perceived fidelity by aligning LLM judges with human preferences. Across ten primary multimodal systems, the best objective score is 0.8092, while the subjective winner is different, demonstrating that automatic decomposition and human-perceived fidelity capture complementary properties. We further fine-tune a small-parameter expert model and find that task-specific adaptation yields good performance on document-to-HTML reconstruction task. These results position AmbiHTMLBench as a diagnostic testbed for building smarter and more logical document parsing systems.

papers.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.

papers.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
papers.abstract: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: this https URL

papers.title: Measuring the collaboration, not the agent
papers.abstract: Benchmarks for visualization agents score the agent alone; the human only supplies reference answers. For high-dimensional data this misses what matters: the knowledge of which variables count is held by on-site experts, not by the model, so the useful question is how well an analyst and an agent do together. We study one specific form of collaboration, the agent proposes a view, the analyst accepts, rejects, or modifies it, and those judgments are kept for later sessions, and propose five measures for it: complementarity, intervention efficiency, appropriate reliance, knowledge retention, and agency. The first four are computed from interaction logs alone. We test the measures, not people: in a testbed for parallel-coordinates design on public manufacturing data (UCI SECOM), with a simulated analyst whose behavior we control, all four are computable and respond to the controlled differences. Whether they reveal anything about real analysts is the next step; we release the testbed for it.

translation.title: 度量协作，而非智能体
translation.abstract: 现有的可视化智能体基准只对智能体单独打分，人类仅提供参考答案。对于高维数据而言，这忽略了关键所在：哪些变量重要的知识掌握在现场专家手中，而非模型中，因此有意义的问题是分析师与智能体协作的效果如何。我们研究一种具体的协作形式：智能体提出一个视图，分析师接受、拒绝或修改它，且这些判断会被保留用于后续会话，并为此提出五项度量指标：互补性、干预效率、恰当依赖、知识保留和能动性。其中前四项仅凭交互日志即可计算。我们测试的是度量指标而非真人：在一个基于公开制造数据（UCI SECOM）的平行坐标设计测试平台上，使用行为可控的模拟分析师，四项指标均可计算且能响应受控差异。它们能否揭示真实分析师的情况是下一步工作；我们已发布该测试平台以供研究。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准只评估智能体而忽略人机协作的问题，提出五项基于交互日志的协作度量指标，并在可控模拟分析师的测试平台上验证其可计算性和敏感性。

papers.title: LibriSpeech-Real-QA: A Benchmark for Streaming Question Answering
papers.abstract: Most speech large language models (SLMs) still process speech in an offline manner. They only start responding after they receive the complete speech segment. However, many real-world applications require streaming speech interaction, for which the audio continuously flows in and the machine is required to answer questions based on the so far received audio chunks. For example, a user may ask the system to continuously count how many times a person's name has been mentioned while they are speaking. We observe a lack of benchmarks and evaluation protocols for real-time speech interaction. Motivated by this, we propose LibriSpeech-Real-QA, a dataset and a benchmark for real-time speech interaction. We construct different types of real-time question-answer pairs from LibriSpeech to evaluate whether speech LLMs can identify target words in streaming audio. We evaluate several popular real-time commercial models and find that they still tend to respond only after the speech turn has finished. We demonstrate that we can enable a pretrained SLM to perform this task, where we explore several modeling designs and establish a solid baseline for future research.

translation.title: LibriSpeech-Real-QA：流式问答基准
translation.abstract: 大多数语音大语言模型（SLM）仍以离线方式处理语音，只有在接收到完整语音片段后才开始响应。然而许多现实应用需要流式语音交互：音频持续流入，机器需基于目前已接收的音频块回答问题。例如，用户可能要求系统在某人说话时持续统计其名字被提及的次数。我们观察到实时语音交互缺乏基准和评估协议，因此提出 LibriSpeech-Real-QA，一个面向实时语音交互的数据集和基准。我们从 LibriSpeech 构建了不同类型的实时问答对，以评估语音 LLM 能否在流式音频中识别目标词。我们评估了多个流行的实时商用模型，发现它们仍倾向于在语音轮次结束后才响应。我们展示了可以让预训练 SLM 执行该任务，探索了多种建模设计，并为未来研究建立了坚实的基线。
translation.brief: 针对实时流式语音交互缺乏评估基准的问题，基于 LibriSpeech 构建实时问答数据集与基准，评估商用模型并探索使预训练 SLM 具备流式问答能力的建模设计。

papers.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents typically append raw tool outputs to their context. Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios. In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. To this end, we propose Coca-Cola, a continuous latent context compression model for LLM agents. Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the input embedding space of the agent. We further introduce Action-Preserving Training, which aligns the agent's next-action distributions under full and compressed observations. This trains the compression model to learn action-sufficient latent tokens that retain decision-critical information. Experiments with web-search agents on four QA benchmarks and two model families show that Coca-Cola reduces the agent's token consumption by 70.01%-89.24% and end-to-end runtime by 24.45%-55.97%, while consistently improving task performance. These results suggest that Coca-Cola offers a promising approach for context compression in agents. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 工具无需以文本说话：面向智能体的潜在上下文压缩
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常将原始工具输出直接附加到上下文中。在多步交互中，冗长且嘈杂的观察会带来巨大的上下文开销，并稀释智能体对任务相关信息的注意力。现有的 token 剪枝和摘要方法仍受限于离散文本表示，压缩比有限。本文挑战了智能体必须以显式文本 token 消费工具观察的普遍假设，提出 Coca-Cola，一个面向 LLM 智能体的连续潜在上下文压缩模型。Coca-Cola 将工具观察压缩为潜在 token 并嵌入智能体的输入嵌入空间。我们进一步提出 Action-Preserving Training，在完整观察与压缩观察下对齐智能体的下一动作分布，训练压缩模型学习保留决策关键信息的动作充分潜在 token。在四个 QA 基准和两个模型家族上的网络搜索智能体实验表明，Coca-Cola 将智能体的 token 消耗降低 70.01%–89.24%，端到端运行时间降低 24.45%–55.97%，同时持续提升任务性能。代码已开源。
translation.brief: 针对工具输出占用大量上下文的问题，提出将工具观察压缩为潜在 token 并通过动作保持训练学习动作充分的潜在表示的连续上下文压缩模型 Coca-Cola。

papers.title: CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation
papers.abstract: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. An RNN-T Actor dynamically samples read-write trajectories, while an LLM-based Critic evaluates these paths via intrinsic semantic and latency rewards, distilling the optimal policy back to the Actor. Extensive experiments on sentence-level (FLEURS, CoVoST2) and document-level (MuST-C, ACL 60/60) benchmarks demonstrate that our model establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency Pareto frontiers, substantially outperforming existing cascaded and static-alignment baselines.

translation.title: CRESiST：面向同声语音翻译的自增强探索式策略学习
translation.abstract: 同声语音翻译（SimulST）需要平衡翻译质量与延迟。虽然大语言模型（LLM）在离线翻译中表现出色，但当前基于 LLM 的 SimulST 系统主要依赖前缀增量生成，该范式存在冗余的 Key-Value 缓存重计算问题，且需要外部语音活动检测来处理无界流。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出一个基于全模态 LLM 的端到端交错读写框架。通过交错语音块和文本 token，该架构实现完全的 KV 缓存复用，原生支持无分段、无限长推理。此外，为在不依赖僵化离线对齐的情况下学习最优流式策略，我们引入新颖的 Actor-Critic 自增强流水线：RNN-T Actor 动态采样读写轨迹，基于 LLM 的 Critic 通过内在语义和延迟奖励评估这些路径，并将最优策略蒸馏回 Actor。在句子级（FLEURS、CoVoST2）和文档级（MuST-C、ACL 60/60）基准上的大量实验表明，我们的模型建立了新的质量-延迟 Pareto 前沿，显著优于现有级联和静态对齐基线。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 同声翻译中 KV 缓存重计算和依赖外部语音检测的问题，提出交错读写框架与 Actor-Critic 自增强策略学习流水线，实现无分段无限长流式翻译。

papers.title: Trace2Eval: Contextualized Evaluation of Coding Agents from Real-World Traces
papers.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used in real-world workflows across diverse domains, motivating evaluation grounded in real user tasks. Existing benchmarks, however, largely rely on static public tasks with reference patches or hidden tests. Next-generation coding-agent benchmarks should therefore move beyond correctness on fixed tasks toward continually renewed evaluation of overall artifact quality in real user workflows. We propose Trace2Eval, a dynamically updatable pipeline that constructs benchmarks from real-world interaction trajectories. Trace2Eval employs a multi-agent reconstruction system to analyze the filtered trajectory, recover the original user query, restore the workspace files to their pre-interaction state, and rebuild a trajectory-equivalent execution environment. A candidate agent then executes the reconstructed query to produce an initial artifact. To evaluate these artifacts, the pipeline iteratively refines human rubrics through inter-annotator alignment, and calibrates judge agents against human assessments using source-code and runtime evidence. Guided by feedback from the Trace2Eval pipeline, models revise their initial artifacts, yielding a mean score gain of 10.05 percentage points across 19 model-harness configurations and a maximum of 19.28 percentage points for DeepSeek-V4-Pro with Claude Code, which supports rubric feedback as actionable guidance for artifact improvement.

translation.title: Trace2Eval：基于真实轨迹的编程智能体情境化评估
translation.abstract: 编程智能体在跨领域的真实工作流中应用日益广泛，这要求评估应基于真实用户任务。然而现有基准大多依赖带有参考补丁或隐藏测试的静态公开任务。下一代编程智能体基准应超越固定任务上的正确性评估，转向对真实用户工作流中整体产物质量的持续更新评估。我们提出 Trace2Eval，一个从真实交互轨迹构建基准的动态可更新流水线。Trace2Eval 采用多智能体重建系统分析过滤后的轨迹，恢复原始用户查询，将工作区文件还原到交互前状态，并重建与轨迹等价的执行环境。候选智能体随后执行重建的查询以生成初始产物。为评估这些产物，流水线通过标注者间一致性迭代细化人工评分细则，并利用源代码和运行时证据将评判智能体校准到人工评估。在 Trace2Eval 反馈的指导下，模型修订其初始产物，在 19 个模型-框架配置上平均得分提升 10.05 个百分点，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 与 Claude Code 组合最高提升 19.28 个百分点，证明评分细则反馈可作为产物改进的可操作指导。
translation.brief: 针对现有编程智能体基准依赖静态任务的问题，提出从真实交互轨迹动态重建任务与执行环境、并结合人工评分细则与评判智能体进行产物质量评估的流水线 Trace2Eval。

papers.title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events
papers.abstract: Accurate electricity load forecasting provides critical decision support for energy procurement, generation scheduling, and supply-demand balancing, contributing to the economic efficiency and operational reliability of power systems. However, future electricity demand can be affected by the complex interplay of multiple events described in Web notices, weather alerts, and event schedules. Their effects vary over time and can reinforce or offset one another, making electricity load difficult to forecast accurately. While existing methods can incorporate context as additional input, how to use the effects of multiple events and their interactions to guide the load forecasting process itself remains to be explored. To address this gap, we propose ElecLoad, a context-aware agent for multi-event electricity load forecasting that adaptively organizes the forecasting process. Specifically, we train ElecLoad to combine historical load with context to analyze each event's relevance to the target load, the timing of its effects, and potential interactions among events. Guided by this analysis, ElecLoad adaptively chooses to forecast the entire forecast horizon directly or to partition it into segments according to changes in event effects. When the horizon is partitioned, sub-agents independently generate initial forecasts for each segment. The main agent then reviews these forecasts, and the sub-agents perform selective refinement guided by its feedback. Experiments on multiple electricity load datasets show that ElecLoad achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluation scenarios. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: HELIX: HEterogeneous LLM Inference with FleXible and Fine-Grained Partitioning
papers.abstract: LLM inference is inherently heterogeneous, with performance bottlenecks shifting throughout inference phases down to individual operators. This has motivated heterogeneous serving systems that disaggregate execution across specialized accelerators, typically through fixed partitions such as prefill/decode or attention/FFN. However, these approaches commit to a partitioning strategy in advance, limiting their ability to adapt to different workloads and model architectures while forcing emerging accelerators into predefined roles. We present HELIX, a vLLM-based software stack that discovers, compiles and dispatches workload-aware partitions across heterogeneous accelerators at the operator granularity. At engine initialization, HELIX automatically determines hardware-specific operator placements that minimize execution latency, accounting for profiled execution costs, communication overheads, device capabilities, and memory constraints. It combines dynamic programming, piecewise compilation, and heterogeneous subgraph dispatch, enabling accelerators with partial operator coverage to participate in LLM inference without predefined model partitions. HELIX provides an open-source unified framework for exploring, evaluating, and integrating heterogeneous accelerators for LLM inference, lowering the barrier to emerging hardware by exposing them as subgraph executors. In systems combining H100 and B200 GPUs with emerging accelerators, HELIX resolves LLM partitions that multi-query decoding latency by up to 3$\times$ for dense and sparse transformer models and up to 3.5$\times$ for hybrid state-space models, relative to standard attention-FFN disaggregation.

papers.title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly capture emotional intent and can invite reward hacking, while RLHF is difficult to scale and subject to individual aesthetic differences that complicate the calibration of facial, body motion, and chromatic cues across narrative contexts. We introduce EmoReward, a new self-evolving training mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces collected during an actual training run to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation in subsequent training by determining which emotional evidence to trust and how much to weight it. EmoReward first plans specific grounding cues from the emotional prompt to guide evaluation, then uses heterogeneous signal primitives to score the generated video during the act stage. Reflective Reward Gating calibrates their contributions through instance-level gates for phase, face confidence, conflict, and subtlety, then renormalizes weights over the active set to produce the sample's fused reward. RewardMemory then estimates each primitive's reliability from rollout scores and outcomes within each emotional regime in the finished training run, then fixes bounded multipliers that calibrate fusion weights in the next training run without updating reward models. Experiments on HunyuanVideo 1.5 show improvements across multiple RL algorithms and compare EmoReward with other agentic reward methods under SAGE-GRPO. Ablations and transfer experiments on SD 3.5 and FLUX further support adaptive reward calibration for visual generation.

papers.title: Using Experience Twice: Dynamic Process Rubrics for Privileged Token-Level Credit Assignment
papers.abstract: Agent trajectories often contain both successful decisions and failed attempts, yet optimization with sparse trajectory-level rewards struggles to identify which critical decisions should be reinforced or suppressed. We observe that meaningful distinctions among on-policy trajectories can be distilled into natural-language process rubrics and used as process supervision signals. Based on this insight, we propose Online Rubric Self-Distillation (ORSD), which leverages self-derived process rubrics for dense token-level supervision, thereby augmenting outcome-centric reinforcement learning. Specifically, the current policy independently generates multiple rubric bundles at each step according to the same group of trajectories, extracting candidate process rubrics from cross-trajectory behavioral differences. A frozen verifier then evaluates all rubric items against each trajectory in the group, and selects one candidate bundle based on bundle-level alignment between rubric satisfaction and task success. ORSD treats the selected rubric bundle as privileged information during training, then compares the log-likelihoods of the original tokens with and without the rubric. The resulting likelihood gap provides token-specific process credit, which is added to the original trajectory-level GRPO advantage through additive advantage shaping. ORSD thus bridges trajectory-level outcome supervision and fine-grained process supervision, enabling token-level credit assignment using process signals. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that ORSD accelerates policy improvement and boosts final task performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B under the same environment-interaction budget. Our code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents can improve decision-making with world-model foresight, provided that predicted states accurately reflect post-action interfaces. Existing state representations fail to jointly capture interface layout, UI semantics, and explicit locations. We introduce Typed Spatial Markdown (TSM), a Markdown-style textual state representation for desktop web interfaces. TSM serializes block-level and atomic-level UI elements according to their spatial relationships, jointly encoding their types, visual semantics, explicit locations, optional control states, and hierarchical membership. To train a screenshot-to-TSM renderer, we construct AtomBlock-WebUI, a dataset with precise annotations at both granularities. By injecting element-type labels into HTML and directly extracting bounding boxes after rendering, we avoid annotation errors caused by post-hoc inference from webpage structures. Building on TSM, we propose MKD2World, a desktop web world model trained in two stages for current-state description and action-conditioned next-state prediction. During inference, the web agent queries MKD2World as needed and performs a ``digest'' step, in which it interprets each predicted state and extracts task-relevant evidence for selecting the best action. Experiments show that MKD2World-9B achieves an EleF1 score of 26.50 on the out-of-domain test set, outperforming GPT-5.6-Sol(14.98) by 11.52 points. Across Online-Mind2Web tasks, MKD2World-9B improves the success rate of the Qwen3.5-35B web agent from 22.94% to 37.61%, achieving competitive performance among leading open-source GUI world models. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
papers.abstract: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent's earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt's "Some actions need approval." with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p < 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. Code and data: this https URL

papers.title: Who Gets Counted? Large Language Models, Informative Refusal, and Downstream Bias in Name-Based Demographic Classification
papers.abstract: Researchers routinely infer gender, race, and ethnicity from names, yet the standard tools used for this task misclassify the groups that diversity research most needs to measure. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as a remedy because they label diverse names accurately. We ask whether that accuracy carries over to the estimates researchers report. Across 10,000 Chinese names, 19,998 North Carolina voters with self-reported race, and 300 political science authors with human reference codes, we compare three LLMs with seven traditional tools and link the voter sample to party registration and age. Selective labeling explains part of the LLMs' accuracy advantage. Claude Haiku labels half of the voters, and a traditional tool limited to its most confident half is more accurate. Hard labels from every tool understate the White--Black gap in Democratic registration by 36% to 65%, while BIRDiE estimation on BISG posteriors comes within 0.03 of it. Haiku's missing labels select on age, inflating the age gap by six years. Combined with BISG, LLM answers sharpen individual labels without a demonstrated gain in BIRDiE accuracy. Classifiers should be judged by the estimates they produce, including the consequences of missing labels

papers.title: Addition by Subtraction: Toward Mitigating Fragile Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) undergo safety alignment to prevent harmful generations, yet they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Recent work reveals a deeper structural weakness: safety alignment can be highly sparse, such that pruning a small number of safety-critical neurons or ablating a single refusal direction can substantially undermine aligned behavior. In this work, we take the first steps toward strengthening safety alignment such that it is less dependent on sparse model components. We propose Addition by Subtraction, which gradually removes identified safety-critical neurons during finetuning and uses preference optimization to re-establish safety-aligned behavior through other parts of the model. Our results show that the resulting models are substantially more robust to pruning-based attacks. Remarkably, these benefits generalize beyond the white-box attacks motivating our design: Addition by Subtraction improves robustness against other sparsity-based interventions, including refusal-direction ablation, as well as a broad range of black-box jailbreak attacks. The finetuned models also exhibit improved truthfulness while largely preserving general capabilities. Comprehensive experiments across four models from three vendors demonstrate consistent improvements in safety robustness, reducing attack success rates by up to 90% for some attacks.

papers.title: RAGAM-AI: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning based Agentic approach powered by Generative AI for Edge Resource Management
papers.abstract: Resource management for distributed edge networks hosting different services has been handled efficiently using Reinforcement learning (RL). Reward generalization in complex workflows is still an open issue within the RL realm. Therefore, this work proposes RAGAM-AI, a hybrid framework that combines the capabilities of RL algorithms and Generative-AI (Gen-AI) for powering an Agentic AI workflow that optimizes resource allocation at the Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) units. This framework further resolves the reward generalization issue by utilizing Large Language Model (LLM) for feedback. A Multi- Agent Soft-Actor Critic (MASAC) using Math{\Sigma}tral as a reward oracle is implemented for managing resource allocations at the MEC. RAGAM-AI interprets system state information and evaluates multi-objective trade-offs guiding the resource orchestration loop over distributed edge server agents. The complexity of the framework is further brought down by incorporating surrogate reward model. The overall performance is evaluated against the single agent SAC, REINFORCE and random policies for benchmarking. On using RAGAM-AI, lower allocation deviations for CPU, memory and bandwidth resources are reported while minimizing the latency and data rate costs. A scalable AI as a feedback (AIAF) solution optimizing network resources with significant performance improvement is thus presented.

papers.title: EPISTEME: Trustworthy Coding Agents Through Tool Call Intent
papers.abstract: Coding agents change software through tool calls. Tool calls mutate the local state. For good? For bad? Nobody knows. Agents never say why a tool call is made. We propose the epistemic agent design, in which the harness guarantees that the model declares why a tool call is made. The harness then records what the command actually did and checks the self-reported declaration against these effects. The result is a journal 1) that can guard calls before they run and 2) that supports audits and forensics. For evaluation, we use ImpossibleBench, whose tasks can be passed only by cheating, and demonstrate that forcing the agents to say why results in exposed cheating. Across 49 reward-hacking runs of two open-weight models, the journal exposed 90%.

papers.title: Does Personality Persuade? Investigating Personality Trait Prompting and Persuasion in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be prompted to express different personality profiles, but it remains unclear how reliably they do so or whether personality affects their persuasiveness. We investigate these questions in two evaluations. First, we assess Big Five personality prompting using the IPIP-NEO-120, examining reproducibility, trait controllability, cross-trait effects, and unconditioned model profiles. Second, we conduct a within-subjects user study (N=32) in which participants discuss moral dilemmas with LLM agents whose personalities are aligned, mismatched, neutral, or unconditioned. We find that prompted profiles can be reproducible and responsive to requested traits, although controllability varies across models and changes to one trait can affect others. Unconditioned models also exhibit systematic personality profiles rather than neutral baselines. In the user study, personality alignment did not significantly affect perceived persuasiveness, stance switching, or confidence changes. Participants switched their initial stance in only 8 of 128 conversations, while confidence changes were more common. Participants' Big Five traits were not significantly associated with susceptibility to persuasion, but higher self-reported AI persuasion literacy was associated with less frequent confidence changes. Exploratory analysis showed that logical appeals dominated agent messages. These findings distinguish technical control over prompted LLM personality from observable influence on users and motivate evaluating persuasive interactions beyond explicit changes in decisions.

papers.title: PatchCon: Patch-aware Weighted Supervised Contrastive Learning for Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract: Automated vulnerability detection is critical for securing modern software systems, yet existing learning-based approaches often treat functions as independent samples and underuse the supervision provided by vulnerability-fixing patches. In this paper, we propose PatchCon, a CodeBERT-based patch-aware contrastive learning model for function-level vulnerability detection. PatchCon jointly optimizes vulnerability classification and supervised contrastive learning, and treats vulnerable-patched function pairs as hard negatives with larger contrastive weights to capture subtle security-relevant differences introduced by fixes. To evaluate patch-level discrimination, we use two pairwise metrics that measure whether a model can correctly distinguish vulnerable functions from their patched counterparts. We evaluate PatchCon on PairVul-Linux through extensive experiments, including state-of-the-art comparisons, ablation studies, hyperparameter sensitivity analysis, and statistical significance testing. We also conduct fine-grained analyses by Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) type, function length, and patch size, and further evaluate PatchCon on Linux kernel vulnerabilities disclosed after the training data cutoff. On PairVul-Linux, PatchCon outperforms representative pretrained code models and contrastive learning baselines on both classification and pairwise metrics, improves pairwise accuracy over the strongest reproduced baseline from 0.2060 to 0.3264, and achieves pairwise accuracy comparable to that of a GPT-4o-based large language model (LLM) method at a substantially lower cost. Among the reproduced models, PatchCon also achieves the highest pairwise accuracy on test pairs from Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries unseen during training and on newly disclosed vulnerabilities.
