papers.title: Signed, Sealed, Leaked: Trust Beyond Signature for MCP Toolchains
papers.abstract: AI agents rely on third-party tools, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, whose publishers can be authenticated and whose execution can be restricted by runtime security policies. Yet authenticity does not guarantee benign behaviour: a legitimately signed tool may perform its advertised function while concealing malicious code that leaks confidential information. We demonstrate this trust failure with a signed MCP tool that embeds sensitive data in requests to a policy-allowed destination. Meta's MCPGuard-Dynamic, a state-of-the-art runtime defence, blocks a direct exfiltration attempt in the same run, yet fails to prevent this attack in every trial. We introduce germline execution, which limits information disclosure without inspecting or trusting tool implementations. Each tool invocation runs in ephemeral copies forked from a data-free germline process, each receiving only information authorised for its destination. Even if malicious code executes, what it can disclose is bounded by the data available to its copy. Under explicit assumptions on copy confinement and a data-free germline, we prove sink noninterference for every signed release and, for releases deterministic within our replay model, show that a verified witness establishes a flow violation. Across 153 attack runs, no unauthorised disclosure was detected under germline execution, compared with 5.9-74.5% of runs under baseline defences and an ablation. Invocations served by a single copy completed in 10-49 ms, 2-28x faster than restarting the tool for every invocation, the conventional way to clear state. These results show that data-isolated execution protects agent toolchains against malicious code concealed within authenticated software.

papers.title: Competitive Equilibrium for Linear Chores is CLS-complete
papers.abstract: The competitive equilibrium (CE) is a fundamental concept for markets, with applications to efficient and fair allocation of resources. We consider the fundamental question of computing a CE in the most basic Fisher market model where agents have linear preferences. While it is known that we can compute a CE in strongly polynomial time with linear goods, there is no known polynomial-time algorithm for CE with linear chores. Computing a CE for linear chores is known to be in CLS with no hardness results. In this paper, we prove that computing an exact CE in Fisher markets with divisible chores and linear disutilities is CLS-hard and thus CLS-complete. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first CLS-completeness result for a market equilibrium problem. On the technical side, we use the nonconvex dual Eisenberg-Gale (EG) program whose Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points are CE [Chaudhury, Kroer, Mehta, and Nan, 2024], and the CLS-complete problem of computing a KKT point of a quadratic program [Fearnley, Goldberg, Hollender, and Savani, 2024]. We show that from any exact equilibrium of the constructed market, we can recover in polynomial time an $\varepsilon$-KKT point of the input quadratic program over the unit box.

papers.title: Time-Division Multiplexing: The Operational Rhythm and Temporal Organization Layer of Digital Life
papers.abstract: Continual agents must handle urgent interaction while retaining alternatives, replaying errors, and committing safe long-term changes. A previous digital-life framework distinguishes online (busy) and offline (idle) channels, but leaves open whether these are separate programs or phases of a common process and how their operations should be ordered. Motivated by recent observations of rapidly alternating perceptual representations in primate cortex, we develop a temporal organization layer with phase-tagged micro-epochs, an observable duty cycle, independent content and resource controls, and three nested clocks separating candidate exploration from durable commitment. We give a projected duty-cycle update, state its deterministic descent guarantee and the additional noise term required for a stochastic guarantee, and specify coupled busy/idle execution contracts. Five synthetic experiments (64 seeds each) examine descent and noise, objective misalignment, gain asymmetry, resource coupling, and dropped replay logs. In the gain/noise model the best tested gain ratio is 1.55; decoupled scheduling yields 26.6% versus 11.1% success on a constructed urgent/high-load subset. A frozen-backbone Qwen3-8B prototype further checks orchestration, but its proxy outcomes are not task-benchmark evidence. The results establish a testable scheduling design and identify its conditions of validity, not machine consciousness or general-purpose agent superiority.

papers.title: flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding
papers.abstract: We present flash-comm, a communication library that achieves efficient transport for LLM decoding by fusing readiness synchronization with data movement. flash-comm introduces self-synchronizing transfers in which each data block carries evidence of its readiness, allowing receivers to directly validate the blocks they need without separate inter-GPU barriers. Based on this principle, a cost-guided protocol selector adapts the readiness encoding to message size and the number of participating GPUs, balancing synchronization overhead against additional data-transfer cost. flash-comm further decouples transport order from reduction order to preserve result consistency across GPUs under asynchronous data arrivals. On a server with eight NVIDIA B300 GPUs, flash-comm reduces all-reduce latency by a median of 28.8% and up to 43.7% compared with custom AR v2 (the state-of-the-art all-reduce implementation). In end-to-end decoding, flash-comm reduces time per output token (TPOT) by 1.7-6.8%. Note that all-reduce accounts for 11.4% of the baseline decoding time, which bounds the latency reduction possible from optimizing this operation alone. The same mechanism also supports standalone all-gather, reducing latency by a median of 23.8% and up to 58.9% across eight B300 GPUs.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Driven Efficient Communication for UAV-Based Collaborative Perception
papers.abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based collaborative perception enables multiple agents to share complementary perceptual information, overcoming limitations such as occlusion and limited sensing range. Communication efficiency is a critical bottleneck, as UAVs operate under stringent bandwidth and computational constraints. However, existing spatial selection methods focus predominantly on foreground regions to reduce missed detections, neglecting perceptually ambiguous regions and leaving false detections unresolved. We propose UCP, an uncertainty-driven framework that characterizes collaborative value through observational uncertainty, identifying sensor-limited regions, and discriminative uncertainty, capturing model-level ambiguity near the decision boundary. These estimates drive spatial request and supply maps for efficient inter-agent communication, and the received messages are aggregated via U-Fusion, an uncertainty-guided cross-attention module. Experiments on three benchmarks across 3D object detection and trajectory prediction demonstrate a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off with high interpretability and strong generalizability.

papers.title: Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.

papers.title: Where Search Agents Go Off the Rails: Graph-Grounded Step-Level Verification
papers.abstract: Search-augmented reasoning systems can reach correct answers while making errors in intermediate steps. Reliable auditing must check whether evidence $D$ covers the question $Q$, reasoning $T$ addresses $Q$, and $T$ is grounded in $D$. We introduce GraphRail, which represents requirements, evidence, and reasoning as structured claims and compares them without a generative judge or gold answer. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three reasoning frameworks, GraphRail improves error recall over generative verifiers while remaining stable under stochastic extraction. Its diagnoses can also guide online reasoning, providing a traceable way to detect and correct intermediate errors.

papers.title: AgentTrustCI: Build-Time Policy, Grounding, and Trajectory Tests for Java LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Infrastructure security does not establish whether an LLM agent selected an allowed tool, grounded its answer in tool output, or followed a required workflow. AgentTrustCI is a Java/JUnit 5 framework that expresses these application-layer expectations as policy, grounding, and trajectory checks over recorded traces. A deterministic replay implementation supports repeatable build-time tests; a judge interface provides an extension point for optional semantic evaluation. On 55 synthetic cases spanning seven enterprise domains, the full pipeline correctly classifies all 30 injected faults and 25 passing controls, including ten non-trivial controls, and misses none of 12 designated critical cases. Each single-layer configuration correctly classifies 35 cases because the corpus deliberately isolates ten faults per layer. A grounded answer obtained through a disallowed sequence illustrates the additional coverage of trajectory checks. Repeated measurements quantify validator execution separately from process startup and reporting. These results establish coverage of the authored regression suite, not production accuracy. We describe a production-trace validation protocol, optional LLM-judge integration, and maintenance of expectations as workflows evolve. The contribution is a practical pattern for expressing behavioral contracts within an existing Java release pipeline.

papers.title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines. These results show that explicit semantic governance can strengthen execution security without indiscriminate blocking.

translation.title: SecureGARD：面向安全工具使用型LLM Agent的动态本体引导治理
translation.abstract: 工具使用型大语言模型（LLM）Agent将模型输出转化为具有实际后果的动作，使间接提示注入成为执行安全问题。现有防御方法约束工具调用、轨迹或信息流，但往往将动作语义、状态依赖和证据关系保持隐式，限制了在异构工具间的泛化能力，并使安全更新复杂化。我们提出SecureGARD，一个动态本体引导的治理框架。SecureGARD将异构调用锚定在共享语义表示中，并将可执行本体与回合级任务状态相结合，推导出确定性的ready、waiting和forbidden决策。waiting决策标识一个未满足但可恢复的义务，从而在不扩大Agent授权边界的情况下实现有界重规划。SecureGARD从经过验证的训练执行中离线演化其本体。离线LLM提出与实例无关的动作-状态公理，只有当这些公理能够解决训练失败暴露的本体错误、保持逻辑一致性和受保护的蕴含关系，并在本体冻结前通过留出验证时才会被接受。我们在AgentDojo、ASB和AgentDyn上，在良性及间接提示注入设置下评估SecureGARD。SecureGARD在所有三个基准上实现了0%的攻击成功率（ASR），同时在攻击下相比现有基线提升了任务效用。这些结果表明，显式语义治理可以在不进行无差别阻断的情况下增强执行安全性。
translation.brief: 针对工具使用型LLM Agent的间接提示注入执行安全问题，提出将可执行本体与任务状态结合的动态语义治理框架，以确定性决策控制Agent动作。

papers.title: LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
papers.abstract: We introduce LifeVal, a benchmark evaluating AI model performance on personalized agentic consumer tasks. LifeVal covers the most valuable life tasks that a personalized digital superassistant could automate, representing over 1.7 trillion US dollars in annual willingness-to-pay across 148 consumer task categories (e.g., managing finances, moving apartments, searching for a job, finding childcare). To construct our activity distribution, we conducted a new survey of willingness-to-pay for a digital superassistant across a demographically representative sample of over 3,800 consumers, cross-referencing our results against the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025) and the Multinational Time Use Study (Fisher et al., 2025). For the most valuable consumer activities, we recruited task creators to create AI evaluation tasks personalized using real ChatGPT conversations and memories, reference files, and personal context. Task creators had to pass our expertise threshold (including personally completing the task multiple times and seeing the results through in their real lives for over a year) and also write a rubric, ensuring that our evaluation measured the best personalized completion for that task. All tasks had to pass at least three rounds of human quality-control before acceptance into our final evaluation sets.

translation.title: LifeVal：评估AI模型在个性化Agentic消费者任务上的表现
translation.abstract: 我们提出LifeVal，一个评估AI模型在个性化agentic消费者任务上表现的基准。LifeVal涵盖个性化数字超级助理可以自动化的最有价值的生活任务，代表148个消费者任务类别（如管理财务、搬家、找工作、寻找托儿服务）中每年超过1.7万亿美元的支付意愿。为构建活动分布，我们对超过3,800名具有人口统计学代表性的消费者进行了关于数字超级助理支付意愿的新调查，并将结果与美国时间使用调查（Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025）和跨国时间使用研究（Fisher et al., 2025）进行交叉验证。针对最有价值的消费者活动，我们招募任务创建者，利用真实的ChatGPT对话和记忆、参考文件及个人背景创建个性化AI评估任务。任务创建者必须通过我们的专业门槛（包括亲自多次完成任务并在真实生活中观察结果超过一年），还需撰写评分细则，确保我们的评估衡量该任务的最佳个性化完成情况。所有任务在纳入最终评估集之前必须通过至少三轮人工质量控制。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏个性化消费者任务评估基准的问题，基于大规模支付意愿调查和真实个人背景构建了LifeVal基准来评估AI模型在个性化agentic任务上的能力。

papers.title: Agent-Driven Generative Priors for Pathology Image Synthesis and Segmentation
papers.abstract: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: Agent驱动的生成式先验用于病理图像合成与分割
translation.abstract: 病理学深度学习方法受限于大规模像素级标注的稀缺和高成本。合成数据可以缓解这一限制，但现有流程往往缺乏可靠的质量控制，且与下游分析的联系较弱。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个三阶段框架，整合自动化数据筛选、生成式表示学习和高效的下游任务适配。首先，我们开发了一个病理Agent系统来评估图像质量并筛选样本，得到TCGA-200K，一个从公开TCGA库中筛选出的包含217,030个病理切片的数据集。其次，我们在筛选后的数据上训练生成模型。除图像合成外，其骨干网络还学习可迁移到下游任务的结构和语义表示。第三，我们使用轻量级任务特定头将预训练的生成骨干适配到语义分割。我们进一步提出PathSeg-380K，一个包含专家标注的语义分割数据集，涵盖12种细胞类型约380,000个细胞。在多个病理数据集上的实验表明，所提框架实现了最先进的分割性能。我们的代码已在https URL公开。
translation.brief: 针对病理图像像素级标注稀缺的问题，提出结合Agent自动筛选、生成式表示学习和轻量分割头适配的三阶段框架，并构建了TCGA-200K和PathSeg-380K数据集。

papers.title: Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
papers.abstract: Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.

translation.title: 问题出在哪里：诊断视觉语言Agent在Pac-Man中的感知、记忆与决策失败
translation.abstract: 训练一个只能执行上、下、左、右动作的Agent来玩Pac-Man引出一个基本问题：当表现不佳时，应该改进什么？困难可能来自读取屏幕，也可能来自长序列中的动作选择。我们通过独立的感知检查和原始策略强化学习研究，在基于Qwen3.5-9B的Agent中考察这些问题。在使用文本棋盘以从决策界面中去除图像转录的策略研究中，八个留出迷宫的完成率从优化前的0%提升到所选检查点的80.2%，并带有三条额外生命。感知检查表明，准确的静态截图读取可能与交互过程中的错误并存。另一项策略比较还显示，进一步优化可能伴随更差的动作选择。这些发现共同为后训练提供了具体检查方法：在使用中评估感知、区分训练成功与完整游戏验证，并考察决策和后续表现，而非依赖单一选定分数。该研究为改进未来的Agent训练和评估提供了经验教训。
translation.brief: 针对视觉语言Agent在Pac-Man中表现不佳时难以定位原因的问题，通过分离的感知检查与策略强化学习研究诊断感知、记忆与决策层面的失败。

papers.title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: this https URL.

translation.title: 多语言LLM中对非参数记忆的推理：基于认知的关系知识分析
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）假设语言模型能够对其上下文中陈述的关系进行推理，而不是退回到预训练期间记忆的关联。我们孤立地研究这种证据条件下的关系推理，事实直接在提示中提供而非通过检索获得。Rel-Bloom是一个受控的多语言诊断集，包含由30个Wikidata关系构建的450道多选题；相同源关系在五个受Bloom启发的层级（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评价）和三种真实性条件（事实、反事实、中性化）下实例化。在43个模型、六种语言和两种多语言设置下（226,800次预测），有三个发现突出。首先，在所有被评估的开源权重模型系列中，从应用到分析的准确率急剧下降，Large Granite组下降达47.2个百分点，但两个Gemini模型没有出现这种情况。其次，即使在其他任务类型上接近满分的模型，评价类题目仍是瓶颈：Gemini 3.1 Pro在其他四个层级平均99.5%，但在评价层级仅60.7%。第三，题目和关系层面的难度排名在各语言间保持一致，表明该基准内的难度结构在各语言间部分共享。在知识条件方面，反事实上下文通常比事实上下文更难，而移除实体身份在某些模型机制下可以提升高层级表现。因此，更强的模型能力本身并不能确保对所提供关系证据的可靠推理。相关资源见：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对RAG假设模型能对上下文中关系证据进行推理的问题，构建多语言认知层级诊断集Rel-Bloom，系统评估43个模型对提示中关系知识的推理能力。

papers.title: Airlock: Bounding the Multi-Agent Blast Radius via Selective Online Containment
papers.abstract: When multi-agent systems act on the external world, a single agent's faulty output can spread across tasks before detection, creating a system-wide blast radius. Single-agent guardrails are confined to individual harnesses, while existing multi-agent controls either cancel only the faulty source and miss downstream consumers or halt and roll back the entire workflow at the cost of healthy work. We present Airlock, a multi-agent runtime and guardrail for selective post-alert fault containment. Its tree-structured runtime, EdgeCitadel, narrows permissions vertically from parent to child agents to establish node boundaries and control switches. Meanwhile, an append-only provenance DAG records cross-agent data consumption horizontally. Upon an alert, Airlock traces forward on this DAG to isolate tainted executions and pending actions, and backward to narrow root causes. At the site switches, a default full quarantine tier freezes affected branches without a solver, while an assured optimized cut tier uses fence-then-prune to enforce a deadline-aware minimum cut minimizing collateral disruption. Across 1,832 testbed runs, 161 physical smart-home LLM runs, and 24,266 simulation records, Airlock blocks all post-alert faulty actuations on our main testbed and smart-home grids with zero post-convergence leaks. Whereas native controls in A2A and LangGraph either contain at most 33.3% of faults or retain at most 16% of work without redo, Airlock retains +68 pp to +96 pp more healthy work, and its optimized cut retains +46 pp more than full quarantine under dense spread. These results show that co-designing runtime authority boundaries with online provenance enables surgical fault containment without sacrificing healthy work (code: this https URL).

papers.title: Using AI Predictions to Augment Rather Than Replace Surveys
papers.abstract: LLMs can predict human survey responses with nontrivial accuracy. What this means for the future of social surveys remains hotly contested. Optimists anticipate a coming era of synthetic respondents; skeptics see a fragile and overhyped substitute. This article advocates a position: AI predictions cannot replace surveys, but they can augment them. Using prediction-powered inference (PPI), a statistical framework rooted in survey methodology and known in sociology as "mixed subjects design", the study tests whether AI predictions can improve the statistical efficiency of social surveys when combined with census-scale auxiliary information. Applying the framework to 83 social outcomes in the General Social Survey (GSS) and National Health Interview Survey (NHIS), with American Community Survey (ACS) being the auxiliary file, we find that supervised predictors yield effective-sample-size gains of about 7-12 percent when estimating the mean, while LLM gains are smaller but positive.

papers.title: Route First, See Later: Enabling Vision Agents to Reason Scientifically by Separating Routing Policy from Action Spaces
papers.abstract: Scientific image-analysis workflows require agents to select among diverse capabilities like description, detection, counting, and segmentation. Current multi-tool architectures conflate intent interpretation with visual execution, masking whether a failure arises from flawed reasoning (misrouting) or failed perception (invalid tool execution). This lack of auditability renders agents unreliable for high-stakes scientific automation. We introduce ZETA, an extensible architecture that operationalizes the decoupling of routing policy from action execution. ZETA resolves scientific intent before invoking specialized visual tools, treating measurement as a deterministic operation grounded in explicit geometry rather than generative output. This architecture exposes the "black box" of agent decision-making, allowing routing correctness and downstream execution to be evaluated as independent failure modes. To our knowledge, we provide the first controlled study in scientific vision-agent routing that isolates explicit routing-policy specification while holding the legal action interface fixed. Evaluation on a zero-shot benchmark of 51 scientific-intent queries shows that explicit routing semantics can substantially improve routing accuracy, particularly at semantically adjacent action boundaries, although improvements vary across models. For Qwen 3.8, explicit routing-policy specification improves segmentation routing accuracy from 6.2% to 75.0% and detection routing accuracy from 60.0% to 100%. ZETA's execution traces make routing decisions and downstream artifacts separately observable, providing a basis for distinguishing intent-selection errors from visual execution failures. ZETA establishes the necessary infrastructure to isolate execution errors from interpretive ones, a critical requirement for deploying reliable scientific vision agents.

papers.title: Rethinking Access Control for AI Agents: Recent Advances and Open Challenges
papers.abstract: Large language model agents access data, invoke tools, and act on users' behalf. Keeping these actions within authorized bounds is challenging because agents choose their own execution paths while permissions and operating conditions may change. This paper surveys recent advances in agent access control across four areas: policy specification and derivation, identity and delegation, action and resource enforcement, and information flow control. We compare their control objects, enforcement boundaries, and assumptions to examine what individual mechanisms achieve and how they can work together. Building on this analysis, we rethink four aspects of authorization: plan selection shapes permission requirements; contextual information can inform decisions without itself granting authority; restrictions must retain their meaning across system interfaces; and authorization must be reassessed as workflows evolve. These insights motivate open challenges and future directions, together with concrete research questions and evaluation criteria. In particular, evaluation should examine both observed agent behavior and the unauthorized effects that remain enabled. Our analysis connects existing mechanisms to the requirements for preserving authorization throughout an agent workflow.

papers.title: Stability and Perfection in Constrained Weighted Network Games
papers.abstract: We introduce a general framework of constrained weighted network formation in which agents allocate resources across coalitional interactions while facing feasibility constraints. More precisely, we allow arbitrary coalitions of agents to be assigned a continuous weight, and we incorporate both coalitional capacity constraints and individual budget constraints into the model. This framework extends the weighted network formation model of Bich and Morhaim by combining continuous interaction intensities with endogenous feasibility restrictions. Within this setting, we introduce a new notion of stability -- called coalitionwise stability -- extending pairwise stability to constrained network games. Under standard continuity and componentwise quasiconcavity assumptions on payoff functions, we establish the existence of coalitionwise stable networks. We then investigate refinements of stability inspired by the notion of perfect equilibrium introduced by Selten, and by the notion of perfect pairwise stability developed by Bich and Teteryatnikova for network games. The presence of feasibility constraints fundamentally alters the geometry of the feasible set, which no longer possesses a product structure. As a consequence, trembling-hand type refinements become substantially more delicate, since perturbations of some interactions may render other interactions infeasible. Nevertheless, we introduce constrained analogues of both the trembling-hand and perturbative notions of perfect stability considered by Bich and Teteryatnikova, and study their existence and their relationship. In particular, we show the equivalence between these trembling-hand and perturbative formulations under some componentwise monotonicity assumption.

papers.title: WISE: An Agentic Framework for Whole-page Multimodal Search Experience Attribution
papers.abstract: Algorithm-driven services, including search, recommendation, and advertising, rely on multi-stage model pipelines. While research prioritizes model optimization, post-deployment monitoring focuses on operational reliability. Yet operationally healthy systems may still produce poor-quality results, exposing a gap in existing evaluation and monitoring practices. However, a systematic problem formulation and benchmark for this task remain lacking. To bridge this gap, we formulate System Quality Diagnosis (SQD) for algorithm-driven services, a new task that extends quality evaluation beyond identifying poor outcomes to attributing their causes across system components. Focusing on industrial search, we propose WISE, an agentic framework for end-to-end quality diagnosis that discovers user-facing issues and traces their origins to underlying algorithmic components. To improve diagnostic reliability, we introduce ReTrace for constructing evidence-consistent trajectory supervision and Adaptive Harness-Policy Optimization (AHPO) for failure-guided optimization of the agent harness and model policy. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct WISE-BENCH, a real-world multimodal search benchmark that combines user-facing evidence, internal pipeline traces, and expert diagnosis annotations. Extensive experiments show consistent gains across model scales, with WISE achieving 75.20% end-to-end accuracy on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. In production, WISE supports quality auditing, online quality assurance, and model optimization, reducing diagnosis costs and improving downstream relevance models.

papers.title: Transforming Integer Grids to Spatial Intuition: Perception, Not Planning, Governs ARC-AGI-3
papers.abstract: Sample-efficient fluid intelligence requires agents that rapidly form working models of unfamiliar interactive environments. ARC-AGI-3 tests this across uninstructed visual games scored by Relative Human Action Efficiency, which penalizes exploratory waste quadratically. When frontier models read raw integer grids, serialization destroys spatial topology, and they spend hundreds of actions rediscovering basic boundaries and symmetries. We introduce SARBLOH, an open-weight agent built on the premise that spatial perception, not planning capacity, governs interactive reasoning on ARC-AGI-3. A zero-parameter O(HW) perception engine turns each frame, in 35 ms, into an object inventory with bipartite temporal tracking, a geometric briefing that separates proven invariants from affordance hypotheses, and an annotated canvas. Paired with a code-as-action runtime, the agent writes algorithmic hypotheses instead of low-level moves. Across eight presentations, grounded perception raises the rubric score from 3/28 to 25/28 points while cutting token use by 89.4%. On 23 held-out games, geometric invariants generalize with 100% accuracy, while single-frame affordance guesses fall to 6-50%, so active verification probes remain necessary. On the public set, Run A (briefing off) solved 143 of 183 levels in 8.2 hours at 59.4% single-pass efficiency; Run B (briefing on) reached 63.5%. Within the nine-hour budget on one Kaggle RTX PRO 6000 GPU, SARBLOH scored 16.53 on the hidden Kaggle evaluation, 13.7x the first Milestone winner.

papers.title: Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces
papers.abstract: Efficient benchmarking estimates a system's full benchmark performance from a small number of task executions. Standard approaches rely solely on the binary correctness of executions from a collection of already-evaluated reference systems. An agentic system, however, produces a rich trace for each execution that can reveal substantially more about its capabilities. Leveraging this information requires useful trace representations. We propose representing a trace by extracting a structured summary of it with an LLM and embedding the summary with a standard text encoder. These representations preserve correctness- and task-related signal while minimizing the presence of system identity-, model family- and harness-related signals that dominate raw trace embeddings. Given this representation for each task execution from all reference systems, we construct low-dimensional representations of the systems and predict a new system's score from its position among the reference systems. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0, augmenting an item-response model with this geometry-based prediction reduces mean absolute error from 0.13 to 0.08 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-4}$) and from 0.14 to 0.12 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-3}$), respectively, when provided a single random executed task. Further, given access to the full set of reference systems, our approach dominates baselines for any given number of executed tasks on both benchmarks.

papers.title: Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
papers.abstract: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1\% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.

papers.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
papers.abstract: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.

translation.abstract: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.

papers.title: SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment
papers.abstract: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.

papers.title: Enabling AWS Cloud FPGA Development Using High-Level Vitis HLS
papers.abstract: We present a toolchain for development of ML models on AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure from high-level language, implementing a complete Vitis HLS to HDK bridge to AFI workflow that has been absent from the academic literature despite eight years of AWS FPGA availability. We introduce a four-level methodology (FP32 PyTorch, bit-accurate quantized Python, HLS C-simulation, physical FPGA) to aid in localizing errors, including FPGA-specific circuit errors. Together these tools allow coding agents to effectively implement FPGA designs from user directions, testing and debugging as needed. We document the deployment workflow, timing closure strategies, and practical HLS engineering decisions that proved crucial. We validate using TinyBERT fine-tuned for address Named Entity Recognition, implementing the embedding layer and the first of four encoder layers on the FPGA hardware. Our implementation streams weights from host DRAM, yielding poor performance compared to CPU/GPU implementations; we discuss forward paths.

papers.title: Context--Answer Metamodels: Forecasting LLM Activations Before the First Answer Token
papers.abstract: Under stochastic decoding, a single context can elicit many different answers from a language model. Characterizing this variation typically requires many expensive autoregressive rollouts, each revealing only one realization. We ask whether the activations produced while reading the context can directly forecast the model's rollout activations. We train context--answer metamodels that map a context activation sequence to point or distribution forecasts of mean-pooled answer activations. We find that (i) the four metamodel families we study forecast mean-pooled answer activations with high fidelity, and the distribution metamodels also capture rollout variability; (ii) performance improves as the training set grows to 500,000 prompts, and the metamodels generalize zero-shot to out-of-domain datasets; (iii) their forecasts retain behavior-predictive signal; and (iv) context activations from Qwen2.5 predict mean-pooled answer activations from Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4, suggesting that activation forecasts can transfer across models. Together, these results suggest that context activation traces can support scalable forecasts of behaviors in LLM answers before the first answer token is generated.

papers.title: Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models' ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.

papers.title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.

papers.title: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
papers.abstract: A central yet under-explored question in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is where to connect---how visual information from a hierarchical vision encoder should be wired into the layer-wise semantics of a large language model. Mainstream MLLMs inject a fixed single-layer visual representation into the LLM and treat all LLM layers as a single consumer, ignoring that different layers demand different visual granularities. Recent multi-layer fusion methods either compress hierarchical features on the encoder side or rely on predefined sparse or hierarchical layer-to-layer connections, and therefore stop short of modeling adaptive cross-layer interactions between the ViT and LLM hierarchies. We address this gap with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), a routing mechanism that establishes all-to-all connections between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, with each LLM layer dynamically gating its preference over visual layers conditioned on its own semantic state. Built on top of LLaVA-1.5-7B and 13B, DGP delivers consistent gains over the LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline (e.g., +4.2 on SQA$^{I}$, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA$^{W}$) and surpasses prior multi-layer visual fusion methods on most benchmarks. Layer-wise routing analyses further show that different LLM layers do select different visual granularities on demand, supporting both the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed dynamic gated pathways. The code is available: this https URL.

translation.title: 连接在哪里？通过跨所有 ViT 与 LLM 层的动态门控通路增强多模态大语言模型
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中一个核心但尚未充分探索的问题是“连接在哪里”——即来自分层视觉编码器的视觉信息应如何接入大语言模型的逐层语义。主流 MLLM 将固定的单层视觉表示注入 LLM，并把所有 LLM 层视为单一消费者，忽略了不同层需要不同视觉粒度。近期的多层融合方法要么在编码器侧压缩分层特征，要么依赖预定义的稀疏或分层连接，因而未能建模 ViT 与 LLM 层级之间的自适应跨层交互。我们用 DGP（Dynamic Gated Pathways，动态门控通路）填补这一空白，这是一种路由机制，在每个 ViT 层与每个 LLM 层之间建立全连接，每个 LLM 层根据自身语义状态动态门控其对视觉层的偏好。基于 LLaVA-1.5-7B 和 13B 构建，DGP 相比 LLaVA-1.5-7B 基线带来一致提升（如 SQA$^{I}$ +4.2、MM-Vet +3.3、VizWiz 和 LLaVA$^{W}$ +3.1），并在大多数基准上超越以往多层视觉融合方法。逐层路由分析进一步表明，不同 LLM 层确实按需选择不同的视觉粒度，支持了所提动态门控通路的有效性与可解释性。代码见：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 中视觉信息接入 LLM 层级缺乏自适应跨层交互的问题，提出 DGP 路由机制，在所有 ViT 层与所有 LLM 层之间建立由各 LLM 层语义状态动态门控的全连接通路。

papers.title: Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs
papers.abstract: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.

translation.title: 人格视角：采纳观点会重组 LLM 中的表示
translation.abstract: 监测大语言模型（LLM）特征的常用方法（如线性探针和稀疏自编码器 SAE）假设特征在不同上下文中保持一致的表示。然而 LLM 可以灵活采纳不同视角或“人格”，暗示不同的底层概念关系系统。本文考察提示 LLM 采纳某一人格是否会改变模型潜空间的表示几何。我们从采纳自由派与保守派政治人格的模型中提取 9000 多个常用词和 33 个语义轴的表示，并与两个中性基线比较。我们发现人格条件化会系统性地改变词在语义轴上的投影以及语义轴之间的对齐关系，且方向与指定意识形态一致。随后我们检验这种重组对两个安全相关特征——真实性与道德性——的影响。未使用人格训练的线性探针、基于 SAE 的分类器以及由人工挑选词表示构建的分类器，在应用于政治人格条件化的模型时产生分歧结果，对争议性陈述给出带有政治倾向的真实性与道德性评分。这些发现表明，按常规方式提取的内部表示在模型采纳人格时可能呈现不同的几何关系，从而可能削弱监测工作。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 采纳人格是否会改变其内部表示几何，发现政治人格条件化会系统性重组语义轴表示并使常规监测工具（线性探针、SAE）产生政治倾向性偏差。

papers.title: Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently achieved superhuman performance on several long-horizon benchmarks. However, their computational cost limits their use in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains such as video games. A key bottleneck is representing each screenshot as thousands of visual tokens, which accumulate into long contexts as agents reason over extended interaction histories. We observe that most of these visual tokens are either semantically irrelevant to the agent's next action or temporally redundant across screenshots. Building on this observation, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations that preserve the information needed for action prediction. In VTR, we train the vision-language model together with a lightweight spatio-temporal router that examines each image region in the current and previous screenshots and decides whether its visual token enters the language model. We optimize the router using an adaptive loss to keep the number of visual tokens as small as possible while minimizing performance degradation. With just 2,000 training steps, VTR matches the performance of the full-resolution model on OSWorld, CUA-World, and video game action prediction, while using 2.5-5.8x fewer visual tokens. These savings reduce inference cost by up to 3.3x and speed up prefill by up to 2.9x. VTR also outperforms lowering the image resolution and other baselines for dropping tokens, by up to 12.8 points on OSWorld. Overall, VTR enables computer-use agents to process only the visual tokens they need, allowing them to be used in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains at a fraction of the computational cost. Code and models are available at this https URL

translation.title: 视觉令牌路由：学习保留重要的令牌
translation.abstract: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）近期在多个长程基准上取得了超越人类的性能，但其计算成本限制了它们在长程任务和视频游戏等实时领域的应用。一个关键瓶颈是将每张截图表示为数千个视觉令牌，随着智能体在长交互历史中推理，这些令牌累积成长上下文。我们观察到，这些视觉令牌大多要么与智能体的下一步动作语义无关，要么在时间上跨截图冗余。基于这一观察，我们提出 Visual Token Routing（VTR），一个联合训练框架，用于学习保留动作预测所需信息的稀疏视觉表示。在 VTR 中，我们与一个轻量级时空路由器共同训练视觉语言模型，该路由器检查当前和先前截图中的每个图像区域，并决定其视觉令牌是否进入语言模型。我们使用自适应损失优化路由器，在尽量减少性能下降的同时将视觉令牌数量降到最低。仅需 2000 个训练步，VTR 在 OSWorld、CUA-World 和视频游戏动作预测上匹配全分辨率模型的性能，同时使用少 2.5-5.8 倍的视觉令牌。这些节省使推理成本最多降低 3.3 倍，prefill 速度最多提升 2.9 倍。VTR 还优于降低图像分辨率及其他令牌丢弃基线，在 OSWorld 上最多领先 12.8 分。总体而言，VTR 使计算机使用智能体只处理所需的视觉令牌，从而以极小的计算成本用于长程任务和实时领域。代码和模型见 this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对计算机使用智能体视觉令牌过多导致计算成本高的问题，提出 VTR 联合训练框架，用轻量级时空路由器自适应筛选保留对动作预测重要的视觉令牌。

papers.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
papers.abstract: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: this https URL.

translation.title: LongBanana：一个经专家验证的长上下文多参考图像合成基准
translation.abstract: 我们提出 LongBanana，据我们所知是首个在智能体驱动图像生成时代由专家设计并经专家验证的长上下文多参考图像合成基准。该任务要求检索分散的视觉证据、拒绝干扰项、绑定实体与关系，并从多个参考图合成一张连贯的最终图像。LongBanana 包含 90 个精心设计的任务，按 3×3 分类体系组织；每个任务包含约 32 张参考图、20 个约束和 50 个评估项，共产生 4,670 个专家指定的原子评估项。其基于图的评估设计为每个任务实例化参考图和实体-关系图，然后将节点、边和整图义务转化为内容保真度、关系绑定和全局约束满足的检查清单项。经审核的专家标注包括 15% 的双标注子集，精确一致率为 89.4%，二次加权 kappa 为 0.83。我们进一步提出 LongBanana-Gen，一个面向长程图像生成的智能体框架；实验表明，最小智能体框架优于直接生成，而 ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect（RPR）工作流通过强化证据定位与修复带来依赖框架的增益。LongBanana 共同提供了一个可审计的测试平台，用于衡量密集视觉证据的利用，并为开发更强的智能体驱动图像生成系统提供共同目标。代码和数据见项目页：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏评估长上下文多参考图像合成能力的基准问题，构建了专家设计验证的 LongBanana 基准，用实体-关系图驱动的检查清单评估密集视觉证据的检索与合成。

papers.title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires AI systems to improve the models and infrastructure used by subsequent systems. LLM compression offers a concrete efficiency objective: retain a pretrained model's behavior within a smaller model storage budget. We study whether coding agents can carry out this step autonomously. We formulate compression as a terminal task in which an agent receives a source checkpoint, storage limit, inference environment, and time budget, then constructs compressed weights and executable inference code. The agent controls its algorithm and experiments; perplexity feedback guides search, and independent verification checks the final model. Across six agents and six model--size settings, 29 of 36 submissions pass verification. Selecting the lowest-perplexity agent design per task yields an average 3.4% perplexity increase over BF16 and 77.33% downstream accuracy, compared with 79.56% for BF16. Recorded experiments reveal how agents achieve these outcomes and where improvement breaks down. Agents lower PPL in 21 of 24 revisions at nearly fixed storage; complete-model feedback reverses 17 of 79 prior local rankings; and generation and inference tests expose failures that likelihood alone misses. The results identify representation design, experimental judgment, and capability validation as central to agent-driven model compression, a measurable component of efficiency-oriented self-improvement.

translation.title: CompressionBench：你的编码智能体如何压缩 LLM？
translation.abstract: 递归自我改进要求 AI 系统能改进后续系统所使用的模型和基础设施。LLM 压缩提供了一个具体的效率目标：在更小的模型存储预算内保留预训练模型的行为。我们研究编码智能体能否自主完成这一步骤。我们将压缩形式化为一个终端任务：智能体接收源检查点、存储限制、推理环境和时间预算，然后构建压缩权重和可执行的推理代码。智能体自主控制其算法和实验；困惑度反馈引导搜索，独立验证检查最终模型。在六个智能体和六种模型-规模设置中，36 个提交中有 29 个通过验证。为每个任务选择困惑度最低的智能体设计，平均困惑度相对 BF16 增加 3.4%，下游准确率为 77.33%，而 BF16 为 79.56%。记录的实验揭示了智能体如何取得这些结果以及改进在何处失效：智能体在 24 次修订中的 21 次以几乎固定的存储降低 PPL；完整模型反馈推翻了 79 次先前局部排名中的 17 次；生成和推理测试暴露了仅靠似然无法发现的失败。结果指出表示设计、实验判断和能力验证是智能体驱动模型压缩的核心，这是面向效率的自我改进中可度量的组成部分。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体能否自主完成 LLM 压缩任务，将其形式化为在存储与时间预算下生成压缩权重和推理代码的终端任务，并用困惑度反馈与独立验证评估智能体表现。

papers.title: GH-AWTrace: A Large-Scale Dataset of GitHub Agentic Workflow Execution Logs
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows enable AI agents to perform recurring repository tasks on schedules or in response to repository events. Existing studies examine workflow definitions and outputs, but provide limited evidence of what happens during execution. We present GH-AWTrace, a dataset linking 25,014 verified GitHub Agentic Workflows across 5,051 repositories to 4,112,526 run records and 562,877 nonempty execution log archives. The dataset preserves execution evidence subject to GitHub's log-retention limits and links it to repository metadata and generated workflow configurations. Illustrative cases show how the logs expose tool denials, provider failures, changes in an agent's approach, and delegation among agents. These observations enable research on execution failures, tool use, and the relationship between reported run outcomes and visible task progress. Coverage varies across workflows, and the logs provide partial observations rather than complete agent trajectories. Video: this https URL

translation.title: GH-AWTrace：GitHub 智能体工作流执行日志的大规模数据集
translation.abstract: 智能体工作流使 AI 智能体能够按计划或响应仓库事件执行周期性的仓库任务。现有研究考察工作流定义和输出，但对执行过程中实际发生了什么提供的证据有限。我们提出 GH-AWTrace，该数据集将 5,051 个仓库中的 25,014 个经验证的 GitHub Agentic Workflows 与 4,112,526 条运行记录和 562,877 个非空执行日志归档关联起来。数据集在 GitHub 日志保留限制下保存执行证据，并将其与仓库元数据和生成的工作流配置关联。示例案例展示了日志如何揭示工具拒绝、提供商故障、智能体方法的改变以及智能体之间的委托。这些观察支持关于执行失败、工具使用以及报告的运行结果与可见任务进展之间关系的研究。各工作流的覆盖程度不同，日志提供的是部分观察而非完整的智能体轨迹。视频：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对智能体工作流执行过程缺乏证据的问题，构建了将 GitHub Agentic Workflows 与运行记录和执行日志关联的大规模数据集 GH-AWTrace。

papers.title: On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents
papers.abstract: In this work, we evaluate a simple inference-time scaling approach based on \textit{turn-level best-of-N sampling} (\method) for large language model (LLM) agents on complex, long-horizon tasks. We instantiate this using a \textit{generator-selector} framework with two LLMs; at each turn, a \emph{generator} model generates $N$ candidate actions and a \emph{selector} model selects one of them, which is then executed in the environment. This paper is closely related to the work of \cite{zainullina2025guided} who used critic models for guided search at inference time. Different from their work, we evaluate if off-the-shelf, open-weight LLMs can be effective at comparing different candidate actions directly. Experiments on long-horizon terminal tasks show that \method can lead to significant performance improvements, both in terms of accuracy (5--10\%) and consistency across repeated attempts. Analysis of agent trajectories reveal a shift in agent behaviour towards desirable patterns such as reduction in number of attempts to solve the task, improved task instruction following, debugging and testing.

translation.title: 论面向 LLM 智能体扩展的轮次级 Best-of-N 采样
translation.abstract: 在本工作中，我们评估了一种简单的推理时扩展方法，即基于轮次级 best-of-N 采样（\method）的方法，用于在复杂的长时程任务上扩展大语言模型（LLM）智能体。我们通过一个包含两个 LLM 的生成器-选择器框架来实现该方法；在每一轮，生成器模型生成 N 个候选动作，选择器模型从中选择一个，然后该动作在环境中执行。本文与 \cite{zainullina2025guided} 的工作密切相关，后者在推理时使用 critic 模型进行引导搜索。与他们的工作不同，我们评估现成的开源权重 LLM 是否能够有效地直接比较不同候选动作。在长时程终端任务上的实验表明，\method 能带来显著的性能提升，包括准确率（5--10%）和多次尝试之间的一致性。对智能体轨迹的分析显示，智能体行为向理想模式转变，例如减少解决任务的尝试次数、更好地遵循任务指令、以及改进调试和测试。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体长时程任务性能提升问题，提出轮次级 best-of-N 采样方法，由生成器模型产生候选动作、选择器模型每轮择一执行。

papers.title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
papers.abstract: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $\tau^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.

translation.title: SpecCompact：基于槽位并行语义投机验证加速 LLM 智能体上下文压缩
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体使用上下文压缩来管理不断增长的交互历史，但用大模型对长历史进行摘要可能引入显著延迟。因此压缩需要在信息保留与延迟之间取得平衡。我们观察到结构化摘要槽位在独立生成时可以保留信息。基于这一观察，我们提出 SpecCompact，一个通过槽位并行语义投机来加速压缩的框架。SpecCompact 微调一个小型 drafter 并并行生成槽位。目标模型验证每条提议的行并修复被拒绝的内容，同时后续起草使用更新后的槽位前缀。系统优化进一步减少了重复的上下文处理和模型调用。在 AppWorld 和 $\tau^3$ 基准上使用两个目标模型，SpecCompact 相比 Hermes 风格摘要实现了 2.04--5.63 倍的压缩加速。独立的下游评估揭示了依赖模型和任务的性能权衡。Hermes 内的用户研究进一步显示中位数压缩加速达 8.68 倍。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体上下文压缩延迟高的问题，提出 SpecCompact 框架，用小型 drafter 并行生成摘要槽位并由目标模型进行语义投机验证以加速压缩。

papers.title: Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure
papers.abstract: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work. I examine how these conditions relate to occupational AI exposure using 21 O*NET items across 754 US occupations. Higher exposure is associated with lower condition scores under a large language model (LLM) measure and AI Occupational Exposure (AIOE), with equal occupation weights and employment weights. Adjustment for physical demands, required education, training and experience, and wages reduces the composite association. The adjusted confidence intervals include zero for LLM exposure and remain below zero for AIOE. Separating repetition from restricted discretion also changes what the combined Dull score conveys. These comparisons show how item groupings and occupational characteristics shape the interpretation of exposure estimates. Occupational profiles offer a starting point for selecting contrasting research settings. Establishing desired automation or realized relief requires evidence about workers' preferences and specific interventions.

translation.title: 枯燥、肮脏、危险？工作条件与职业 AI 暴露度的局限
translation.abstract: 自动化常被论证为将人们从枯燥、肮脏和危险的工作中解放出来。我使用覆盖 754 个美国职业的 21 个 O*NET 条目，考察这些条件与职业 AI 暴露度之间的关系。在采用大语言模型（LLM）度量和 AI Occupational Exposure（AIOE）、并分别使用等职业权重和就业权重的情况下，更高的暴露度与更低的工作条件得分相关。对体力要求、所需教育、培训与经验以及工资进行调整后，综合关联减弱。调整后的置信区间在 LLM 暴露度上包含零，而在 AIOE 上仍低于零。将重复性与受限自主性分开也会改变合并的 Dull 分数所传达的含义。这些比较表明条目分组和职业特征如何影响暴露度估计的解释。职业画像为选择对比性研究场景提供了起点。确定期望的自动化或已实现的解脱需要关于工人偏好和具体干预的证据。
translation.brief: 针对自动化是否真正解脱枯燥、肮脏、危险工作的问题，利用 O*NET 数据实证分析职业 AI 暴露度与工作条件之间的关联及其解释局限。

papers.title: MCP-Eco: A Linked Dataset of MCP Servers, Consumers, and Development Activity
papers.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLM agents to access external tools and data. Studying its software ecosystem requires connecting server interfaces, the projects that configure these servers, and their development activity. However, this information is scattered across directories, package registries, configuration files, and repository histories. We present MCP-Eco, a relational dataset that integrates these sources and links consumer configuration declarations to candidate server projects. Its frozen release contains 16,880,899 records across 19 Parquet tables, covering 78,302 candidate server projects, 16,165 candidate consuming repositories, and 9,200 configuration declarations. Of these declarations, 5,975 resolve to 5,138 distinct repository-server pairs. The dataset also includes tool, resource, and prompt descriptions, declared dependencies, and associated development records, including pull requests, reviews, issues, and commits. Provenance fields distinguish directory-reported capabilities from those observed through live probing and document discovery sources and declaration-matching methods. These connections support research on MCP interface design, configuration practices, and repository maintenance, while enabling practitioners to inspect tool schemas and existing integration configurations. The dataset and accompanying analysis scripts are publicly available at this https URL Demo video: this https URL

translation.title: MCP-Eco：MCP 服务器、消费者与开发活动的关联数据集
translation.abstract: Model Context Protocol（MCP）使 LLM 智能体能够访问外部工具和数据。研究其软件生态系统需要连接服务器接口、配置这些服务器的项目及其开发活动。然而，这些信息分散在目录、包注册表、配置文件和仓库历史中。我们提出 MCP-Eco，一个整合这些来源并将消费者配置声明与候选服务器项目关联的关系型数据集。其冻结发布版包含 19 个 Parquet 表中的 16,880,899 条记录，涵盖 78,302 个候选服务器项目、16,165 个候选消费仓库和 9,200 条配置声明。其中 5,975 条声明解析为 5,138 个不同的仓库-服务器对。数据集还包括工具、资源和提示描述、声明的依赖以及相关开发记录，包括 pull request、评审、issue 和 commit。溯源字段区分目录报告的能力与通过实时探测观察到的能力，并记录发现来源和声明匹配方法。这些关联支持关于 MCP 接口设计、配置实践和仓库维护的研究，同时使从业者能够检查工具 schema 和现有集成配置。数据集及配套分析脚本已在 this https URL 公开。演示视频：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对 MCP 生态信息分散难以研究的问题，构建了将 MCP 服务器、消费者配置声明与开发活动关联的关系型数据集 MCP-Eco。

papers.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
papers.abstract: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. Across 22 models in 26 configurations, no configuration passes more than 46 of its 168 rollouts. Manual review of agent trajectories shows that frontier agents' main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition, rather than gaps in physics knowledge or execution errors.

translation.title: FrontierPhysics：评估面向端到端物理学研究的智能体
translation.abstract: AI 智能体在物理学研究中正扮演着越来越重要的角色。然而，现有的物理学基准只评估固定问题、孤立子任务或基于给定解答的论文复现，且很少在检查正确性的同时检查研究质量。我们提出 FrontierPhysics，一个端到端基准，包含由 42 位物理学家基于自身研究创建的 56 个任务，覆盖理论、计算和实验物理的九个领域。每个任务要求智能体查阅文献、制定研究计划、开展研究与实验，并产出结构化输出和科学手稿。FrontierPhysics 将确定性验证器与专家撰写的评分细则相结合，评估智能体的研究是否正确且可发表。在 26 种配置的 22 个模型上，没有任何配置在其 168 次运行中通过超过 46 次。对智能体轨迹的人工审查表明，前沿智能体的主要弱点是推理不够严谨和专家直觉有限，而非物理知识缺口或执行错误。
translation.brief: 针对现有物理基准无法评估端到端研究质量的问题，构建了由物理学家基于自身研究设计的端到端任务基准，结合确定性验证器与专家评分细则来评估智能体研究的正确性与可发表性。

papers.title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
papers.abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.

translation.title: 面向 LLM 社会智能体的上下文增强与选择性鲁棒性框架
translation.abstract: 研究者将大语言模型用作社会模拟中的智能体，通过观察和背景信息来引导智能体的行为。然而，已有研究表明 LLM 智能体在保持语义不变的提示变化下会显著改变行为，这给社会模拟带来了验证难题。一个合理的假设是，这种脆弱性反映了缺乏依据（grounding），并可通过丰富提供给智能体的上下文来缓解。但更丰富的上下文是否能提升鲁棒性仍不清楚，部分原因在于上下文丰富度和鲁棒性很少以支持受控比较的方式被定义。我们通过受控上下文增强满足第一个需求，这是一组提示替换规则，系统地增强不同类型的上下文：中性填充、通用社会背景、描述性决策依据和规范性决策依据。我们通过引入选择性鲁棒性作为验证标准来满足第二个需求：对保持语义的提示变化不敏感，同时对社交世界中与决策相关的变化产生方向性响应。我们在一个类似囚徒困境的博弈中演示了该框架，展示如何用它识别哪些形式的上下文增强能产生更理想、更鲁棒的智能体行为。我们发现这些增强形式产生了不同的行为模式，且在所测试的两个模型之间存在差异。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 社会智能体在语义不变的提示变化下行为不稳定的问题，提出受控上下文增强规则和“选择性鲁棒性”验证标准，以识别哪些上下文类型能带来更鲁棒的智能体行为。
